jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for members to join us our Digital Technology and Transformation team to build digital services and e-commerce solution across digital services channels. You’ll be the key players in products & services design and development, from inception through production. If you would like to shift yourself into next steps and make the real impact, we’re waiting for you.
Core Responsibilities
● Advanced Modeling: Design and implement predictive models using supervised/unsupervised learning, regression, deep learning, and cutting-edge Generative AI.
● Production & MLOps: Develop robust, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready AI/ML workflows, with a focus on MLOps practices. Experienced in ML/AI serving optimization (low-latency, batch) and understand deployment strategy
● Optimization & Safety: Conduct performance tuning, token optimization, and API cost, management while ensuring all models adhere to AI safety, fairness, and privacy standards.
● Cross-Functional Team: Partner with Data Scientist, Product Owner, Data Engineering, Developer, and other business teams to translate complex business problems into technical roadmaps.
● Engineering Excellence: Raises the team’s technical bar by establishing best practices for code reviews, experiment tracking, and documentation.
● Innovation: Stay at the forefront of AI/ML trends, proactively researching and applying new techniques or frameworks to solve retail and e-commerce challenges.

Qualification
● Education: Bachelor degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information System, or an IT-related field.
● Experience: 3+ years of proven experience as an AI/ML Engineer with a focus on delivering advanced AI & Machine Learning applications on a large scale (Retail or E-Commerce business is preferable).
● Core Languages: Mastery of Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and expert-level SQL.
● Basic ML knowledge: Supervised, Unsupervised, Regression, and traditional AI algorithms.
● Agentic AI frameworks like Langchain and Langgraph
● Frontend and Backend development and/or integration
● Production deployment: Ubuntu, Docker
● MLOPs Mastery: Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for ML model experiment tracking, Data Versioning, and real-time monitoring
● Familiar with Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and Big Data tools (Databricks)
● Understand data structure and manipulation techniques, write clean code, and adopt software engineering techniques.

Nice to have:
● Broad domain knowledge of e-commerce and retail business.
● Hands-on experience with MLOps tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, or AWS SageMaker.
● Familiarity with data engineering tools like Apache Spark, Kafka, or Airflow.
● Familiarity with Golang is a distinct advantage.

Location: BTS Ekkamai
Working Day: Mon-Fri (WFA every friday)

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description:
• Analyze Requirements & Define AI Use Cases: Collaborate with business stakeholders across Sales & Marketing, Accounting, and Human Resources to design AI solutions that optimize workflows, reduce manual steps, and support decision-making.

• Develop AI Solutions & Prototypes: Build and deploy AI prototypes and applications, including Chatbots, Document Search systems, Predictive Models, and Process Automation.

• Data Engineering & Preparation: Prepare, integrate, clean, and transform multi-source data (using SQL, Embeddings, and Vector Databases) to ensure high-quality data pipelines for AI models.

• Testing & Model Optimization: Evaluate, benchmark, and continuously fine-tune AI performance, accuracy, security, and response quality (e.g., assessing RAG outputs and Agent workflows).

• Enablement & Deployment Support: Drive AI adoption across the organization, train end-users, document process flows/manuals, and track real-world business outcomes.

Key Qualification:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Engineering, or related fields.

• Core AI Knowledge: Solid understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Agents.

• Programming & Libraries: Proficient in Python and standard data/AI libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, LangChain, or similar frameworks).

• Data Engineering & Vector DBs: Strong SQL skills (joins, aggregations, data transformation) with expertise in data cleaning, feature engineering, embeddings, and vector databases.

• AI Cloud Services & APIs: Hands-on experience integrating cloud AI services and APIs (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, OpenAI API, Microsoft Copilot, or similar platforms).

• Business Analysis & Governance: Strong problem-solving ability to analyze business requirements, build technical documentation (Process Flows, Test Cases, Manuals), with knowledge of AI Governance, Data Privacy, and Responsible AI.

• Experience: 1–3 years of experience in AI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, or Software Development (Fresh graduates with strong hands-on AI academic/personal projects are welcome to apply) .

jobs.title: AI Engineer (T00030275)
jobs.description:
Job summary
The AI Engineer will design, develop, and integrate AI-powered solutions into software applications using APIs and cloud-native services. With a strong foundation in software engineering and hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, this role focuses on operationalizing AI models, building intelligent features, and ensuring seamless deployment and scalability of AI services. The engineer will collaborate with product teams, data scientists, and cloud architects to deliver robust, secure, and efficient AI-driven systems.
Job description
• Design and consume RESTful APIs for AI services, including generative AI, TTS, STT and NLP.

• Integrate third-party AI APIs (e.g., Azure OpenAI) into enterprise applications.

• Integrate APIs with API Gateway for authentication, rate limiting, and monitoring

• Document and maintain API specifications for internal and external use.

• Collaborate with data scientists to deploy trained models into production environments.

• Implement model inference pipelines and monitor performance metrics (latency, accuracy, throughput).

• Design and develop chatbot solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs)

• Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using knowledge bases

• Design and implement AI agent workflows with multi-step reasoning and decision-making

• Integrate chatbot with internal/external tools via function calling / API orchestration

• Manage conversation context, memory, and state across interactions

• Collaborate with data scientists to deploy trained models into production environments.

• Apply MLOps principles for continuous integration and delivery of AI models.

• Deploy and manage chatbot and AI services on Azure Cloud

• Work with services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, App Service, and Storage

• Integrate data pipelines with cloud storage (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage) and compute resources.

• Implement CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and scalable deployment patterns

• Ensure responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, and data privacy.

• Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and best practices for applied machine learning.

• Implement secure and scalable cloud architectures for AI model hosting and inference.

• Monitor and optimize cloud resource usage, ensuring cost-efficiency and performance.

• Use Azure DevOps for pipeline automation, model versioning, and release management.

Qualifications
• At Least 3 years of experience as an AI Engineer, Software Engineer, or related field.

• Strong coding skills i.e. Python, nodeJS

• Develop web applications using Next.js Integrate frontend with chatbot APIs (Python / Node.js backend)

• Experience with full-stack development using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, Node.js, Next.js is a plus.

• Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud services, especially those related to AI LLMs, and DevOps.

• Experience designing and managing data science infrastructure, including compute, storage, and orchestration.

• Effective communication and teamwork to bridge technical and business needs.

• Continuous learning to adapt to evolving Data and AI technologies

jobs.title: AI Business Architect
jobs.description:
IDG กำลังยกระดับวิธีการทำงานทั้งองค์กรด้วย AI และพัฒนาบริการที่ปรึกษาให้ทันกับความต้องการของลูกค้าองค์กร เราจึงมองหาคนที่ยืนอยู่ตรงกลางระหว่าง “โจทย์ธุรกิจ” กับ “เทคโนโลยี”
คุณจะรับโจทย์จากผู้บริหารและทีมงาน แปลงเป็นการออกแบบโซลูชัน AI ที่ใช้ได้จริง แล้วลงมือทำให้เกิดขึ้นร่วมกับทีมข้ามสายงาน — ทั้งภายในองค์กรและกับลูกค้า
ตำแหน่งนี้ไม่ใช่งานวิจัย และไม่ใช่งานเขียนโปรแกรมล้วน ๆ แต่คืองาน “ทำให้ AI ใช้ได้จริงและวัดผลได้”

หน้าที่ความรับผิดชอบ
— ถอดกระบวนการทำงานของแต่ละหน่วยงานและของลูกค้า หาจุดที่ AI สร้างผลลัพธ์ได้จริงทั้งด้านเวลาและรายได้ แล้วจัดลำดับความสำคัญเป็นแผนงานพร้อมประเมินต้นทุน ความเสี่ยง และผลตอบแทน
— ออกแบบกระบวนการใหม่ให้ชัดว่าอะไรให้คนทำ อะไรให้ AI ทำ และจุดตรวจสอบโดยมนุษย์อยู่ตรงไหน พร้อมเลือกเครื่องมือให้เหมาะกับงาน โดยคำนึงถึงต้นทุนและความปลอดภัยของข้อมูลลูกค้า
— บริหารการนำไปใช้แบบโครงการ ตั้งแต่กำหนดขอบเขต ทดลองนำร่อง วัดผล จนขยายผลได้จริง
— ลงมือทำส่วนที่ไม่ต้องเขียนโค้ดด้วยตนเอง เช่น การออกแบบ Prompt และคลัง Prompt ขององค์กร ระบบอัตโนมัติ ฐานความรู้ Dashboard
— ร่วมออกแบบผลิตภัณฑ์และบริการที่ขับเคลื่อนด้วย AI และข้อมูล โดยแปลงความต้องการของลูกค้าองค์กรให้เป็นข้อกำหนดที่ทีมพัฒนานำไปสร้างได้จริง และตรวจสอบว่าผลลัพธ์ที่ส่งออกไป “อธิบายที่มาได้”
— อบรมและโค้ชผู้ใช้งาน พร้อมเขียนข้อเสนอและเอกสารประกอบการตัดสินใจที่กระชับ ชัดเจน สำหรับผู้บริหารและลูกค้า

คุณสมบัติ
— การศึกษา: ปริญญาตรีสาขาใดก็ได้ — บริหารธุรกิจ วิศวกรรมศาสตร์ ไอที เศรษฐศาสตร์ นิติศาสตร์ วิทยาศาสตร์ ยินดีรับพิจารณาทั้งหมด
— ประสบการณ์ 2–5 ปี: ในสายที่ปรึกษา Business Analyst, Project Management, Digital/Product, Marketing Operations หรือสายเทคนิค (ผู้ที่มีประสบการณ์ตั้งแต่ 1 ปี แต่มีผลงานด้าน AI ที่จับต้องได้ พิจารณาเป็นกรณีพิเศษ)
— ภาษาอังกฤษดี: อ่านเอกสารเชิงเทคนิคและเชิงธุรกิจได้ เขียนอีเมลและรายงานได้ชัดเจน และเข้าประชุมกับลูกค้าหรือพันธมิตรต่างชาติได้ ไม่ต้องคล่องระดับเจ้าของภาษา แต่ต้องกล้าใช้และสื่อสารรู้เรื่อง
— ใช้เครื่องมือ AI ทั่วไปได้คล่อง: เช่น ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini, NotebookLM, Microsoft Copilot, เครื่องมือสร้างงานนำเสนอด้วย AI (Gamma, Canva) และเครื่องมือ Automation หรือ No-code อย่างน้อย 1 ตัว (Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Power Automate หรือ Google Apps Script)
— พื้นฐานดิจิทัลแน่น: Excel / Google Sheets (PivotTable, VLOOKUP หรือ XLOOKUP, การคำนวณเชิงโมเดลเบื้องต้น), Google Workspace หรือ Microsoft 365 และเครื่องมือบริหารงานอย่าง ClickUp, Notion, Asana หรือ Jira

คุณสมบัติเพิ่มเติมที่จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ
— Python หรือ SQL พื้นฐาน หรือมีความตั้งใจจะเรียนรู้
— เข้าใจแนวคิด RAG, Embeddings, AI Agent หรือการเชื่อมต่อ API ในระดับหลักการ
— ประสบการณ์งานที่ปรึกษา หรืองานส่งมอบที่ต้องทำงานกับลูกค้าโดยตรง
— เขียนภาษาไทยและอังกฤษได้ดีทั้งสองภาษาในระดับธุรกิจ

ส่งประวัติย่อ (CV) พร้อมข้อเขียนไม่เกิน 1 หน้า (ภาษาไทยหรืออังกฤษ) ตอบคำถามเดียวนี้:
“เล่ากระบวนการทำงานหนึ่งอย่างที่คุณปรับปรุงด้วยเครื่องมือ AI — เดิมช้าหรือมีปัญหาอย่างไร คุณสร้างอะไรขึ้นมา และผลลัพธ์เปลี่ยนไปเท่าไรเป็นตัวเลข”
(ส่งมาที่ e-mail: ••••@idgthailand.com )

IDG is upgrading how the whole organisation works with AI, and evolving our advisory services to match what corporate clients now expect. We are looking for someone who sits between the business problem and the technology.
You will take a brief from leadership or a client, turn it into a workable AI solution design, and then make it happen with cross-functional teams — internally and on client engagements.
This is not a research role and not a pure engineering role. It is a “make AI actually work, and prove it” role.

What you will do
— Map how teams and clients actually work, find where AI creates real gains in time or revenue, and turn that into a prioritised plan with cost, risk and expected return.
— Design the new workflow — what humans do, what AI does, where the human check sits — and select the right tools for the job, with cost and client-data security as first-order constraints.
— Run implementation as a project: scope, pilot, measure, then scale what works.
— Build the no-code layer yourself: prompts and the company prompt library, automations, knowledge bases, dashboards and SOPs.
— Help shape AI- and data-driven products and services by translating client requirements into specifications a development team can build, and checking that every output can be traced and explained.
— Train and coach users, and write clear, concise proposals and decision papers for management and clients.

Must-have qualifications
— Education: bachelor's degree in any field — business, engineering, IT, economics, law or science are all welcome.
— 2–5 years' experience: in consulting, business analysis, project management, digital/product, marketing operations or a technical role. Candidates with 1+ year and a demonstrable AI portfolio will be considered.
— Good English: able to read technical and business documents, write clear emails and reports, and hold your own in a meeting with a foreign client or partner. Native fluency is not required — working confidence is.
— Fluent with everyday AI tools: e.g. ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini, NotebookLM, Microsoft Copilot, AI presentation and design tools (Gamma, Canva), and at least one automation or no-code tool (Zapier, Make, n8n, Airtable, Power Automate or Google Apps Script).
— Solid digital fundamentals: Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, basic modelling), Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and a work management tool such as ClickUp, Notion, Asana or Jira.

Nice to have
— Basic Python or SQL, or the willingness to learn.
— Conceptual understanding of RAG, embeddings, AI agents or API integration.
— Consulting or client-facing delivery experience.
— Business-standard writing in both Thai and English.
— Any AI certificate or self-taught portfolio — personal projects count, please show them to us.
How to apply
Send your CV plus a note of no more than one page (Thai or English) answering one question:
“Describe one process you improved using an AI tool — what was slow or broken before, what you built, and what changed in numbers.”
( sent e-mail: ••••@idgthailand.com )

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
The AI Engineer is responsible for developing, deploying, and maintaining production-grade AI/ML systems that deliver measurable business value. The role involves building modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions alongside developing traditional statistical and machine learning models. Working closely with the Data team, the AI Engineer leverages the company's enterprise data platform to source, prepare, and embed high-quality data. The position emphasizes hands-on engineering, continuous learning, and a practical problem-solving mindset. It involves selecting the most appropriate methodology for each task and turning applied prototypes into dependable, scalable, and cost-efficient production services.
Major Responsibility
• Build and Optimize Modern AI Applications: Design and deploy a range of LLM-powered solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, natural-language data querying, tool-using and function-calling workflows, and other Generative AI applications, to deliver accurate, grounded, and citable responses.

• Develop Statistical and Machine Learning Models: Develop, deploy, and maintain traditional statistical models and machine learning algorithms (e.g., regression, classification, clustering) to solve structured data problems and complement broader AI initiatives.

• Collaborate with the Data Team: Work together on data preprocessing, embedding generation, and pipeline integration, leveraging the AWS enterprise data platform to supply clean, well-governed data for AI workloads.

• Optimize and Harden Production Services: Improve production AI services for reliability, scalability, latency, and cost, document solutions clearly, and communicate outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Monitor and Observe Production AI: Implement tracing, observability, and dashboards to track quality, latency, drift, and cost-per-task across the model lifecycle.

• Ensure AI Ethical Standards, Compliance, and Data Privacy: Apply input/output guardrails, PII redaction, access controls, and grounding safeguards, in alignment with internal data governance policies and emerging AI regulations.

• Mitigate AI-Assisted Development Risks: Critically evaluate and audit AI-generated code to prevent security vulnerabilities, logic flaws, and technical debt, ensuring deep technical understanding rather than over-reliance on automated code generation.

• Monitor and Observe Production AI: Implement tracing, observability, and dashboards to track quality, latency, drift, and cost-per-task across the model lifecycle.

• Ensure AI Ethical Standards, Compliance, and Data Privacy: Apply input/output guardrails, PII redaction, access controls, and grounding safeguards, in alignment with internal data governance policies and emerging AI regulations.

• Mitigate AI-Assisted Development Risks: Critically evaluate and audit AI-generated code to prevent security vulnerabilities, logic flaws, and technical debt, ensuring deep technical understanding rather than over-reliance on automated code generation.

Education Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

Professional Experience:
• 1 to 4 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, or an equivalent record of strong personal projects, research, or internships building applied AI/LLM solutions.

Technical Skillset:
• Programming: Strong proficiency in Python for building AI/ML applications, including working with LLM APIs/SDKs and common AI libraries, as well as practical experience in data manipulation (e.g., using Pandas or SQL to clean and prepare data).

• LLM Development: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompt design, tool/function calling, and connecting models to external data and tools.

• Retrieval & Vector Databases: Familiarity with vector databases, embedding models, and chunking/retrieval strategies (such as semantic chunking, hybrid search, and reranking).

• Statistical Modeling & Machine Learning: Solid foundation in applied statistics, probability, and classical machine learning techniques. Proven ability to evaluate trade-offs and select the optimal modeling approach for specific business objectives.

• Cloud Computing: Experience with cloud platforms. AWS is the primary ecosystem for deploying and serving AI workloads, while familiarity with GCP or Azure is a welcome advantage.

• Engineering & LLMOps: Familiarity with version control (Git) and an awareness of general MLOps/LLMOps concepts (such as basic model testing, tracking performance, or managing prompts).

jobs.description:
About the job
🚀 We are seeking to expand our AI Innovation and Center of Excellence Team and are looking for: AI Engineers

About the Job:
XPONENTIAL is the innovation arm of the Siam Piwat Group, located right next to the Siam BTS in Bangkok. We're the masterminds behind the ONESIAM SUPERAPP and are on a mission to build a kick-ass AI driven SaaS platform that will revolutionize the digital landscape for consumers and business partners, with our office directly at Siam BTS.

What We Need:
We are seeking an AI Engineer to help shape and accelerate our AI-driven future. This role is part of the AI Center of Excellence, driving the nucleus of the Groups shift to AI, within a startup and execution focused environment. Focus on AI, Agentic, and the framework driving both , to reinvent Siam Piwat Group and our Shopping Centers.

You will be a hands-on technical leader, exploring and implementing cutting-edge AI technologies while building scalable , AI-powered platforms including AI applications, Analytics, Targeting, Ad generation, but also operations improvements, etc . From designing AI-enabled data pipelines to applying large language models to real business problems, you will be a key driver in turning data and AI innovation into measurable outcomes.

What You'll Do:
• Build & Apply AI Solutions: Explore, prototype, and implement AI (LLMs) solutions using Google Vertex AI (Gemini) and other leading open-source AI frameworks tailored to real business use cases.

• Engineer Self-Improving Agentic Systems: Design and build autonomous, self-improving Agentic AI workflows using modern SDKs and frameworks, incorporating architectural guardrails and feedback loops to ensure safety, reliability, and continuous learning in production.

• Engineer for Production: Design and develop robust AI, Agentic, and Data solutions using Python, Java, or similar languages, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

• Translate Business to Technology: Partner closely with Product Owners to convert complex business challenges into effective AI-powered technical solutions.

• Advance the AI Innovation: Continuously research emerging AI, ML, and AI technologies, assessing their potential value and driving adoption where it creates competitive advantage.

• Build AI-powered Data Platforms: Design and maintain an AI-powered marketing platform by integrating behavioral data from multiple sources (e.g., Snowplow), managing data warehouses on BigQuery, and ensuring data quality and integrity

Your Qualifications:
• Strong Engineering Foundation: Solid programming experience in Python, Java, or similar languages, with strong proficiency in SQL.

• AI & ML Expertise: A strong background in traditional AI and machine learning, with hands-on experience using Generative AI frameworks and libraries demonstrated by building production-grade AI systems in real-world business environments.

• Agentic Frameworks & Architecture: Proven expertise in building self-improving Agentic AI systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI), with a strong grasp of implementing architectural guardrails and safety layers for complex enterprise tasks.

• Cloud Experience: Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure.

• Problem Solver: Proven ability to break down complex business problems and design practical, scalable technical solutions.

• Communication Skills : Ability to clearly articulate ideas and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Nice to Have:

• Experience with data warehousing and data pipeline development and large-scale data processing (BigQuery experience is a strong plus)

• Experience with containerization tools such as Docker

• Knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform

What We Offer:
• An empowered environment where you can shape your role, make a direct impact on our platform, and help build our culture.

• The opportunity to build a world-class operations function from the ground up for a leading SuperApp.

• A "Work as One" team spirit with the stability and backing of a major industry leader, Siam Piwat Group

Are You The One?
If you're excited to be part of something groundbreaking, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and believe you fit the bill, let's join forces. Help us build the next big thing in SaaS at Xponential.

jobs.description:
เรากำลังมองหา AI Engineer รุ่นใหม่ ที่สนใจเทคโนโลยี Sensor + AI + Cloud + Sensory
คุณจะมีบทบาทสำคัญในการพัฒนา Sensory AI Techhnology - New Data Later for AI
การออกแบบ พัฒนา และนำระบบปัญญาประดิษฐ์ (AI) และ Machine Learning (ML) ไปประยุกต์ใช้กับผลิตภัณฑ์และกระบวนการทางธุรกิจ โดยทำงานร่วมกับทีม Data Science, Software Engineering และ Product เพื่อสร้าง AI Solutions ที่มีคุณภาพ ปรับขนาดได้ และตอบโจทย์ความต้องการขององค์กร

• ความรับผิดชอบหลัก (Key Responsibilities):

1.1 การพัฒนาโมเดล AI / ML
● ออกแบบ พัฒนา และทดสอบโมเดล Machine Learning และ Deep Learning สำหรับ Use Cases ต่างๆ ขององค์กร
● ทำ Feature Engineering และ Data Preprocessing สำหรับ Training Pipeline
● ประเมินประสิทธิภาพโมเดลด้วย Metrics ที่เหมาะสม และปรับปรุงโมเดลอย่างต่อเนื่อง
1.2 MLOps และ Deployment
● สร้างและดูแล ML Pipeline ตั้งแต่ Data Ingestion จนถึง Model Serving
● Deploy โมเดลบน Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) ผ่าน Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
● ติดตามประสิทธิภาพโมเดลใน Production และจัดการ Model Drift
● ออกแบบและดูแลระบบ CI/CD สำหรับ AI/ML Workflow
● พัฒนา Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) System และ AI Agent
● ทดลองและนำเทคโนโลยี AI ใหม่ๆ มาประยุกต์ใช้
1.3 การทำงานร่วมกับทีม
● ทำงานร่วมกับ Data Scientists เพื่อ Operationalize โมเดลที่ผ่านการวิจัย
● ประสานงานกับ Backend / Frontend Engineers
● จัดทำเอกสารทางเทคนิค (Technical Documentation) และแชร์ความรู้ภายในทีม

• คุณสมบัติผู้สมัคร (Qualifications):

2.1 การศึกษาและประสบการณ์
● ปริญญาตรีขึ้นไปในสาขาวิทยาการคอมพิวเตอร์, วิศวกรรมซอฟต์แวร์, วิทยาศาสตร์ข้อมูล หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง
● ประสบการณ์ทำงานด้าน AI/ML Engineering 2-5 ปี ขึ้นไป
● มีประสบการณ์ Deploy โมเดลใน Production Environment จริง
2.2 ทักษะด้านเทคนิค (Technical Skills)
● Python เป็นหลัก รวมถึง Libraries เช่น PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, Scikit-learn
● ความเข้าใจใน ML Algorithms ทั้ง Classical และ Deep Learning
● ความรู้ด้าน MLOps Tools
● มีความรู้ด้าน Cloud Platform
● มีความรู้เรื่อง Infrastructure และ Database เช่น SQL, Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI / Flask เป็นต้น
● ความเข้าใจด้าน Data Engineering เป็นอย่างดี
2.3 คุณสมบัติส่วนบุคคล:
• มีทักษะในการแก้ปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าได้ดี และพร้อมเรียนรู้เทคโนโลยีใหม่ๆ

• ทำงานร่วมกันเป็นทีม

สิ่งที่คุณจะได้ (Why Join Us):
• ได้ทำงานกับ Deep Tech จริง (AI + Sensor + IoT)

• ได้เห็นระบบที่คุณทำ ถูกใช้งานจริงในโรงงาน / Smart City

• ได้เรียนรู้ทั้ง Hardware + Software + AI Integration

• โอกาสเติบโตเร็วในบริษัทเทคโนโลยีระดับสากล

jobs.title: AI Engineer Manager
jobs.description:
Responsibilities
Generative AI & LLM Engineering
• Design, develop, and fine-tune Generative AI solutions using leading LLMs such as GPT-4o, Claude (Anthropic), Gemini, and open-source models (LLaMA, Mistral, etc.)

• Build and maintain End-to-End AI Chatbot systems — from prompt engineering and LLM integration to deployment and monitoring

• Develop production-grade RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Chatbot pipelines integrating vector search, document chunking, embedding models, and LLM inference

• Implement and manage Vector Storage solutions using FAISS, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or similar technologies for semantic search and knowledge retrieval

• Design and deploy Agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom multi-agent orchestration workflows

• Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise APIs, databases, and internal platforms via LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent tooling

• Stay current with rapidly evolving AI/ML tools including Hugging Face, Ollama, vLLM, OpenAI APIs, Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, and Azure OpenAI Service

AI Product Development & MLOps
• Own the end-to-end AI product lifecycle: requirements gathering, model selection, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement

• Build and manage scalable AI inference pipelines with performance monitoring, logging, and cost optimization

• Design prompt engineering strategies, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails for safe and reliable LLM outputs

• Implement CI/CD workflows for AI models using MLflow, DVC, or similar MLOps tools

• Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to productionize machine learning and AI models

• Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into business workflows, automation, and decision-making processes

Data Engineering & Platform (Foundational Awareness)
• Understand the fundamentals of data pipeline concepts (ETL/ELT, batch and streaming) to effectively collaborate with Data Engineering teams

• Able to read, query, and work with data from common platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or PostgreSQL

• Understand data flow from source systems to data warehouses/lakehouses to inform AI model inputs and outputs

• Familiar with vector database concepts and embedding pipelines sufficient to configure and use them in AI projects

• Capable of communicating data requirements clearly to Data Engineers when building AI features or knowledge bases

Collaboration & Innovation
• Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, and engineers to translate business requirements into AI solutions

• Contribute to and promote best practices for AI development, testing, documentation, and responsible AI usage

• Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge on emerging AI tools, frameworks, and research

• Evaluate and adopt new AI/ML technologies and frameworks to keep the team at the forefront of innovation

• Effectively manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality solutions independently and as part of a team

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering with a focus on Generative AI and NLP applications

• Proven experience building Generative AI solutions using GPT-4o, Claude (Anthropic), Gemini, or equivalent LLMs — this is a must

• Hands-on experience with RAG Chatbot development: embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, and LLM response generation

• Proficiency in Vector Storage technologies such as FAISS, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or ChromaDB

• Experience building End-to-End Chatbot systems including intent handling, context management, multi-turn dialogue, and API integration

• Practical knowledge of Agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) for building multi-step, tool-using AI agents

• Strong Python programming skills — Python (required), SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript (a plus)

• Familiarity with popular AI/ML tools and platforms: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, Ollama, vLLM, OpenAI SDK, Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI

• Experience with prompt engineering techniques including few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought, structured output, and function calling

• Ability to evaluate LLM outputs using metrics and frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens, or custom eval pipelines)

• AI Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Hugging Face Transformers

• LLM Platforms: OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA, Mistral

• Vector Databases: FAISS, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, ChromaDB

• Cloud & Data: AWS / GCP / Azure AI services, Databricks, Snowflake, PostgreSQL

• MLOps: MLflow, DVC, Docker, Kubernetes (a plus)

• Big Data: Apache Spark, Kafka (a plus)

• Experience in Retail or E-Commerce AI applications (e.g., recommendation engines, pricing AI, conversational commerce)

• Familiarity with fine-tuning and PEFT techniques (LoRA, QLoRA) for LLMs
• Knowledge in machine/statistical learning, computer vision, or time series forecasting
• Experience with AI safety, hallucination mitigation, and responsible AI practices
• Contributions to open-source AI projects or published AI research

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Overview
This role serves as a bridge between the development team and the executive management. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing AI and Machine Learning technologies into the organization's core systems and workflows.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can write production-ready code, understands software architecture, and possesses the communication skills to translate the business value of AI to help executives make data-driven decisions.
Responsibilities
Technical & Development
• Design, develop, and integrate AI, LLM, and Machine Learning features into organizational systems and products.

• Build and maintain stable, scalable APIs , data pipelines, and AI workflows.

• Develop prototypes and Proof of Concepts (POCs) to validate the feasibility of new use cases before moving to production.

• Deliver high-quality code , participate in code reviews, and help establish coding standards within the development team.

• Evaluate and select appropriate AI tools, models, and frameworks based on project requirements and budget.

AI Integration & Adoption
• Identify opportunities and use cases where AI can drive efficiency or reduce operational costs across various departments.

• Collaborate with executives to map out the AI roadmap , prioritizing projects based on business impact.

• Conduct training sessions and provide guidance to internal teams on how to use AI tools safely and effectively.

• Stay updated on emerging AI trends and evaluate their suitability for adoption within the organization.

• Establish guidelines for data security, privacy, and ethical AI usage (AI Governance).

Collaboration & Communication
• Partner with management to translate high-level business goals into actionable, technical requirements.

• Present project updates, results, and ROI of AI initiatives to executives in clear, non-technical language.

• Act as the primary liaison between the development team, business units, and other key stakeholders.

Qualifications
• Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in software development, AI, or Data-related roles.

• Programming Skills: Proficient in at least one core language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or Java.

• Database Knowledge: Solid understanding of both SQL and NoSQL databases, including experience with Vector Databases.

• Language Proficiency: Excellent communication skills in Thai, with the ability to fluently read and understand English technical documentation.

Soft Skills
• Strong analytical and systematic problem-solving skills.

• Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to work collaboratively in team environments and manage cross-departmental coordination.

• High learning agility, self-motivated, and adaptable to rapidly changing technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full-stack, AI-Native)
jobs.description:
At Simplesat, we help support teams collect customer feedback and actually do something with it. We're lean, profitable, and obsessed with making our survey product simple, useful, and just a little bit adorable
We're now looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full-stack, AI-Native) in Bangkok. Here's the fun part: AI does most of the typing now, so this role isn't about racing a robot to the keyboard. It's about being the human who tells the agent where to go, checks its homework, and makes sure what ships is correct, safe, and actually lovely to use.
🧡 Why you might love this role
• Work on a real product used daily by real customers around the world

• Own features end-to-end with AI agents (hi, Claude Code 👋) — schema, APIs, UI, tests, the whole nest 🪹

• Help shape how we build with AI, not just “take tickets”

• Turn the agent's recurring oopsies into reusable tooling, so the same mistake never bites us twice

• Join a small, friendly, slightly weird team where your ideas actually matter

🧠 Why Simplesat is interesting (for engineers)
• Build where it matters — the core product powering surveys, responses, analytics, and dashboards customers rely on every day

• Grow through real scale — real-time surveys for millions of responses , with instant syncing, reliable global delivery, and dashboards that stay fast and clear

• Learn from complexity — 75+ integrations , each one teaching you something about data flow, failure modes, and resilience

• Play on the AI frontier — we're actively reshaping how we build with AI, and you'll have outsized influence on what “good” looks like here

• Build for the future — clean, scalable architecture so we keep shipping quickly without painting ourselves into a corner

🧩 What you'll be doing
• Designing & building features end-to-end across our stack, directing AI agents to produce a PR you'd happily merge

• Making AI output trustworthy with unit + E2E automation and self-validating loops, so the team approves with confidence instead of squinting at every line

• Refactoring toward simplicity — retiring dead code, collapsing duplicate patterns, keeping things legible for both humans and AI

• Making sharp technical calls on architecture, performance, and trade-offs, and knowing which doors only open one way

• Sharing knowledge and raising the bar with your teammates

🌈 What we value in engineers
• Judgment over keystrokes — knowing what's right to ship, not just how to make it run

• Calibrated trust in AI — you use it hard, and you know exactly where not to

• Ownership over the tasks and projects you commit to

• Autonomy with accountability — you don't need hand-holding, but you keep the team in the loop

• Curiosity and continuous learning , with a bit of healthy weirdness

🛠 Our current toy box
AI-assisted tooling (Claude Code) • React • Python • Django Web APIs • PostgreSQL • Redis • AWS • OAuth • Webhooks • GitHub • Notion • Slack • Figma
This is not a strict checklist. Curiosity and learning speed matter more than ticking every box.
🎯 A bit about you
• Based in Bangkok and comfortable in English (spoken + written)

• 5+ years building and shipping web applications, strong JavaScript and modern web fundamentals

• AI is already how you build — you've shipped real production work this way, not just experimented

• You validate by testing, not by trusting — unit and frontend E2E automation are part of how you deliver

• A real refactoring track record, reducing complexity in a live, messy codebase

• Comfortable building and consuming REST APIs , and you've written optimized SQL and handled concurrent writes in higher-traffic systems

• You can collaborate with product and design and explain your trade-offs without drama

Experience designing reusable AI context, skills, or guardrails for a team is a lovely bonus.
🎁 Benefits & perks
• 13th-month bonus

• Yearly tuition allowance to keep learning

• Flex day system

• Yearly offsite outing outside Bangkok

• Flexible remote work (with hybrid / in-office collaboration)

• A down-to-earth team, real product ownership, and no corporate nonsense

💰 Compensation
Competitive and negotiable, based on your experience and the impact you can bring.
How to apply
Apply via this link : https://simplesat.notion.site/Senior-Software-Engineer-Full-stack-AI-Native-e7409f6d1b854f71b8fe28d09b619e7b
And tell us one quick story: a time an AI agent failed you on real work — what broke, and what you changed so it never happened again. That tells us more than any CV ever could.
If you're reading this and thinking, “This sounds like my kind of weird,” we'd really love to hear from you

jobs.title: AI/Machine Learning Engineer (Motion AI)
jobs.description:
Imagine being responsible for driving operational efficiency through the development of AI solutions for time capturing and motion detection for the world’s largest jewellery brand. If you love collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and delivering measurable business impact, then you might be our next Specialist, Motion AI at Pandora Crafting & Supply.

We love that you will…
• AI Solution Development (Motion Capture & MTM):
• Lead the end-to-end development of an AI-driven motion capture solution based on Methods-Time Measurement (MTM) principles

• Design and implement computer vision models to track and analyze hand and body movements from production videos

• Develop algorithms to calculate Actual Time and derive Standard Time using motion-based data

• Build and optimize machine learning models to classify motion patterns and detect inefficiencies

• Develop and maintain a standardized Pandora Motion Library Code, translating motion patterns into reusable MTM-based codes for analysis , benchmarking, and scalability

• Ensure the solution is scalable and adaptable to both existing products and new product designs with increasing complexity

• Data Management & Processing
• Transform unstructured data (video, images, manual time study) into structured datasets for analysis

• Develop feature engineering pipelines to convert motion data (e.g., coordinates, velocity, trajectory) into model-ready inputs

• Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across multiple systems

• Continuously monitor data drift and model input quality to maintain performance across new products and increasing complexity

• Vendor & Co-Development Management
• Co-develop AI solutions with external vendors/partners, including defining requirements and reviewing deliverables

• Act as the main technical counterpart to outsourced teams to ensure solution quality and scalability

• Ensure knowledge transfer and long-term maintainability of the developed system

• Monitor vendor performance to ensure timelines and expected outcomes are achieved

• Cross-Functional Collaboration:
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key non-technical standard time stakeholders (e.g. Plant level PEx, Production, PD, etc.) to understand business needs

• Translate complex AI outputs and facilitate effective communication channels across teams to ensure timely and accurate information flow, enabling informed decision-making

• Drive alignment between technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure successful adoption

• Influence and guide cross-functional discussions to align on standard time processes, challenge assumptions, and promote best practices.

• Process Improvement & Business Impact
• Analyze movement patterns to identify best practices and improve operational efficiency

• Identify opportunities to reduce cycle time and minimize rework

• Deliver data-driven recommendations to enhance production performance

• Ensure applicability of insights across diverse product types and future design iterations

• Performance Measurement & Governance
• Define KPIs and success metrics (e.g., efficiency improvement, time reduction, rework reduction)

• Track and evaluate the performance and impact of the AI solution

• Ensure compliance with data governance and company standards

• Business–Technical Bridge
• Lead business requirement analysis by translating complex business pain points into actionable data and AI strategies, driving alignment between business objectives and technical solutions.

• Influence stakeholder communication by clarifying IT and Data Science concepts for business teams, guiding informed decision-making, and challenging assumptions when needed.

• Evaluate and translate AI/DS use cases, assessing feasibility, impact, and applicability across business contexts to support strategic initiatives.

• Mentor and advise junior staff on bridging business and technical requirements, fostering knowledge sharing and professional growth.

• Technology Utilization:
• Proactively monitor emerging technologies and AI tools in time management to identify opportunities for operational improvement.

• Assess, recommend, and lead the adoption of technology and AI-powered solutions that enhance accuracy, streamline processes, and drive measurable business outcomes.

• Direct initiatives to integrate AI and digital tools into standard practices, improving forecasting, data reliability, and operational efficiency across teams.

• Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure system compatibility, oversee implementation success, and monitor ongoing performance of technology solutions.

• Influence cross-functional teams by sharing insights, best practices, and strategic recommendations for technology adoption, promoting continuous improvement and innovation.

• AI Adoption & Implementation
• Support change management by facilitating the integration of AI solutions into existing business processes and workflows. Lead proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives by executing AI and Data Science prototypes, demonstrating tangible business value, and informing strategic decisions.

• Design comprehensive test scenarios and oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), gathering actionable feedback to refine AI solutions for business adoption.

• Champion change management efforts, driving the integration of AI solutions into existing business workflows while ensuring alignment, compliance, and operational efficiency.

• Provide guidance and mentorship to team members on AI adoption, testing methodologies, and best practices, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

• Training and Support:
• Provide training and guidance to team members on time tracking systems and data entry procedures.

• Address inquiries and guide to ensure consistent and accurate data input.

• Supports Senior Manager, Standard time for an ad hoc standard time and relevant activities

We love that you are…
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Industrial Engineering , or a related field.

• Minimum of 2-5 years’ experience in AI/ML, computer vision , data science, or advanced analytics, preferably within manufacturing or industrial environments.

• Proven experience in AI solution development , including motion capture, computer vision, and machine learning model deployment

• Strong expertise in computer vision techniques (e.g., pose estimation, object tracking, video analytics) and frameworks such as OpenCV, TensorFlow, or PyTorch .

• Solid experience in time study methodologies (e.g., MTM, motion analysis , industrial engineering concepts) is highly preferred

• Hands-on experience in data engineering and feature engineering, transforming unstructured data (video/images) into structured, model-ready datasets

• Strong proficiency in Python, VSCode SQL, and data processing pipelines; experience with cloud platforms i.e. Azure is an advantage

• Demonstrated experience in building scalable AI/ML solutions and monitoring model performance (e.g., data drift, model accuracy)

• Experience working with external vendors or offshore development teams, including requirement definition, delivery validation, and performance management

• Strong ability to bridge business and technical teams, translating complex AI concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders

• Experience in process improvement and operational analytics, delivering measurable business impact (e.g., efficiency gains, cycle time reduction)

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines with a solution-oriented mindset

• Strong sense of accountability, with the ability to work independently and manage stakeholders effectively

• Good command of Thai and English

Welcome to our Crafting & Supply
The magic happens at our crafting facilities, where we combine centuries-old crafting traditions and high-quality materials with modern production techniques. You will be warmly greeted with over 13,000 craftspeople who are excellent at crafting and supplying the world’s largest jewellery brand with our craftsmanship. You will be part of a team of Standard Time & Industrialization Data Governance and report to the Senior Manager, Standard Time & Industrialization Data Governance.

Join a team that is as diverse and inclusive as our jewellery. We believe and value creative thinking and ensure that there’s equitable opportunities for all.

• Foster your growth and craft opportunities through our learning and development programmes.

• At Pandora, no effort or contribution goes unnoticed. We offer a wide range of opportunities and benefits to ensure that our employees feel valued, supported, and cared for.

• Transportation services are also available to drop you at the closet BTS station and other community areas.

About Pandora Crafting & Supply
Pandora started crafting its jewellery in Thailand in 1989, where our founders fell in love with the delicate craftsmanship of the Thai people. To date, there are two crafting facilities in Thailand, Bangkok, and Lamphun, and we employ more than 13,000 skilled craftspeople. By the end of 2024, there are 113 million pieces sold globally, all of which were hand-finished here in Thailand by our skilled craftspeople using high-quality raw materials and sustainable methods.

About Pandora Group
Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand. Designed in Denmark and crafted in Thailand, Pandora jewellery provides endless opportunities for personalisation, allowing people to express their passions and show who they are. The company’s products are made from high-quality materials and sold in more than 100 countries through 6,785 points of sale, including 2,788 concept stores.
Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and is sourcing lab-grown stones and recycled silver and gold for all its jewellery. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs 37,000 people worldwide, is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange, and generated sales of DKK 31.7 billion (EUR 4.25 billion) in 2024.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
คุณคือ คนกลางที่เชื่อม "เทคโนโลยี AI" เข้ากับ "โจทย์ธุรกิจจริง" เข้าใจ pain point ขององค์กร แล้วมาออกแบบ พัฒนา และ deploy ระบบ AI Agent / AI Automation ไปแก้ปัญหาให้ใช้งานได้จริง ตั้งแต่ prototype จนขึ้น production เอง (end-to-end ownership)
ลักษณะงานที่รับผิดชอบ
• ทำงานร่วมกับหัวหน้าทีมทุก unit เพื่อเก็บ pain point แล้วแปลงเป็น requirement / โจทย์ที่ scope ได้และแก้ได้จริง

• ออกแบบและพัฒนา workflow / automation ด้วย AI Agent เลือก tech stack และเครื่องมือให้เหมาะกับงาน

• ลงมือ build → test → iterate → deploy ส่งมอบ solution ที่ทีมใช้งานได้จริง ไม่ใช่แค่ demo

• ทำ system / data integration เชื่อมระบบ ข้อมูล และเครื่องมือภายในเข้าด้วยกัน (API, webhook, MCP, connectors)

• เป็น technical advisor ให้หัวหน้าแต่ละ unit ที่อยากพัฒนา workflow ของตัวเอง

• วัดผลเชิง impact (เวลา / ต้นทุนที่ประหยัดได้) แล้ววนกลับมา optimize ต่อเนื่อง

• ถ่ายทอด / เทรนทีมให้ใช้ระบบและ workflow ใหม่เป็น (enablement)

คุณสมบัติ
• จบการศึกษาในระดับปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป อายุไม่เกิน 35 ปี

• ใช้ AI Agent / LLM tools ได้คล่อง (เช่น Hermes, Manus, Claude, Codex ฯลฯ)

• เคยใช้ AI Agent / AI Automation สร้างหรือทำ โปรเจกต์ที่มีคนใช้จริง (production) และโดยต้องมีส่วนร่วมตั้งแต่ต้นกระบวนการจนส่งมอบ

• Workflow / systems thinking — มองออกว่าจะ decompose งานเป็นขั้น ๆ ยังไง และออกแบบให้ AI Agent ทำงานต่อกันเป็น pipeline จนจบเองได้

• มีทักษะการสื่อสารกับ User ฝั่ง Business แล้วแปลงเป็น technical solution ได้ (requirement → design → delivery)

• เข้าใจในงาน AI และ Business เชิงลึก ไม่ใช่แค่ต่อ tool ตามทำ tutorial แต่เข้าใจว่าทำไมถึงออกแบบระบบแบบนั้น รู้ trade-off และ debug / ปรับจูนเองได้เมื่อของพัง

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Innovation - BBL)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a passionate and innovative AI Research Engineer to join our team in advancing the frontiers of Artificial Intelligence. This role focuses on research and development of new AI models in areas such as computer vision, natural language processing, and voice technologies . You will explore cutting-edge techniques in Machine Learning (ML), Deep Learning (DL), and Generative AI (GenAI), contributing to breakthroughs that shape the future of intelligent systems.

Responsibilities
· Conduct research and experimentation to design novel AI models in computer vision, language modeling, and voice technologies.
· Explore and develop new architectures in ML, DL, and GenAI, including transformers, diffusion models, and multimodal systems.
· Investigate and optimize training strategies for large-scale models, including data augmentation, self-supervised learning, and reinforcement learning.
· Collaborate with research scientists, data engineers, and product teams to translate theoretical advances into practical prototypes.
· Publish findings, contribute to patents, and stay at the forefront of academic and industrial AI research.
· Evaluate emerging AI frameworks and orchestration tools (such as LangChain, LangGraph, Crew.ai, OpenAI Agent SDK) for applications.
· Build experimental pipelines to validate hypotheses and benchmark models against state-of-the-art baselines.
· Contribute to the development of scalable infrastructure for training and evaluating large models.

Requirements
· Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a research-oriented mindset.
· Excellent communication skills to present complex ideas clearly and collaborate across disciplines.
· Solid foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and generative modeling techniques.
· Experience in designing and training advanced architectures (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, GANs, diffusion models).
· Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow.
· Familiarity with large-scale training environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed computing.
· Knowledge of data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark) is a plus.
· Hands-on experience with experimental design, quantitative research, and benchmarking AI models.
· Exposure to CI/CD workflows for research pipelines is advantageous.
· A track record of publications, open-source contributions, or patents in AI research is highly desirable.

Location: Bangkok Bank, Head Office, Silom
Contact Person: พี่นุ่มนิ่ม HR 02 ••• ••••, 063 403 5669

jobs.title: Data Analytics & AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
The Solution Architect – Data Analytics & AI is responsible for designing end-to-end data and AI solutions that are scalable, secure, and commercially viable for customers in Thailand. The role partners closely with Sales, Project/Delivery teams, and the Data & AI Leader to translate customer requirements into solution architectures, implementation approaches, and technical proposals.
This position provides technical leadership across pre-sales and delivery, ensuring that Fujitsu’s global platforms, reference architectures, and AI capabilities (including those from Fujitsu Japan and other regions) are effectively integrated into customer solutions and can be implemented with high delivery confidence.
The key responsibilities for this role are:
• Collaborate with Global AI SME team on Thailand AI opportunities

• Understand emerging AI technologies and collaborate with customers and service line members not only to deliver Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and MVPs, but also to develop commercially viable, scalable solutions.

• Lead architecture design for Data Analytics, Data Platform, and AI/ML solutions (from concept through production).

• Produce architecture artifacts (solution diagrams, HLD/LLD, data flow, integration specifications, security considerations).

• Active involvement in working with Fujitsu Data and AI team in setting up of the AI CoE

• Work closely with Fujitsu research laboratory on core technology IPs development and promotion.

• Work with key data platform strategic partners like Azure, Palantir, Databricks and AWS to drive technology POCs and opportunities.

• Design modern data platforms and analytics architectures (ingestion batch/streaming, lakehouse/warehouse, semantic layer, BI/analytics).

• Design AI/ML solution architecture including MLOps/LLMOps lifecycle, model deployment patterns, monitoring, and governance.

• Ensure alignment with Fujitsu and customer standards, including security architecture and compliance requirements.

Key Accountabilities
• Customer Relationships . Identify customers for MVPs and work closely with them in facilitating proof of concepts and AI solution development involving our Data & AI offerings

• Collaboration with partners . Engage with the alliance team to work with key partners on offerings/key technology

• Influence . Influence our stake holders on technology decisions involving Data & AI

• Thought leadership . Provide industry insights involving AI technology. Represent Fujitsu Thailand as a subject matter expert on AI and participate in conferences and industry events.

• Academia and Research institutes. Work with Academia and research institutes on future opportunities/ideas

• Co-creation. Facilitate and co-create solutions with customers where applicable

Key Performance Indicators
• Quality and completeness of solution architecture and proposal deliverables.

• Conversion of qualified opportunities through effective technical solutioning.

• Successful delivery outcomes: stability, performance, security, and customer satisfaction.

• Reuse and contribution to internal knowledge base, assets, and reference architectures.

• Works with sales executives to identify customers who can participate in MVPs/Proof of Concepts and early engagements for AI solution development

• Represent Fujitsu in Thailand technical events and conferences

• Share information regarding Data & AI offerings to our stake holders

• Work successfully with our customers on POCs and AI Solution Development through co-creation and/or requirements analysis

• Hands on planning and implementation of Data & AI PoC/Production environment; and solve technical challenges

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree or preferably Master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, MBA or any other related fields

• Proven track record in architecture, leading to sales, consulting and delivery outcomes

• At least 5-7 years of experience in selling or implementing Data Analytics, Business Intelligent or Data Warehouse solutions

• Data analytics related skills is a must (SQL, R or Python-Statistical Programming, data visualization, machine learning)

• Hands on experience in Databricks, Azure Data Factory/Data Lake and/or Palantir preferred.

• Machine Learning/ Deep Learning Programming knowledge plus,

• Latest knowledge on the recent AI technology trend including Vision AI, Generative AI and Agentic AI

• Extensive Technical Consulting and Advisory experience

• Capable of speaking at conferences and media events

• Strong ability to provide well-conceived, clearly articulated, pragmatic solutions and recommendations to complex infrastructure and application problems

• Contributes to the knowledge base of Fujitsu within and beyond the Partner Aligned Practices

• Ability to lead technical conversations related to AI

• Experience in developing technical architecture proposals, pricing solutions, and customer requirements gathering/engagements

• Experience in formal design either as architect or in a senior technical or consulting role

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Purpose/Overview:
The Embedded AI Engineer will focus on developing, deploying, and optimizing edge intelligence applications on high-performance onboard drone computing platforms. This role combines the knowledge between AI algorithms and hardware robots, utilizing C/C++, C#, and Python to process real-time sensor data and run computer vision models.
By leveraging developer tools and payload SDKs, we will build custom software packages to handle hardware-accelerated data communication and automated workflows. Working within an Ubuntu Linux environment, the candidate will apply the efficient model inference techniques using tools like TensorRT and CUDA to maximize onboard computing performance.
Job Responsibilities
1. Software Development
- Design and write clean code in C, C++, and Python for Linux-based ARM architectures.
- Integrate and configure physical hardware components using standard communication protocols.
2. AI & Computer Vision Integration
- Train, and optimize machine learning classifiers (such as Deep Neural Networks) to determine probabilities output based on multi-dimensional parameters
- Deploy, test, and optimize pre-trained Deep Learning models (e.g., Object Detection) on the edge.
- Leverage hardware acceleration libraries such as TensorRT, CUDA, and OpenCV to maximize the AI inference performance.
- Implement real-time video stream processing and data pipeline optimizations.

jobs.title: AI Data Analyst (Fresh Graduated are Welcomed) - (30K - 35K)
jobs.description:
About SAND-M Global:
SAND-M Global is one of Thailand's fastest-growing Consumer Health & Wellness companies, creating innovative products that make healthier living simple, enjoyable, and accessible. Our portfolio spans sleep wellness, energy, functional nutrition, hydration, and everyday wellness, serving millions of consumers through modern trade, convenience stores, e-commerce, and international markets.
At SAND-M, we believe the future of business is AI-enabled. We are building an organization where data, artificial intelligence, and human creativity work together to drive faster decisions, stronger execution, and continuous innovation.
We're looking for curious, analytical, and ambitious people who are excited to shape the future of consumer brands through data and AI.

Your Mission:
Leverage data and AI to transform business questions into actionable insights that accelerate growth across Marketing, Commercial, Sales, E-commerce, Supply Chain, Product Innovation, and Executive Management.
You will build dashboards, analyze business performance, develop AI-powered workflows, and support business teams in making faster, smarter, and more effective decisions.

Key Responsibilities:
• Collect, clean, validate, and integrate data from multiple business sources.

• Build automated dashboards and executive reports using Power BI, Looker Studio, or similar Business Intelligence tools.

• Analyze sales, marketing, customer, retail, e-commerce, operational, and financial data to identify trends, opportunities, and business risks.

• Use AI agentic tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other emerging AI platforms to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and generate actionable business insights.

• Develop AI-assisted dashboards, reports, and business intelligence solutions that improve decision-making across the organization.

• Monitor business performance and recommend actions to improve growth, efficiency, and profitability.

• Partner with Marketing, Commercial, Sales, Supply Chain, R&D, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to solve business challenges through data.

• Present insights clearly through dashboards, reports, presentations, and data storytelling.

• Continuously explore new AI technologies and recommend practical applications that improve productivity and business performance.

• Support the company's AI transformation by promoting data-driven and AI-enabled ways of working.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Marketing Analytics, Mathematics, or related fields.

• Fresh graduates are welcome.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel.

• Basic knowledge of SQL and/or Python is an advantage.

• Experience with Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar Business Intelligence tools is preferred.

• Proficient in AI agentic tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or equivalent AI platforms, with the ability to leverage AI to automate workflows, accelerate analysis, generate insights, and improve productivity.

• Able to prepare, clean, organize, and structure data from multiple sources for analysis.

• Able to develop dashboards, monitor KPIs, analyze business performance, identify growth opportunities, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

• Execution-oriented with the ability to move beyond analysis into practical business implementation.

• Passionate about Artificial Intelligence, emerging technologies, and continuous learning.

• Curious, proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to solve real business problems.

• Strong communication, presentation, and data storytelling skills.

• Good command of English.

What You Will Gain:
• Hands-on experience working directly with senior leadership.

• Exposure to real business challenges across Marketing, Sales, Commercial, Supply Chain, Product Development, and International Business.

• Opportunity to build AI-powered business solutions that create measurable business impact.

• Fast career growth in one of Thailand's fastest-growing Consumer Health & Wellness companies.

• Continuous learning in AI, Business Intelligence, Consumer Insights, Automation, and Data Analytics.

• A dynamic environment where innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement are encouraged.

Why Join SAND-M Global?
At SAND-M Global, we don't see AI as a replacement for people—we see it as a multiplier of human potential.
We are building an AI-enabled organization where talented people use data, creativity, and technology to challenge conventions and shape the future of consumer health and wellness.
If you're passionate about data, excited by AI, and want to make a real business impact from day one, we'd love to hear from you.
Join us in building the next generation of Consumer Health & Wellness brands—powered by people, enabled by AI.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role
We're looking for an AI Engineer to design, build, and maintain our organization's AI systems — from understanding business requirements to deploying models into production. You'll work with cutting-edge AI technology, including Generative AI, LLMs, and full-scale Machine Learning systems, and play a direct role in transforming how our organization works through technology.
Key Responsibilities
AI / Machine Learning Development
• Design and develop AI solutions such as chatbots, automated document analysis systems, prediction systems, computer vision, or recommendation systems based on business needs

• Build applications on Generative AI / LLM foundations, such as RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), AI agents, and integrations with leading model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

• Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training / fine-tuning, and model evaluation

Deployment & MLOps
• Develop prototypes / POCs and drive them into fully functional production systems

• Build and maintain pipelines for training, deploying, and monitoring models

• Integrate AI systems with existing organizational systems via APIs and other integrations

Quality & Safety Assurance
• Monitor and continuously improve model performance (accuracy, latency, cost)

• Design systems in line with Responsible AI principles, data security, and PDPA compliance

• Prepare technical documentation for developed systems

Cross-functional Collaboration
• Analyze workflows with various departments to identify opportunities to improve efficiency with AI

• Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

• Provide guidance and knowledge-sharing on AI to the team

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field

• 2–5 years of experience in AI/ML development or software development

• Experience shipping AI systems to production is a strong plus

Technical Skills
• Python (required), SQL — JavaScript/TypeScript is a plus

• AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face

• Generative AI: LLM APIs, LangChain/LlamaIndex, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant)

• Cloud & infrastructure: AWS / Azure / GCP, Docker — Kubernetes and CI/CD experience is a plus

• Basic data management and ETL, comfortable working with databases

Soft Skills
• Strong problem-solving and systematic thinking

• Able to communicate technical ideas clearly to general audiences

• Comfortable reading technical documentation in English (English communication skills are a plus)

• Fast learner, able to adapt quickly as AI technology evolves

Why Join Us
This isn't just a coding role — you'll help shape how AI is actually used across the organization. You'll get to experiment, make decisions, and see your work create real business impact.

jobs.summary: Find the problem worth solving, define success, scope it, drive real AI adoption beyond the demo, and feed it back into the platform.
jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Find the problem worth solving
Most enterprise AI dies after the demo, not during it. The model works, everyone nods, the contract gets signed — and a year later it's a tab nobody opens, or the whole team uses it daily and not one executive can name a number it moved.
That's not a model problem. It's that nobody asked the right questions first: what is actually worth building, what outcome would a customer pay real money for, and what has to change in how people work for any of it to stick. Answering those before anyone writes code is the job.
You own the problem and the outcome of a Cleverse deployment; a Forward Deployed Engineer owns the build. The customers are regulated institutions, banks and asset managers, the kind of place where "it mostly works" is not an acceptable sentence. You'll spend real time on-site, because the thing worth building is almost never the thing written on the brief.

What you'll do
Find the problem worth funding. Learn how the business actually makes and loses money, and find the first use case leadership will pay for and defend. It's rarely the one on their wish list, and often the spreadsheet two analysts rebuild by hand every night.
Define success before anyone builds. Decide what a win looks like in numbers, and get the customer to commit to that number up front. A deployment with no agreed measure of success is one anyone can call a failure later.
Scope it honestly. Shape the solution with your FDE and pressure-test it against real data. Sometimes that means talking a customer out of their pet idea because it will never clear procurement, and pointing them at the unglamorous one that pays for itself. Staying true to the outcome, not the customer's first idea of it, is the whole discipline.
Drive adoption, not just launch. Going live is the start. You run the onboarding, the change management, and the executive readouts that take a deployment from one team to the whole organization, and keep it funded at budget review.
Feed the platform. Turn what you learn across deployments into playbooks and product direction.

What we're looking for
• You can learn unfamiliar industries quickly , going broad enough to understand the landscape and deep enough to identify where value is actually created or lost.

• You understand what today's AI can and can't do, deeply enough to spot an opportunity a customer hasn't thought to ask for, and to turn down one that won't survive production. Hand-waving won't survive contact with a real customer.

• You can make an idea tangible yourself: a sharp prompt, a working Aerogram flow, a prototype that settles an argument in the room. Production engineering belongs to your FDE.

• You define the problem before solving it, and tie every piece of scope to a number someone can check.

• You're trusted by the C-suite and the frontline alike, you communicate clearly to both, and you can tell when the two aren't aligned.

• You don't confuse a customer's proposed solution with the underlying problem. You know how to unpack assumptions, challenge framing, and get to what actually needs to change.

• You know that most organizations have more opportunities than resources . You can prioritize ruthlessly and focus attention on the few initiatives that matter most.

• Thai and English, both with customers.

• Helpful, not required: developer tools, AI products, enterprise transformation, or strategy consulting.

Don't apply if you want the problem handed to you already defined, or you measure your work by what ships rather than what changes.

About Cleverse
We're a venture builder: we see where the digital world is going, build the business model around that vision, and craft the product that makes it real. Our teams have shipped the kind of work the industry remembers — built when most thought it couldn't be done at that scale. We host the rooms where the country's builders gather, and we tend to be standing where the field is about to go, not following it.
Aerogram is our current bet — on the gap between AI that demos and AI that does real work inside a business. We stay true to the outcome a customer is paying for, not to any one way of reaching it, and we're never quite satisfied: there's always a version of the work that's better than the one we shipped.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
MTS GOLD (Mae Thong Suk Group) is a leading gold investment company in Thailand, with over 70 years of proven industry expertise. The company is committed to continuous innovation and leverages advanced technologies, including Gold Internet Trading, Gold Mobile Trading, and Gold Payment Solutions , to deliver secure and efficient investment services to its clients.
MTS GOLD provides end-to-end gold investment solutions, encompassing both physical gold trading and gold futures investment , enabling clients to access comprehensive and reliable investment opportunities across multiple platforms.
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer to drive our digital and data transformation initiatives.
This role is ideal for a technically strong and innovative professional who thrives in a fast-paced investment environment. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions to enhance trading strategies, optimize risk management, and improve customer experience. You will play a key role in leveraging data and advanced analytics to support intelligent decision-making and strengthen our competitive edge in the financial market.

Job title: AI Engineer
Key Responsibilities
• Develop and deploy LLM-based applications and AI-powered features, such as chatbots, automation tools, and internal AI solutions.

• Build and maintain backend services and APIs, and integrate LLMs into existing systems and workflows.

• Design and implement production-grade RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, including data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and response generation.

• Design and maintain canonical data models and reconciliation engines.

• Develop AI agents (tool/function calling) to automate workflows and support various business use cases.

• Craft, test, and optimize prompts and LLM interaction logic to ensure accurate, reliable, and consistent outputs.

• Integrate LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) with databases, internal systems, and third-party services.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues such as hallucinations, latency, and output inconsistencies.

• Improve system performance through caching strategies, prompt optimization, and cost efficiency techniques.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Backend, and cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready features and continuously improve user experience.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

• At least 3 years of experience as an AI Engineer, Software Engineer, or ML Engineer.

• Strong proficiency in Python, with the ability to write and debug code independently.

• Solid understanding of LLMs, Generative AI, and prompt engineering principles.

• Experience working with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude).

• Ability to integrate APIs and work with databases (SQL/NoSQL).

• Experience with or understanding of RAG systems and vector search.

• Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

• Hands-on experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar tools.

• Experience developing and deploying AI features in real-world environments (side projects or production).

• Ability to manage large-scale databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).

• Familiarity with Docker and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Understanding of asynchronous programming and REST API design.

• Strong interest in learning and experimenting with new Generative AI technologies.

• Problem-solving mindset with the ability to iteratively improve systems and workflows.

Join Us
At MTS GOLD, you will have the opportunity to drive digital innovation within Thailand’s premier gold and investment business. This role offers a platform to develop and implement cutting-edge AI solutions, leverage data to enhance trading strategies, and build intelligent systems that support enterprise-wide decision-making in a fast-evolving financial landscape.
If you are a results-driven professional passionate about Artificial Intelligence, and Data-Driven Innovation, we invite you to join MTS GOLD and be part of shaping the future of financial technology.

Apply now and be part of our continued success.
