jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
We are an AI-focused tech provider under Muangthai Group Holding, with a mindset of a technology start-up. We are looking to bring many proven best-in-class AI-powered products and solutions to various businesses. If you are self-motivated, want to be part of the new trend of technology and make a real impact, join us to be part of the growth story.
Job Description
We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Data Scientist to design, develop, and deploy machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI solutions. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, software engineers, and other data scientists to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and production-ready solutions. Experience with agentic AI, the insurance industry, or AWS will be considered an advantage.
Key Responsibilities
• Work with stakeholders to identify business problems and define suitable data science and AI solutions.

• Develop machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, recommendation, segmentation, and anomaly detection.

• Build deep learning solutions for structured and unstructured data, including text, documents, images, and time-series data.

• Design and implement generative AI applications, AI agents, and agentic workflows.

• Perform data exploration, preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, validation, and evaluation.

• Select appropriate algorithms and models based on performance, scalability, cost, latency, and business requirements.

• Build reusable training, inference, evaluation, and scoring pipelines.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models through APIs, batch pipelines, or real-time services.

• Monitor model performance, data quality, data drift, and production reliability.

• Apply model explainability techniques such as feature importance and SHAP.

• Participate in reviews of technical designs, code, experiments, and documentation.

• Support and mentor junior team members where appropriate.

• Communicate findings, limitations, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

• At least 3–5 years of experience in data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or a related role.

• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.

• Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, machine learning, and model evaluation.

• Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, or CatBoost.

• Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

• Experience working with both structured and unstructured data.

• Experience with feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, cross-validation, and model interpretation.

• Experience deploying machine learning models into production.

• Familiarity with REST APIs, batch inference, real-time inference, Docker, and Git.

• Ability to write clean, modular, testable, and maintainable code.

• Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with generative AI, large language models, RAG, AI agents, or agentic workflows.

• Experience in the insurance industry.

• Experience with AWS services or cloud-based machine learning solutions.

Why work with us?
• Competitive salary

• Bonus subject to performance and company financial results

• Health and life insurance plan

• Provident fund

• Flexible working hours and work environment

• Company sponsored laptop

• Annual health check-up

• Sponsored online courses and career development programs

Cathcart Technology is partnering with an innovative AI technology company developing next-generation products that help businesses leverage Generative AI to improve customer experiences and digital operations. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy combining strong technical expertise with product thinking and want to shape the future of AI-powered software.

jobs.title: AI Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
ตำแหน่ง AI Senior Engineer 3 อัตรา
หน้าที่ความรับผิดชอบ
• [Enterprise AI Architecture] ออกแบบ วางสถาปัตยกรรม และพัฒนาโครงสร้างพื้นฐานด้าน AI (Core AI Infrastructure) และระบบสารสนเทศอัจฉริยะให้สอดคล้องกับกลยุทธ์และเป้าหมายทางธุรกิจขององค์กร

• [Advanced AI Solutions] ออกแบบและดูแลการพัฒนาเทคโนโลยี Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) และระบบ Multi-Agent Orchestration เพื่อขับเคลื่อนการทำงานอัตโนมัติ (Automation) ในระดับองค์กร

• [System Integration & API Design] วางระบบการเชื่อมต่อ (Integration) ระหว่าง Core AI Engine, Agent Platforms กับระบบฐานข้อมูล (SQL, NoSQL, Vector Databases) และแอปพลิเคชันเดิมขององค์กรผ่านการออกแบบ API ที่มีประสิทธิภาพสูง

• [Full-Stack AI Application Development] ควบคุมและร่วมพัฒนา Interface สำหรับระบบ AI (AI-Powered User Interface) โดยเชื่อมต่อระบบหลังบ้านเข้ากับ Front-end Web Application เพื่อให้ผู้ใช้งานทั่วไปสามารถปฏิสัมพันธ์กับระบบ AI (เช่น AI Chat Interface, Dashboard, Workflow Visualizer) ได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพและเสถียร

• [Model Optimization & Evaluation] ควบคุมและปรับแต่งโมเดล AI ทั้งกลุ่ม Traditional ML/DL และกลุ่ม Foundation Models ให้มีประสิทธิภาพสูงสุด (Optimization) ทั้งในแง่ความแม่นยำ ความเร็ว และความคุ้มค่าของต้นทุนคอมพิวเตอร์ (Cost-Efficiency)

• [Data Architecture & Pipelines] บริหารจัดการสถาปัตยกรรมข้อมูลขนาดใหญ่ (Big Data) และร่วมมือกับทีม Data Engineer ในการออกแบบ Data Pipelines เพื่อป้อนข้อมูลเข้าสู่ระบบ AI อย่างปลอดภัยและถูกต้อง

• [LLMOps & Governance] พัฒนาและวางมาตรฐาน LLMOps / MLOps Pipelines, Model Monitoring รวมไปถึงการกำหนดแนวทาง AI Governance & Guardrails เพื่อควบคุมความปลอดภัยของข้อมูล (Data Privacy) และป้องกันความเสี่ยงจากการใช้งาน AI

• [Technical Leadership] ทำหน้าที่เป็นผู้นำทางเทคนิค (Technical Lead) ในการควบคุมคุณภาพโค้ด ตรวจสอบสถาปัตยกรรมระบบ และให้คำปรึกษาแก่ทีมพัฒนาระบบ นักวิเคราะห์ข้อมูล และวิศวกรเอไอรุ่นน้อง

• [R&D & Innovation] ศึกษา ติดตาม และประเมินเทคโนโลยี AI/Generative AI และเครื่องมือใหม่ๆ อยู่เสมอ เพื่อนำมาประยุกต์ใช้สร้างข้อได้เปรียบทางธุรกิจและนวัตกรรมใหม่ให้กับองค์กร

• จัดทำเอกสารทางเทคนิค (Technical Documentation) สถาปัตยกรรมระบบ และถ่ายทอดองค์ความรู้ให้แก่ทีมงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• ปฏิบัติงานอื่น ๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย

คุณสมบัติผู้สมัคร
• สำเร็จการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรี และปริญญาโท สาขา Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Engineering หรือสาขาอื่นที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• มีประสบการณ์ทำงานด้าน AI, Machine Learning หรือ Data Science ไม่น้อยกว่า 5 ปี

• มีความเชี่ยวชาญขั้นสูงในการพัฒนาโปรแกรมด้วยภาษา Python และการออกแบบระบบ Back-end (เช่น FastAPI, Microservices Architecture)

jobs.title: Junior / Mid-Level Data Scientist (Manufacturing AI)
jobs.description:
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a motivated Junior to Mid-Level Data Scientist who is passionate about transforming manufacturing and industrial data into intelligent solutions for smart factories. You should enjoy solving real-world problems using data analytics and machine learning, with a particular interest in computer vision and industrial AI applications.
If you are curious, eager to learn, and enjoy working closely with engineering and operations teams to deliver impactful AI solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities
• Develop object detection, image classification, and image anomaly detection models to improve production efficiency, product quality, and manufacturing processes.

• Design, build, and maintain scalable machine learning pipelines and production systems.

• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover insights and understand production data.

• Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to identify business challenges and develop data-driven solutions.

• Monitor data quality and troubleshoot data-related issues.

• Follow software engineering best practices, including code quality, testing, version control, and documentation.

• Keep up to date with the latest developments in AI and data science

• Present technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Data science, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or related fields.

• 1-2 years of experience in data science and machine learning. Fresh graduates are also welcome.

• Strong proficiency in Python and modern Python environment management tools (e.g. uv).

• Strong proficiency in SQL.

• Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including gradient descent, bias-variance trade-off, overfitting/underfitting, probability, and statistical hypothesis testing.

• Solid understanding of digital image processing techniques, including image preprocessing, filtering, thresholding, morphology, feature extraction, image enhancement, and geometric transformations.

• Experience with data analysis libraries such as Pandas, Polars, NumPy, SciPy, and Matplotlib.

• Experience with several of the following computer vision technologies: PyTorch, TorchVision, Transformers, Ultralytics (YOLO), OpenCV, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, and Pillow.

• Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow and DVC.

• Experience using Git and remote repositories.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• A collaborative mindset, positive attitude, and willingness to learn.

• Good written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
• Experience applying data science in manufacturing, industrial automation, or engineering.

• Experience with traditional machine learning algorithms and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost.

• Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision Language Models (VLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

• Experience deploying machine learning applications using Docker and Kubernetes.

• Experience with n8n.

• Japanese language proficiency.

Welfare and Benefits

jobs.description:
Job Purpose/Role
As an AI Enablement Partner, you will be the strategic catalyst driving AI literacy and automation excellence across our Business Units (BUs). You don’t just implement tools; you build capabilities. You will act as a trusted advisor to BU AI Champions, helping them navigate the complexity of AI, managing the delivery of high-impact solutions, and fostering a self-sustaining automation culture within the organization.
Key Responsibilities
Core Mission:
Mentoring & Governance Control > Shape AI transformable requirements, lead governance control, and mentor the enablement team.
Business Partnership & AI Strategy:
Partner with BUs to co-create AI roadmaps. Act as the primary point of contact for AI Driver and AI Champions to identify high-value opportunities where AI/Automation can significantly reduce manual effort.
Solution Portfolio Management:
Evaluate business needs and dictate the delivery strategy:
Ready-to-Eat (High Complexity/Risk):
• Lead the requirements gathering and submit to PM for managing the "delivery queue" for the AI Automation Engineer team to build robust, finished tools.

• How-to-Cook (Low/Medium Complexity):

• Empower BUs to build their own solutions by providing frameworks, tools, and mentorship.

• Capability Building & Mentorship:

• Beyond initial training, provide ongoing "Shadowing" and "Consultative Review" to ensure BU-built automations are efficient, scalable, and secure.

• Design organization-wide AI upskilling strategies.

• Coach and mentor internal Junior/Advanced team member

• Trust & Governance Advisory:

• Serve as the first line of defense in AI Ethics and Governance. Evaluate solutions for data privacy, leak prevention, rate limits, and licensing before deployment.

• Adoption Lifecycle & Feedback Loop:

• Orchestrate the end-to-end adoption process. Establish audit mechanisms and feedback loops (Monthly/Quarterly) to measure real business impact and continuous improvement.

• Own the overall adoption lifecycle.

• Audit the system dynamically to ensure enterprise-grade safety.

Key Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in IT related and experience 5+ years in IT/Technology.

• Experience: At least 3 years specifically in AI/Automation Adoption or Digital Transformation roles.

• Consulting Mindset: Proven ability to translate complex technical constraints into clear business pros/cons. You speak the language of both "Tech" and "Business."

• Automation Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with workflow / Low-code tools

• (Kissflow, Power Automate, Make, n8n, AppSheet, AirTable, AppSmith and etc.) and a strong grasp of Vibe Coding (AI-assisted development).

• Programming: Proficiency in Python or JavaScript to support/review custom scripts.

• Requirement Engineering: Exceptional skill in mapping vague user "wants" into structured "requirement flows" and viable solution architectures.

jobs.title: Data Scientist (Onsite)
jobs.description:
AIS is seeking a Data Scientist to join our dynamic team in Bangkok, Thailand. This role involves working with massive datasets, primarily on cloud infrastructure, to support advanced analytics and machine learning applications. At AIS, you’ll tackle diverse and impactful use cases across multiple business domains, including the mobile phone business, high-speed home broadband, entertainment, and media, gaining exposure to some of the most exciting and complex data challenges in the industry.

Qualifications
Data Science & Analytics
• Data Science Foundations: Strong foundation in data science, statistics, and advanced data analytics, including data visualization to communicate insights effectively.

• Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Skilled in performing EDA to uncover patterns, detect anomalies, and generate meaningful insights from data.

• Experimentation & Testing: Skilled in designing A/B tests or other experimental designs to measure business impact, analyze results, and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.

Machine Learning & AI
• Model Development & Deployment: Experience in building, deploying, and optimizing machine learning models on large datasets.

• Generative AI (GenAI): Opportunity to work on GenAI projects that drive innovation and impactful business solutions.

Problem-Solving & Collaboration
• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities focused on deriving actionable insights from data.

• Team Collaboration: Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team, contributing to shared project goals.

Technical Expertise
• Proficiency in Big Data Technologies: Expertise in Spark, PySpark, and SQL for large-scale data processing focused on feature creation for machine learning models and data analysis tasks.

• Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis and machine learning (including libraries like Pandas, PySpark, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Matplotlib, Plotly, Seaborn, etc.).

• Python Notebooks: Familiarity with Jupyter, Google Colab, or Apache Zeppelin for interactive data analysis and model development.

• Platform Experience: Experience in using PySpark on cloud platforms such as Azure Databricks or other platforms (including on-premise) is a plus.

Education & Experience
• Educational Background: Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics , Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Information Technology, Engineering, or related fields.

• Work Experience: At least 2-3 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning, with demonstrated technical expertise and a proven track record of driving data-driven business solutions.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
The Senior AI Engineer owns the enterprise LLM platform substrate that powers every generative-AI consumer across the organisation. This role designs, builds, and operates the LLM Gateway, the evaluation framework, and the AI best-practices playbook that engineers, business teams, and product squads depend on to ship trustworthy AI features at scale.

Key Responsibilities • Design, build, and operate the enterprise LLM Gateway — provider abstraction, authentication, rate limiting, per-use-case cost tracking, prompt logging for audit, and model routing across major providers (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, Vertex AI).
• Operationalise an evaluation framework (Langfuse or equivalent) — tracing, eval scores, human feedback loops — as a platform service consumed by every production GenAI consumer.
• Define and enforce evaluation rubrics (accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, latency, cost per inference) and embed regression gates in CI so no GenAI consumer ships without a working eval harness.
• Ship and operate the GenAI cost dashboard with per-use-case attribution and quarterly forecasts to leadership; drive cost-optimisation initiatives (caching, prompt compression, model routing).
• Partner with Data Governance on AI-model governance evidence (audit-log schema, PII redaction proofs, model routing controls) to support legal and compliance approvals for GenAI at scale (Thailand PDPA, regional AI frameworks).
• Partner with platform engineering on Vector Search and embedding model selection, retrieval relevance tuning, chunking strategies, and reranker layers.
• Author and publish the AI Best Practices Playbook — the standard engineering teams across the company use when shipping LLM features; mentor and review.
• Own GenAI platform service-level objectives — availability, latency, cost ceilings — and lead incident response for production GenAI consumers.
Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related discipline.
• 6+ years of software engineering with at least 2+ years shipping production LLM platform systems (gateways, evaluations, cost metering, multi-model routing).
• Strong Python production-service development (FastAPI, async, observability, tests).
• Hands-on production experience with at least one major LLM provider (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, Vertex AI), including cost and latency optimisation.
• Eval-driven LLM development discipline — golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression gates in CI, multi-step conversation replay.
• Solid grounding in prompt-injection defence, data-leakage prevention, and PII handling for LLM systems.
• Cloud production experience (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP transferable) and Git-based CI/CD; comfortable owning service contracts and SLOs.
• Excellent written and verbal communication; able to author technical design documents and influence engineering peers and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with LLM gateways (Portkey, LiteLLM, Kong AI) or having built one in-house.
• Fine-tuning experience (LoRA / QLoRA) and open-weight model deployment (vLLM, TGI).
• Thai-language NLP exposure (PyThaiNLP, WangchanBERTa, SEA-LION, Typhoon) and retail / commerce data context (POS, catalog, CRM, loyalty).
• Vendor or industry certifications such as Databricks Generative AI Engineer, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable.

jobs.description:
Job Purpose :
The Data Scientist under Persistency Tribe is responsible for understanding business needs, designing and developing practical data, AI, and automation solutions, and supporting their adoption into day-to-day business operations.
This position also supports the transformation roadmap by preparing trusted data, automating high-effort and repetitive processes, generating clearer and more actionable insights, and helping Persistency Tribe staff build confidence in using data, AI, automation, and emerging technologies responsibly.
This role requires a combination of analytical capability, technical execution, business understanding, and user adoption support
Responsibilities:
Understand Business Problems and Shape Use Cases
• Work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Project Managers, and business users to understand manual processes, repetitive tasks, control points, handoffs, and pain points that can be simplified, automated, or redesigned.

• Translate business problems into practical data, analytics, AI, or automation use cases.

• Contribute ideas for new AI, technology, analytics, and automation initiatives aligned with Persistency Tribe priorities and transformation principles.

• Support prioritization of use cases by assessing business value, feasibility, data availability, complexity, and adoption readiness.

• Help define expected outcomes, success measures, user requirements, and practical implementation considerations.

Build Data, AI, and Automation Solutions
• Build and support practical tools for real business use cases, including prediction models, GenAI tools, text-to-SQL solutions, exception detection, data validation routines, dashboards, workflow automation, and scripts that reduce recurring manual effort.

• Support GenAI-assisted commentary and management narrative preparation by validating source data, checking consistency, and ensuring outputs are grounded in approved and reliable information.

• Test, validate, and refine outputs to ensure accuracy, usability, and business relevance before deployment or user release.

Drive Adoption and Train Users
• Help Persistency Tribe users build confidence in using data, AI, automation tools, dashboards, and GenAI solutions safely and effectively.

• Support preparation of practical training materials covering AI, data, analytics, automation, dashboards, GenAI usage, and responsible technology adoption.

• Assist in user clinics, demos, training sessions, knowledge-sharing activities, and hands-on support to improve adoption of new tools and ways of working.

• Create simple user guides, FAQs, use-case examples, prompt examples, and do-and-don't guidance for responsible AI and technology usage.

• Track usage, adoption, feedback, and pain points to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Support change champions and business users in embedding new tools and solutions into regular business processes.

Collaborate, Govern, and Document
• Maintain clear documentation for datasets, automation logic, analytical assumptions, model outputs, GenAI prompts, testing results, user guides, and solution handover materials.

• Support documentation required for usage tracking, auditability, data governance, AI governance, model governance, and responsible AI controls.

• Work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Project Managers, Data Science, IT, Risk, Compliance, and business users to ensure deliverables are understood, adopted, and embedded into business processes.

• Participate in knowledge-sharing activities to uplift data, technology, automation, and AI capability of tribe members.

Continuous Improvement and Capability Uplift
• Identify opportunities to improve existing reports, processes, workflows, automation tools, analytical outputs, and user experiences.

• Support the standardization and reuse of data assets, analytical logic, automation components, prompt templates, and training materials.

• Stay informed about practical developments in analytics, automation, GenAI, and emerging technologies that may benefit Persistency Tribe transformation.

• Contribute to a culture of experimentation, responsible innovation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.

Qualifications:
• Experience in insurance, finance, actuarial, agency, persistency, conservation, campaign, or customer analytics.

• Experience in transformation, product development, consulting, or business improvement initiatives where the candidate helped build a solution and drive user adoption.

• Knowledge of finance reporting, FP&A, controllership, actuarial processes, or insurance business operations.

• Experience with automation tools, self-service analytics platforms, workflow tools, or low-code/no-code platforms.

• Experience supporting GenAI use cases, prompt design, AI-assisted reporting, or data-driven narrative generation.

• Experience helping users through change, conducting training, preparing user guides, or supporting adoption of new tools.

• Familiarity with data governance, AI governance, model governance, information security, or audit requirements.

• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure) including Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and related AI infrastructure.

• Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, for deploying scalable AI services.

• Good understanding of Agentic AI architectures, AI Agents, and modern LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and AI SDK.

• Ability to design and implement AI agents using: Pro-code frameworks (e.g., Agent SDK), Low-code / no-code solutions (e.g., Azure AI Foundry Agents)

AI Observability & Monitoring
• Experience implementing AI observability and monitoring systems for LLM-based applications and AI agents.

• Hands-on experience with AI observability tools such as LangFuse, and logging platforms such as Azure Log Analytics.

• Experience building monitoring dashboards and system telemetry using Grafana.

• Strong understanding of AI system logging, tracing, and performance monitoring for production AI systems.

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation techniques, including LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks to measure agent quality and response performance.

• Understanding of AI evaluation metrics, including model accuracy and response quality latency and throughput, reliability and system health and token usage and cost efficiency

Operational Skills
• Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack.

• Define and monitor AI agent KPIs and performance metrics, including quality evaluation using LLM-as-a-Judge approaches.

• Collaborate with AI Engineers, AI Scientists, and Risk teams to define: experiment metrics, evaluation frameworks, continuous monitoring strategies for AI systems

• Work closely with Product teams, customers, and stakeholders to define business-level KPIs for AI agents and measure their impact on business outcomes.

• Feed operational insights, monitoring results, and evaluation metrics back into the AI development lifecycle to drive continuous improvement of models and agents.

• Design and maintain data pipelines and operational data infrastructure to ensure standardized, clean, and reliable data for analytics, monitoring, and reporting.

• Collaborate with DevOps, SRE, and IT teams on tooling, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes to ensure reliable AI system delivery.

About the Role
We are looking for a strategic and adaptable PM to oversee our software development projects during a critical phase of AI adoption. The goal is to ensure efficient delivery of software solutions where the development team actively leverages advanced AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Devin.ai). This isn't traditional project management; it requires understanding how AI assistants impact timelines, resource allocation, and quality assurance in a modern, high-speed development environment.

Core Responsibilities
• Project Governance & Quality Management: Define and maintain project management standards specifically adapted for AI-driven development. Ensure strict adherence to the company's software development Quality Management processes and guidelines. As a leader, you must ensure every team member deeply understands and strictly follows these quality management standards.

• AI Acceleration & Partner Collaboration: Actively accelerate and optimize the use of AI tools within the development workflows. Communicate directly with partner companies to research, acquire, and implement the latest AI solutions and tools within the organization.

• Client Relations & Business Analysis: Act as the core bridge between tech teams and clients. Build strong, trusting relationships with customers, and utilize a "BA-style" consultative mindset to understand customer needs and smoothly translate them into project requirements.

• Timeline & Resource Management: Oversee project schedules, financial tracking, and resource allocation, specifically accounting for the increased velocity provided by AI tools.

• Performance Tracking & Reporting: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of AI tool adoption. Prepare regular status reports and progress updates for the management team.

• Risk Management: Identify potential risks unique to AI-generated code (e.g., security, compliance) and ensure mitigation strategies are executed promptly.

jobs.description:
About the role
This role will be responsible in building an AI/ML-powered fraud prevention program that combines proven machine learning for detection (gradient boosting, graph neural networks, sequence models) with emerging agentic AI and generative AI for analyst assist, case triage, and adversarial testing. This role designs and builds those systems end-to-end.
This is a hands-on engineering role. You architect the solution and you write the code. You need to understand fraud enough to have opinions on model design; you need to understand modern AI stacks enough to have opinions on architecture.

Key Responsibilities:
Transaction fraud ML : Real-time scoring model for transactions.
Application fraud detection : Onboarding and lending-application fraud
Mule network analysis : Graph neural networks over customer-to-customer transfer patterns. Identifies mule rings before they operationalise. High priority given Thai regulatory pressure on mule accounts.
Agentic triage flows : LLM-powered agents that autonomously gather context around a fraud alert and produce a structured case summary for a fraud analyst to review. Reduces analyst time-per-case from tens of minutes to under one.
Adversarial red-teaming : Synthetic fraud pattern generation for testing our own detection systems.

Qualifications:

jobs.description:
Job summary:
AI Platform / System Reliability Engineer to run the AI platform and the stabilization period for deployed AI/GenAI solutions, owning the reliability, availability, cost, and security of AI workloads. This is a critical role because the AI Centre of Excellence fully owns stabilization: you will operate monitoring and on-call, harden workloads, manage capacity and cost, and build the runbooks and knowledge base that allow each solution to be safely transferred to the receiving unit with a proven SLO track record. The ideal candidate combines solid platform and operations skills with a calm, evidence-led approach to incidents and a security-first mindset.

Job description:
• Operates monitoring, alerting, and on-call for AI/GenAI workloads — infrastructure, model endpoints, data pipelines, and guardrails.

• Hardens AI workloads: secrets, key rotation, network segmentation, endpoint protection, and dependency security.

• Operates capacity, autoscaling, and cost controls across GPU/CPU, token budgets, and quota management.

• Builds and maintains stabilization-period runbooks and the L2/L3 knowledge base for owned services, and participates in dry-runs.

• Takes on-call shifts and performs L1/L2 incident response, documenting post-incident actions for AI-specific failure modes such as hallucination spikes, prompt injection, drift, and cost runaway.

• Owns service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for assigned AI services, keeping availability, latency, cost, and quality within target.

• Supports stabilization hand-overs by training the receiving unit on assigned runbooks.

• Identifies opportunities to improve monitoring, automation, and incident-response practices, and contributes to the platform reference runtime and golden paths.

• Structures incident triage, identifies dependencies, and escalates ambiguity early, resolving known AI-workload issues effectively.

• Reduces repeat incidents within scope and helps execute clean stabilization hand-overs within the agreed SLA.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• 1–6 years of SRE, DevOps, platform, or infrastructure-operations experience.

• Solid Linux and networking fundamentals, and comfort with at least one cloud platform — Microsoft Azure preferred.

• Hands-on experience with monitoring/alerting and log analytics (Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, Application Insights, or similar).

• Scripting and automation ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and basic infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Bicep).

• Familiarity with containers and Kubernetes (AKS) operations: deployments, scaling, and log/metric inspection.

• Understanding of secrets management, key rotation, and basic security hardening.

• Foundational understanding of LLM-ops — model endpoints, token-cost basics — and AI failure modes such as drift, prompt injection, and cost runaway.

• Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation during stabilization.

• Experience in banking, financial services, or another regulated environment is an advantage; comfortable working in an Agile / Scrum environment.

jobs.title: Specialist, HR Data Analytics & AI Automation
jobs.description:
Imagine being responsible for people technology and analysis for the world’s largest jewellery brand. If you love working with data, system enhancement and digitalization, then you might be our next Specialist, People Technology and Analytics at Pandora Crafting & Supply.

We love that you will…
AI Agent Building & Automation
• Identify and prioritize AI agent and automation use cases across PPT and PPV HR processes, including knowledge retrieval, process guidance, employee self-service, HR case support and operational reporting.

• Design, build, test and deploy AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform or approved automation tools.

• Translate business requirements into agent instructions, prompts, workflows, knowledge sources, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.

• Maintain agent knowledge sources, conversation flows, prompts and automation logic to ensure accuracy, usability and operational relevance.

• Monitor AI agent performance, user feedback, adoption, accuracy and issue trends; continuously improve solutions based on analytics and business input.

• Support responsible AI practices, including privacy, security, access control, data classification and governance reviews.

Digital Transformation, Adoption & Governance
• Partner with HR process owners, HR Operations, Payroll, TA, C&B, HRBPs, D&T and business stakeholders to identify digital opportunities and measurable business value.

• Support pilots, proofs of concept, UAT, deployment and scaling of successful AI automation solutions for PPT and PPV.

• Prepare user guides, SOPs, playbooks, FAQs, training materials and communication to drive adoption and consistent usage.

• Deliver demonstrations, training and stakeholder workshops for HR teams and selected employee groups.

• Establish and maintain governance documentation, change logs, testing evidence, access rules and operating procedures for AI / automation solutions.

• Track benefits, risks, adoption metrics and continuous improvement actions after deployment.

People Technology & Analytics Enablement
• Support HR system enhancement, data quality checks and reporting requirements related to automated processes and AI-enabled services.

• Coordinate with internal D&T teams, global teams and external vendors to resolve issues, manage enhancements and sustain deployed solutions.

• Maintain documentation for system configuration, process flows, integration points, dashboards and automation inventory.

We love that you are…
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related field

• Minimum 3 years of experience in AI technologies, HR/IT systems, automation, analytics, digital transformation, or HR process improvement.

• Proven experience in designing, implementing, and enhancing technology solutions to support HR operations, employee experience, people services, and business transformation initiatives.

• AI Automation knowledge /experience is a plus.

• Proficient in Power Automate, Power Apps, Python, and/or SQL

• Experience with HR technology platforms, workflow automation, AI-powered solutions, and data-driven decision-making is highly preferred.

• Experience with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools and solutions is a plus.

• Hands-on experience or strong interest in Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, AI tools or workflow automation.

• Understanding of HR processes, employee data, access control and system/data governance.

• SAP SuccessFactors or other HR/IT experience is an advantage.

• Able to visualize data and communicate insights effectively

• Skilled in translating business needs into technical requirements

• Solid understanding of HR processes and data structures

• Service-oriented with a customer-first mindset

• High attention to detail and data accuracy

• Adaptable with a continuous learning attitude

• Strong communication in both Thai and English

Welcome to our Crafting & Supply
The magic happens at our crafting facilities, where we combine centuries-old crafting traditions and high-quality materials with modern production techniques. You will be warmly greeted with over 13,000 craftspeople who are excellent at crafting and supplying the world’s largest jewellery brand with our craftsmanship. You will be part of a team of People experience and transformation team and report to the Manager, People Technology & Analytics.

Join a team that is as diverse and inclusive as our jewellery. We believe and value creative thinking and ensure that there’s equitable opportunities for all.

• Foster your growth and craft opportunities through our learning and development programmes.

• At Pandora, no effort or contribution goes unnoticed. We offer a wide range of opportunities and benefits to ensure that our employees feel valued, supported, and cared for.

• Transportation services are also available to drop you at the closet BTS station and other community areas.

About Pandora Crafting & Supply
Pandora started crafting its jewellery in Thailand in 1989, where our founders fell in love with the delicate craftsmanship of the Thai people. To date, there are two crafting facilities in Thailand, Bangkok, and Lamphun, and we employ more than 13,000 skilled craftspeople. By the end of 2024, there are 113 million pieces sold globally, all of which were hand-finished here in Thailand by our skilled craftspeople using high-quality raw materials and sustainable methods.

About Pandora Group
Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand. Designed in Denmark and crafted in Thailand, Pandora jewellery provides endless opportunities for personalisation, allowing people to express their passions and show who they are. The company’s products are made from high-quality materials and sold in more than 100 countries through 6,785 points of sale, including 2,788 concept stores.
Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and is sourcing lab-grown stones and recycled silver and gold for all its jewellery. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs 37,000 people worldwide, is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange, and generated sales of DKK 31.7 billion (EUR 4.25 billion) in 2024.

jobs.title: AI Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
aCommerce is the region’s leading e-commerce service provider. With over 800 talented staff and operations in Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines.
As the AI Transformation, you will champion the adoption, integration, and safe usage of Artificial Intelligence across the organization. Loosely modeled after a product manager, this role focuses on maximizing personal and organizational productivity through AI, establishing governance and security policies, and collaborating closely with product teams to build innovative AI-driven features into our internal and external offerings.

Current areas where initiatives relate are:
• Ecommerce operations automation

• Marketplace data intelligence

• Content automation

• Customer service automation

• Brand analytics

• AI agents for ecommerce workflows

• Internal productivity across commercial, operations, marketing, product, finance, and support

Job Responsibilities in a nutshell:
• Develop strategies for the deployment and use of AI within the company.

• Track the use of AI for personal productivity and use it to evangelize to others inside and outside of the company, showing that we use AI effectively.

• Work to establish policy for the safe use of AI for developers and citizen developers.

• Establish lightweight processes to evaluate new AI tools coming into the company for suitability of purpose and corporate standards, including security standards.

• Work with other product managers to embed AI features into existing and new products.

• Develop training programs for staff on effective and safe usage of AI tools.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Technology, or related field

• Minimum 4 years of experience operating as a product manager, technical evangelist, or in a similar strategic technology role.

• Demonstrated ability to advocate for new technologies and drive organizational change and adoption.

• Strong communication and presentation skills to effectively evangelize AI usage both internally to staff and externally to clients/partners.

• Experience in developing cross-functional policies and training programs

• Proven experience in researching new technologies and techniques for applying technology

• Experience in engaging with Senior Management to gain consensus and sponsorship for key initiatives

• As this role is regional in nature, strong command of written and spoken English is required. Good command of the Thai language is a strong plus.

• Deep understanding of current AI tools, generative AI technologies, agent systems, and emerging ecosystem trends.

• Knowledge of data privacy, security standards, and ethical considerations surrounding corporate AI deployment.

Overview: We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Data Scientist to join our team in the retail industry. The ideal candidate has at least 2 years of experience in data science, with expertise in data analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning. Exposure to MLOps, feature engineering, and data engineering workflows will be considered a plus.

Responsibilities • Data Analysis: Collect, preprocess, and analyze large datasets to identify trends and actionable insights for retail business challenges.
• Model Development: Design, train, and deploy machine learning models for tasks such as demand forecasting, customer behavior analysis, and inventory optimization.
• Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams, including data engineers and business stakeholders, to translate requirements into data-driven solutions.
• Visualization and Communication: Present insights and findings through visualizations and dashboards to inform decision-making.
• Innovation: Stay updated on the latest tools and techniques in data science and retail analytics.

Optional Responsibilities (if experienced):
• Feature Engineering:
• Engineer and optimize features to improve machine learning model performance.
• Automate feature extraction pipelines for scalable workflows.
• MLOps:
• Contribute to the deployment, monitoring, and retraining of machine learning models in production environments.
• Data Engineering:
• Assist in designing and maintaining data pipelines and ensuring data quality.
Requirements
• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
• Experience: At least 2 years of experience in data science or a related field.
• Technical Skills:
• Proficiency in Python for data analysis and machine learning.
• Strong SQL skills for managing and querying large datasets.
• Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
• Knowledge of data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, matplotlib).
• Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork abilities.

Preferred (Optional) Qualifications:
• Exposure to MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker).
• Familiarity with data engineering tools (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow).
• Experience in building real-time analytics or personalization systems.
Benefits
• Clear focus.
• Diverse Workplace (Our members are from around the world!)
• Non-hierarchical and agile environment
• Growth opportunity and career path

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (Robotics & IoT)
jobs.description:
Automation Engineer (Robotics & IoT)
Location: Bang Kadi Industrial Park, Pathum Thani, Thailand
Employment Type: Full-time

[ABOUT THE JOB]
As an Automation Engineer at Sony Device Technology (Thailand), you will research, prototype, and develop robotics and IoT solutions to advance factory automation. This is a hands-on, developer-style role focused on new solution development, you will explore emerging technologies such as AMRs, Cobots, computer vision, and IoT devices to solve real production challenges, and support these solutions from initial development through deployment and refinement..
Day-to-day equipment support is handled by our technician team; you will be involved in critical (hard-down) troubleshooting when systems you have developed require engineering-level intervention, including code-level fixes.

Explore & research
Study production floor needs; evaluate AMR, Cobot, and other automation technology options.
V
Design & build
Design supporting components using 3D CAD software; fabricate parts via 3D printing.
V
Code & connect
Write Python, JavaScript, and Node-RED to link robots, sensors, and OT systems to internal dashboards.
V
Test & validate
Run trials on the production floor; refine the prototype using real performance data.
V
Handover
Once validated, the solution is passed to other teams for long-term maintenance and servicing.

[WHAT YOU'LL DO]
• Research, evaluate, and compare AMR and Cobot vendor options to identify solutions that best fit production needs.

• Support installation, calibration, and troubleshooting of AMR/Cobot systems, including coordination with Japan HQ during handover of newly installed equipment.

• Develop service robots for internal material transport and inspection tasks (e.g., automated environmental monitoring, station-to-station transfer).

• Develop and expand IoT solutions using Raspberry Pi and microcontrollers (e.g., smart shelf systems, environmental monitoring with automated control).

• Develop computer vision applications for production monitoring, including process-compliance checks and workload/ergonomic analysis.

• Design and fabricate supporting hardware components using 3D CAD modeling and 3D printing.

• Write software in Python, JavaScript, and Node-RED to integrate robots, sensors, and OT systems with internal dashboards.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and validate prototype solutions.

• Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for solutions you help develop, working closely with other engineering teams as needed.

[WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR]
• Bachelor's degree in Automation, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering , or a related field.

• 0–3 years of experience in robotics, IoT, or automation (internships and academic projects are welcome).

• Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, and Node-RED; hands-on experience with Raspberry Pi.

• Basic proficiency in 3D CAD design software (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360) to support 3D-printed prototypes ( 0–2 years of relevant experience acceptable ).

• Familiarity with AMRs, Cobots, or industrial robotics concepts.

• Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• English proficiency at an intermediate level; able to read technical documents and write clear, professional emails.

[WORK SETUP]
• 100% on-site at Bang Kadi Industrial Park

• 5-day work week (Monday–Friday).

• May require occasional entry into cleanroom areas (with protective gear).

• No relocation support provided; candidates are expected to be able to commute to this location.

[WHAT WE OFFER]
• Annual Bonus

• Provident Fund

• Overtime Pay — all overtime hours compensated

• Attendance Bonus

• Language Allowance — monthly incentives for TOEIC & JLPT certification, no expiry throughout your career

• Financial support for English and Japanese language classes

• 5-Day Work Week: Monday – Friday

• Fuel Allowance or Company Shuttle Bus/Van Service plus travel allowance

• Health Insurance — comprehensive annual medical coverage

• Accident Insurance

• Dental Treatment Support

• Flexible Benefits — annual budget allocated across 6 categories: gym & sports, hotel stays (domestic & international), family medical care, vision care, preventative vaccines, and additional health screenings

• Continuous Learning — access to mandatory and elective technical training courses

• Financial support for Marriage, New Baby, and Ordination

• Financial support for loss of a family member or natural disaster relief

• Annual Company Trip & Party

• Exclusive Sony Employee Discounts on Sony products

jobs.title: Data Science - AI (T00032134)
jobs.description:
Job summary
Data / GenAI Specialist to lead the applied AI work for GenAI and LLM use cases and own the model quality of each solution from proof-of-concept through stabilization. This role covers feasibility, prompt engineering, RAG tuning, fine-tuning decisions, evaluation design, and continuous model-quality improvement. Working within the AI Centre of Excellence, the ideal candidate pairs strong hands-on data-science craft with the rigour to measure and reduce hallucination, bias, and toxicity, define quality SLOs, and produce the evidence a model-risk reviewer needs in a regulated banking environment.
Job description
• Leads proof-of-concept feasibility, rapid prototyping, and value-hypothesis validation for GenAI use cases.
• Designs and implements prompt engineering, few-shot strategies, chain-of-thought, and agent reasoning patterns.
• Tunes RAG components: chunking, embeddings, retrievers, re-rankers, and context-window strategy.
• Decides fine-tuning versus prompting versus tool-use trade-offs, and selects base models and adapter strategies.
• Designs evaluation frameworks: offline evals, LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop review, A/B testing, and red-teaming.
• Measures and reduces hallucination, bias, and toxicity, and defines quality SLOs per use case (accuracy, hallucination, bias, toxicity).
• Documents model cards, evaluation reports, and assumptions for model-risk review.
• Partners with Data Engineers on data quality, curation, and annotation, and monitors production model quality and drift.
• Iteratively improves prompts, retrievers, and evaluation hooks, contributing to reusable eval pipelines and prompt/RAG libraries.
• Experiments with new models, prompts, and retrieval strategies, and applies methodologies aligned with quality SLOs and Responsible-AI goals.
Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field (Master's preferred).
• 5+ years of data-science / machine-learning experience, with demonstrated hands-on LLM/GenAI delivery.
• Strong Python and the ML/AI ecosystem: PyTorch or TensorFlow, Hugging Face, scikit-learn, pandas/NumPy, and notebook workflows.
• Practical experience with prompt engineering, RAG (chunking, embeddings, retrievers, re-rankers), and agent patterns.
• Experience designing evaluation — offline evals, LLM-as-judge, human-in-the-loop, A/B testing, and red-teaming — with frameworks such as Ragas or DeepEval.
• Understanding of fine-tuning approaches (LoRA/PEFT) and their trade-offs versus prompting and tool-use.
• Ability to define and measure model-quality metrics and to write clear model cards and evaluation reports.
• Solid grasp of Responsible AI, bias, and drift monitoring; exposure to model-risk validation is an advantage.
• Experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, and Azure AI Search is preferred.
• Comfortable working in an Agile / Scrum environment.

jobs.description:
Role Summary
PropertyScout is looking for a sharp, exceptional problem solver and young leader to help us build our business.
In this role, you will lead high-impact strategic initiatives across the organization—driving operational excellence, process automation, and data-driven decision-making at scale. You will work directly with the COO and senior leadership team to solve complex business problems, improve core commercial performance, and execute projects that meaningfully shape PropertyScout’s growth trajectory.
This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution. You will translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analyses, actionable recommendations, and measurable operational improvements. You will also lead and develop a lean, high-performing team responsible for analytics, CRM optimization, and sales enablement infrastructure supporting thousands of agents and customers.
👉 This role is ideal for candidates with top-tier consulting , investment banking , or similarly demanding analytical experience—individuals who combine strong problem-solving ability, business judgment, and a hands-on ownership mindset. We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, highly driven, and excited to build.

Your Responsibilities
1. Business Operations & Process Automation
• Identify bottlenecks in key workflows - customer service, sales, supply, after-sales service

• Design and implement process improvements to increase speed, conversion, and customer experience

• Lead automation projects end-to-end: Understand the problem, map the process, use AI tools and no-code automation platforms to reduce manual work and improve output quality, drive adoption

2. Analytics, Management Reporting, Strategy & Planning
• Own management reporting across core business performance indicators relating to lead handling, conversion, sales performance, or product KPIs

• Use company data to spot operational improvement areas early and push the organization forward

• Inform strategy, planning and management decision making by turning messy business questions into clear analyses, practical recommendations, and measurable actions

3. Sales Enablement & CRM
• Optimize lead routing, deal stages, follow-up discipline, compliance checks, and sales productivity workflows

• Improve how our CRM and connected tools support sales and operations teams

• Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Product/Tech, Marketing, Finance, and Management to fix root causes, not symptoms

4. Team Leadership & Ownership
• Manage and develop a “lean & mean” sales enablement, analytics, CRM team

• Set priorities, review work, raise quality standards, and create a culture of precision, speed, and ownership

• Coach team members in structured problem solving, analysis, project execution, and communication

• Act as the accountable owner for team output: accuracy, timeliness, usefulness, and business impact

• Live and build a team culture where reports are reliable, easy to understand, and drive impactful decisions

Requirements
• Strong academics from a top university, with preference for quantitative or analytical fields

• 3-5 years of professional experience, preferred with exposure to strategy consulting, finance, or data analytics

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving ability - able to break down complex business problems, “get hands dirty” with data analyses (advanced Google Sheet/Excel skills), and turn analyses into clear strategy and action

• Strong project execution - reliable follow-up, clear ownership, ability to drive cross-functional work to completion

• People leadership potential - experience leading projects; direct team management experience is a plus

• Excellent English communication written and spoken; Thai language is a plus

• Strong ownership mindset - hands-on, practical, detail-oriented, and comfortable in a fast-moving start-up

Good to have
• Experience using AI tools for analysis, productivity, or automation

• Experience with no-code automation platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make)

• Experience with CRM systems

• Experience with BI tools

• Understanding of sales funnels, lead conversion, marketing analytics, or process automation

Your Growth & Development
This high-impact role is a unique stepping stone for a young professional seeking a steep learning curve, the ability to make a difference from day one, and a fast career path in one of the leading and best funded startups in Thailand. You will join an exceptional international team, report directly to the COO and work closely with senior management, with a mandate to drive growth and change at PropertyScout.
• Direct ownership of mission-critical projects that affect revenue, service quality, and productivity

• Work with large-scale operations covering 7,000+ agents, 250,000+ properties, and 10,000+ monthly customers

• Lead projects across AI automation, sales enablement, CRM workflows, data analytics

• Manage and develop your team while staying hands-on with problem solving, strategy development, execution

• Strong career path into business operations leadership, strategy, or general management

• Competitive compensation for young professionals, bonus, and potential ESOP for exceptional candidates

About PropertyScout
PropertyScout is Thailand’s leading end-to-end real estate transaction platform, automating 80% of the real estate transaction process to empower agents to deliver a trusted and seamless experience for tenants, buyers, and landlords. We combine technology, data, centralized operations, and a large agent network to make buying, selling, and renting property faster, more transparent, and more reliable.

• 250,000+ properties in our database

• 10,000+ buyers, tenants, and property owners served every month

• Venture-backed by leading international investors, with ambition to build a category-leading business across SEA

jobs.title: Data Scientist Manager
jobs.description:
At TNDS, we are passionate about creating great digital services that transform our customers’ businesses.

Joining TNDS as a Data Scientist Manager means becoming one of the key drivers behind our data-driven business and decision-making culture. Our Data Scientist Managers do not only build machine learning models. Instead, you will lead teams to understand complex business problems, design analytical strategies, validate assumptions with evidence, and transform insights into real business outcomes.

You will work closely with Business Analysts, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, Operations Teams, and Executives to solve real-world problems in Digital Banking, FinTech, and mission-critical systems.

If you are passionate about using data to influence business decisions and creating measurable impact through analytical thinking, this role is for you.
Responsibilities
• Lead end-to-end Data Science initiatives from business problem framing to deployment and monitoring.

• Translate ambiguous business requirements into measurable analytical frameworks and KPIs.

• Design and develop predictive models, anomaly detection systems, recommendation systems, and optimization solutions as required by business use cases .

• Drive experimentation frameworks including A/B testing and statistical validation.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Business, Engineering, and Operations teams to solve business problems using data.

• Guide feature engineering, model validation, and analytical methodologies.

• Ensure data quality, reliability, and analytical accuracy across workflows.

• Present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders and executives.

• Mentor and coach Data Scientists and Analysts to improve technical and business thinking capabilities.

• Support production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of analytical systems.

• Promote a strong data-driven culture and encourage evidence-based decision making.

Requirements
• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related fields.

• At least 5 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, Machine Learning, or related roles.

• Strong understanding of statistics and mathematical thinking.

• Strong analytical thinking, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Strong experience in Python, SQL, Statistical Modeling, Machine Learning, and Predictive Analytics.

• Strong understanding of Feature Engineering, Model Validation, Experiment Design, KPI Frameworks, and Data Pipelines.

• Familiarity with Cloud Platforms and MLOps concepts is a plus.

• Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts in a simple and actionable way.

• Experience leading cross-functional analytical initiatives.

• Strong ownership mindset and ability to work under ambiguity.

• Experience in Banking, FinTech, or Digital Products is preferred.

Work Location
• Near Chong Nonsi BTS / Saint Louis BTS

Benefits & Perks
• Flexible working hours

• Dental & Health Insurance

• Personal Accident Insurance

• Fitness

• Annual Bonus

• Provident Fund

• Etc.

Job Description
ตำแหน่ง: AI Web Operations Specialist
ภาพรวมตำแหน่ง
รับผิดชอบในการจัดทำและดูแลเว็บไซต์ลูกค้าโดยใช้ระบบ Static Website Template และ AI-assisted Workflow ของบริษัท เพื่อช่วยให้การผลิตเว็บไซต์รวดเร็ว มีมาตรฐาน รองรับ SEO และ AI Discoverability และสามารถดูแลรักษาได้ง่ายในระยะยาว
ตำแหน่งนี้ไม่จำเป็นต้องเป็น Programmer ระดับสูง แต่ต้องสามารถเรียนรู้เร็ว ใช้งาน AI Tools ได้ และสามารถทำงานตาม Workflow และมาตรฐานของบริษัทได้อย่างละเอียดรอบคอบ

Website Production

• จัดวาง Content ให้เหมาะสมกับ Mobile / Tablet / Desktop

• ดูแลความเรียบร้อยของเว็บไซต์ก่อนส่งมอบ

Component & Template Workflow

• ปรับแต่ง Theme, Style และ Visual ของเว็บไซต์ตามประเภทลูกค้า

AI-Assisted Workflow

• ปรับแก้ผลลัพธ์จาก AI ให้เหมาะสมกับงานจริง

Responsive & Quality Assurance

• ตรวจสอบความถูกต้องของ Layout, Font, Image และ Button

• ตรวจสอบ Broken Link และความสมบูรณ์ของเว็บไซต์

• ตรวจสอบ Performance และความเร็วของเว็บไซต์เบื้องต้น

Job Description
Position: AI Web Operations Specialist
Overview
Responsible for creating, customizing, and maintaining customer websites using the company’s Static Website Template System and AI-assisted workflow. The role focuses on producing modern, high-performance, SEO-friendly websites that are easy to maintain and scalable in the long term.
This position does not require advanced programming skills, but candidates must be fast learners, comfortable using AI tools, and able to follow structured workflows and company standards carefully.

Responsibilities
Website Production
• Customize customer websites using the company’s template and component system

• Edit text, images, colors, and website sections based on customer requirements

• Update website content through JSON/Data Structure systems

• Organize content for Mobile / Tablet / Desktop responsiveness

• Ensure websites are visually polished before delivery

Component & Template Workflow
• Use and maintain reusable components within the system

• Work with the company’s shared website templates

• Maintain layout and design consistency across projects

• Customize themes, styles, and visual appearance based on customer categories

AI-Assisted Workflow
• Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude to assist with website production

• Follow the company’s Prompt Library and workflow standards

• Generate basic layouts or sections using AI under company guidelines

• Refine AI-generated output to meet real production quality

Responsive & Quality Assurance
• Test responsive design across multiple devices

• Verify layout, typography, images, and buttons

• Check for broken links and overall website completeness

• Perform testing before deployment

• Review website performance and loading speed

SEO & AI Discoverability
• Manage Meta Title and Meta Description

• Review Heading Structure (H1-H6)

• Add Alt Text to images

• Maintain Sitemap and basic SEO structure

• Ensure proper Semantic HTML for search engines and AI crawlers

• Maintain structured data and discoverability-related website information

Deployment & Maintenance
• Deploy websites through Cloudflare Pages or company systems

• Handle basic Domain / SSL configuration

• Update customer websites based on requests

• Maintain version control and website backups

Qualifications
Required Skills
• Basic understanding of HTML / CSS

• Basic understanding of Responsive Design

• Comfortable using computers and web tools

• Fast learner with the ability to adapt to AI tools

• Detail-oriented and organized

• Willing to follow structured workflows and standards

Nice to Have
• Experience with Tailwind CSS

• Experience with Astro Framework

• Experience with Git / GitHub

• Basic SEO knowledge

• Experience with Cloudflare Pages

• Familiarity with AI coding tools

• Interest in UI/UX or modern web design

Tools & Technologies
• Astro

• Tailwind CSS

• GitHub

• Cloudflare Pages

• ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

• VSCode

Workflow & Working Style
• Work within the company’s AI-assisted production workflow

• Use shared templates and reusable component systems

• Follow a data-driven website structure

• Follow standard workflows and QA checklists

• Final work review and approval will be handled by Lead/Senior staff before deployment

Position Goals
• Improve the speed of customer website production

• Reduce repetitive manual work

• Improve website SEO, performance, and AI discoverability

• Build a scalable website production system for long-term growth

• Create modern, elegant, and professional-looking customer websites

Company description:

Career at Mitr Phol
At Mitr Phol, you will be empowered to take on meaningful challenges and grow across diverse business areas. We invest in your learning and career development, rewarding strong performance with clear progression opportunities and long‑term stability.
We value collaboration, openness, and flexibility, while genuinely caring for your well-being. As part of a company known for its strong reputation and commitment to sustainability, your work will create impact far beyond the bottom line.

About Mitr Phol Group
Mitr Phol Group is a leading agri-business with nearly 70 years of history. As Thailand's largest sugar producer and the world's fourth-largest, we are also active in renewable energy, wood-substitute materials, and consumer and bio-based products.
We operate with integrity, inclusivity, and sustainability at our core—aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Our philosophy, "Cultivating for All," reflects our belief in the dignity and potential of people, and our commitment to developing leaders who create meaningful value.
Mitr Phol is recognized as one of Thailand's top employers, having received the Top Employer Thailand certification for multiple consecutive years from the Top Employers Institute ( 20••-•026 ) in recognition of our excellence in HR practices.

Job description:

Position : Data Engineer (Fixterm Contract 2 Years) The Data Engineer (AI) is responsible for building and maintaining robust data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI and advanced analytics across Mitr Phol. This role ensures that data is collected, cleaned, transformed, and made available in an AI-ready format for Data Scientists, Generative AI/LLM specialists, and business stakeholders.
Experience • 2-5 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, or ETL development.
Role & Responsibility (R&R) • Data Pipeline Development
• Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data
• Data Management & Transformation
• Implement data cleansing, transformation, and normalization processes.
• Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and integrity.
• Build curated datasets and feature stores for AI/ML models.
• Operations & Monitoring
• Monitor pipeline performance, latency, and costs.
• Troubleshoot data ingestion or quality issues.
• Automate workflows using orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, etc.).
• Document & Best Practices
• Maintain documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data dictionaries.
• Follow coding standards, version control (Git), and CI/CD practices.
• Ensure compliance with Responsible AI and data security guidelines.
Education • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, IT, or related.

jobs.title: Senior / Lead Data Scientist (Financial AI & Risk Analytics)
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Senior / Lead Data Scientist specialising in Financial AI & Risk Analytics to join our team at our Din Daeng Bangkok office on a full-time basis . In this pivotal role, you will lead the development and implementation of sophisticated artificial intelligence and machine learning models designed to address complex financial risk challenges and deliver actionable insights to our stakeholders. You will have a strategic impact on our analytical capabilities, driving innovation in financial AI whilst establishing best practices across our data science operations. This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of finance and technology, where your expertise will directly influence business outcomes and competitive advantage.
Key responsibilities

• Design, develop and deploy advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence models focused on financial risk analytics, credit risk assessment, market risk analysis and fraud detection

• Lead the end-to-end data science lifecycle, from problem definition and data exploration through model validation, implementation and ongoing performance monitoring

• Mentor and supervise junior data scientists and analytical staff, fostering a culture of excellence, continuous learning and collaborative problem-solving within the team

• Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis on large-scale financial datasets to identify patterns, anomalies and opportunities for predictive modelling

• Develop robust statistical models and econometric frameworks to quantify and forecast financial risks across various asset classes and business segments

• Create clear and compelling data visualisations and reports that translate complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations for senior management and risk committees

• Collaborate closely with risk management, compliance, trading and operations teams to understand business requirements and ensure analytical solutions align with strategic objectives

• Establish and maintain rigorous model governance frameworks, including validation protocols, backtesting procedures and documentation standards to ensure regulatory compliance

• Stay abreast of emerging trends, methodologies and technologies in financial AI, machine learning and risk analytics, and evaluate their applicability to our business

• Optimise data pipelines and analytical infrastructure to enhance processing efficiency, scalability and data quality across analytical systems

What we're looking for

• Master's degree or higher in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline

• Minimum 7–10 years of professional experience in data science, machine learning engineering or advanced analytics, with at least 4–5 years specifically focused on financial services, risk analytics or quantitative finance

• Demonstrated expertise in building and deploying machine learning models in production environments, with proficiency in supervised learning, unsupervised learning, ensemble methods and deep learning techniques

• Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R or Scala, with experience in relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost)

• Solid understanding of financial concepts including credit risk, market risk, operational risk, counterparty risk, regulatory capital requirements and risk measurement methodologies

• Experience with big data technologies and distributed computing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop or cloud-based analytics platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

• Proven track record of leading analytical projects, mentoring junior staff and driving cross-functional collaboration in a complex organisational environment

• Strong statistical knowledge including hypothesis testing, causal inference, time series analysis and experimental design

• Experience with financial data sources, APIs and market data platforms; familiarity with data warehousing and ETL processes is advantageous

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Knowledge of financial regulations such as Basel III, IFRS 9, Dodd-Frank or equivalent regional frameworks is highly desirable

• Certification in machine learning, data science or related disciplines is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Gameplay and AI Programmer
jobs.description:
About the Role
As a Senior Gameplay Programmer, you are a technical pillar of the development team. You will architect and own core gameplay systems, ensuring they are performant, scalable, and feel exceptional to the player. You will act as a bridge between creative vision and technical execution, mentoring junior developers while solving the complex engineering challenges inherent in cross-platform AAA development.

Responsibilities
● System Architecture : Lead the design and implementation of robust, extensible gameplay frameworks (e.g., combat systems, locomotion, inventory, and world interaction) in C++ (Unreal).
● AI System Ownership : Own AI systems from concept to launch, ensuring their quality, stability, and performance.
● Core AI Implementation : Architect and implement advanced AI systems using methodologies like Behavior Trees, State Trees, Utility AI, and GOAP, specifically leveraging Unreal Engine's features.
● Integration & Interoperability : Integrate AI and gameplay with animation (state machines, locomotion, IK), physics, and combat systems.
● Performance & Optimization : Own the frame rate and memory footprint of gameplay systems. Profile and optimize code to ensure seamless performance on both high-end consoles and resource-constrained mobile devices.
● Advanced Debugging : Debug complex issues involving AI decision-making, pathfinding, and multi-system interactions.
● Cross-Platform Mastery : Develop and maintain features that scale gracefully across PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and high-end Mobile platforms.
● Tooling & Workflow : Create data-driven tools and visual editors to empower Designers and Artists to iterate on gameplay logic without constant engineering support.
● Technical Mentorship : Drive high coding standards through rigorous code reviews, technical documentation, and hands-on guidance for Junior and Mid-level programmers.
● Collaboration : Partner closely with Lead Designers and Art Directors to translate abstract creative concepts into polished, responsive gameplay mechanics.
● Technical Strategy : Contribute to the long-term technical direction for gameplay and AI within the studio.
● R&D : Proactively research and integrate emerging technologies (such as UE5’s Motion Matching) to keep the studio at the cutting edge of the industry.

Requirements
● Experience: 5+ years of professional game development experience, with at least 3 years in a Senior capacity.
● Shipped Titles: At least one shipped AAA or high-fidelity AA title on Console (PS5/Xbox) or PC.
● Technical Depth: Expert-level proficiency in C++. Deep understanding of memory management, multi-threading, and Data-Oriented Design.
● Math Skills: Strong foundation in 3D math (vectors, quaternions, linear algebra) for character movement and spatial systems.
● Engine Expertise: Advanced knowledge of Unreal Engine (Gas, Blueprints, C++ API).
● Deep understanding of game AI techniques (Behavior Trees, GOAP, Utility AI, Navigation Mesh customization, etc.).
● Leadership: Proven ability to break down complex features into actionable tasks and provide accurate time estimates for production.
● Language: Good in English.

Nice to Have
● Experience developing for Open-World titles (streaming logic, LOD management, and large-scale world persistence).
● Background in AI Programming (Behavior Trees, GOAP, or NavMesh customization).
● Familiarity with Unreal Engine 5 features (Nanite, Lumen, or the Mass Entity framework).
What We Offer
● A senior role in a high-growth studio with a unique cultural mission.
● A creative, office-based environment in the heart of Bangkok.
● A seat at the table in defining the technical direction of our flagship titles.
