jobs.title: Senior Manager - AI & Data Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior AI & Data Engineering Manager to lead the design, development, and scaling of enterprise-scale, production-grade data platforms and AI-ready data infrastructure that drive business value across Retail and Wholesale operations. This role bridges business strategy, data engineering, AI platform, and cloud technologies to deliver trusted, governed, and scalable data for Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, and Generative AI applications.

Key Responsibilities

• AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement
• Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI solutions to support business transformation (e.g., pricing, promotion, automation, recommendation, demand forecasting, customer insights, and intelligent decision support).
• Build and manage scalable data pipelines supporting AI/ML model training, inference, feature engineering, Feature Store, RAG knowledge bases, and LLM applications.
• Develop reusable datasets, AI-ready data products, feature engineering pipelines, and semantic data models for AI Engineers, Data Scientists, and Business Analytics teams.
• Partner closely with AI Engineers to design, deploy, productionize, and scale AI/ML models, LLM applications, Agentic AI, AI Chatbots, Recommendation Systems, and Mobile AI applications.
• Design and maintain data ingestion pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data from enterprise systems, APIs, databases, files, event streams, IoT devices, and third-party platforms.
• Develop scalable data pipelines supporting document ingestion, embedding generation, metadata management, vector indexing, and retrieval workflows for RAG applications.
• Identify opportunities to embed AI into business workflows and operational decision-making to improve efficiency, customer experience, and business value.

• Data Platform & Engineering Leadership
• Own end-to-end enterprise data architecture from source systems to Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Feature Store, Semantic Layer, and AI-serving layers.
• Design, develop, and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines supporting batch, micro-batch, streaming, and near real-time data processing.
• Design and maintain workflow orchestration for enterprise data pipelines using Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
• Develop enterprise-scale Big Data solutions using Apache Spark and distributed computing frameworks.
• Design scalable logical and physical data models while optimizing database architecture for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
• Ensure enterprise data quality, governance, lineage, metadata management, observability, security, and compliance across data platforms.
• Implement automated data validation, monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability to ensure production-grade data reliability.
• Optimize SQL queries, Spark workloads, partitioning strategies, storage formats, and compute resources for maximum performance and cost efficiency.
• Analyze complex technical issues, identify root causes, troubleshoot production problems, and recommend infrastructure and platform improvements.
• Select, evaluate, and integrate modern data engineering tools, cloud technologies, and AI platform frameworks to support evolving business needs.
• Continuously evaluate emerging technologies in Big Data, Lakehouse Architecture, Data Platform Engineering, Cloud Computing, and AI Platform Engineering.

• AI Platform & Infrastructure
• Build and maintain enterprise AI data infrastructure supporting LLM, RAG, Agentic AI, AI Chatbots, Recommendation Engines, Intelligent Search, and Intelligent Automation platforms.
• Design and implement scalable AI data pipelines supporting batch, streaming, vector search, embedding pipelines, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
• Design scalable APIs, data services, and integration layers connecting AI applications with enterprise systems and digital platforms.
• Collaborate with AI Engineers to prepare high-quality datasets for LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, model evaluation, inference, and continuous model improvement.
• Support deployment and operationalization of AI products using DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD, containerization, and modern software engineering practices.
• Drive continuous improvements in platform scalability, availability, security, observability, resilience, and operational efficiency.

• Team Leadership & Capability Building
• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Data Engineers, AI Engineers, and Analytics professionals.
• Foster engineering excellence through best practices in architecture design, coding standards, testing, code reviews, deployment, technical documentation, and software engineering.
• Drive architecture reviews, technical design reviews, engineering governance, and platform standardization across the engineering organization.
• Define engineering standards, technical roadmaps, platform architecture, and technology strategy aligned with business objectives.
• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Solution Architects, Infrastructure, and DevOps teams.
• Provide hands-on technical leadership with a strong engineering mindset and willingness to troubleshoot complex production systems.
• Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, innovation, and adoption of emerging technologies across the engineering team.

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Management Information Systems , or a related field.
• 6+ years of experience in Data Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Big Data, or AI Platform development, with experience leading engineering teams.
• Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, or Modern Data Platform architectures.
• Expert proficiency in SQL, Databricks SQL, PostgreSQL , database design, and query performance optimization .
• Strong programming skills in Python.
• Hands-on experience with Apache Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark SQL, Unity Catalog , and distributed data processing.
• Strong experience designing and developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow orchestration .
• Experience with streaming technologies such as Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka , or equivalent.
• Experience building enterprise-scale data platforms supporting AI/ML, Advanced Analytics, and Generative AI applications.

The Equipment Development Engineering group (EDE) of Seagate Technology is expanding the team! We welcome aspiring Automation Alchemist Enthusiasts to check out this awesome opportunity!
Our vision is to innovate and develop advanced intelligent automated manufacturing equipment solutions that can sense, analyze, and make smart decisions by themselves.

The team is made up of a strongly cohesive high performing team of design talents with a diversity of talents specialized in mechanical, embedded systems, electrical, software, and vision disciplines.
We strive to constantly incorporate IIOT, AI, machine learning image, and data analytics solutions into all our development enabling our equipment to realize factory smart intelligence thus creating a high-tech future-ready plant.
We seek dedicated, motivated, and creative talented teammates, who take up the new automation directives to provide turnkey solutions, integrating functionality, automation & intelligence for Drive Assembly, Drive Test, Heads, Media Manufacture Automation & Enterprise Data Solutions.

• Estimate project cost and schedule and manage projects from concept through completion
• Develop machine‑learning models to enhance automation processes
• Integrate advanced sensors for improved data acquisition, predictive maintenance, and quality analytics
• Research emerging robotics and automation technologies to identify opportunities for equipment improvement

About you:
• Effective in working with both native and non‑native English speaker
• Strong communication skills to work across engineering, IT, and operations teams
• Self-motivated, team player with strong analytical skills and eager to learn more
• Positive, can‑do mindset with a willingness to take on challenging problems
• Able to work both independently and collaboratively within diverse, cross functional teams
• Good command of English and Thai
• Committed to continuous learning, particularly in automation, control systems, and AI advancements

Your experience includes:
● Bachelor’s or higher degree in engineering and/or equivalent experience (Computer Engineer, Electrical Engineer, Mechanical Engineer are preferable)
• Strong proficiency in C# and C++ with experience developing and deploying software solutions for factory automation and industrial environments
• Hands on experience with automation control devices, including sensors, scanners, pneumatic cylinders, and electrical actuators
• Solid understanding of industrial communication protocols and network architectures such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus, DeviceNet, CAN, and EtherCAT
• Experience with machine‑vision systems and tools including Cognex VisionPro, Halcon, OpenCV, and Emgu CV, along with knowledge of vision‑hardware design
• Foundational knowledge of machine learning and artificial intelligence
• Knowledge of electrical and pneumatic diagram design
• Familiarity with safety equipment design standards such as SOP39 and SEMI

Location: Korat, Thailand
Our Korat facility is our largest manufacturing site worldwide, with more than 10,000 employees. Here, our team produces cloud-based storage equipment, from individual storage components to finished drives. Employees enjoy ample on-site parking, free shuttle vans and buses within the city of Korat, as well as transportation to and from Bangkok and Khon Kaen province on weekends. At work, you can grab a delicious breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks at one of our 24/7 on-site canteens or coffee shops. We offer table tennis, basketball, volleyball, a running/walking trail, and exercise classes in our on-site fitness center. In addition, there are relaxing spaces with comfortable seating both indoors and outdoors, perfect for taking a break during the day.
Additionally, consider joining any of our employee resource groups (ERGs), such as Seagate Women in Leadership Network (SWLN), Seagate PRIDE: Thailand chapter, or Seagate Asia’s parents and caregivers group. We also have many on-site recreation events and opportunities to give back to the local community.

jobs.title: Project Manager Lead (หัวหน้าทีมบริหารโครงการ)
jobs.description:
Project Manager Lead

ตำแหน่งนี้ไม่ใช่ Project Manager Leadทั่วไป
ในยุคที่ AI สามารถสร้าง spec, wireframe และ report ได้ในไม่กี่นาที
คุณค่าของ PM ไม่ได้อยู่ที่ “การผลิตเอกสาร” อีกต่อไป
บทบาทของคุณคือ:
👉 ตัดสินใจว่า “อะไรควรสร้าง” และ “ควรสร้างอย่างไร”
👉 ภายใต้ข้อมูลที่ไม่ครบ และบริบทที่ซับซ้อน
👉 ไม่ใช่แค่ผู้ที่ประสานงานให้ทีมสร้างตามที่ถูกบอก
คุณจะเป็นผู้นำทีม PMO (PM, UX/UI, BA, CS)
และออกแบบการทำงานให้ AI เป็น default workflow ของทุกโครงการ

รูปแบบการทำงาน: Hybrid work (WFH 1 Day/Week)
สถานที่ทำงาน : สำนักงานบางนา หรือ สำนักงานย่อยลาดพร้าว
ช่วง Probation จำเป็นต้องเข้าปฏิบัติงานที่สำนักงานบางนา

ความรับผิดชอบหลัก (Core Responsibilities)
1. Judgment & Decision-Making
• Judgment : ตัดสินใจว่า "อะไรควรสร้าง" และ "อะไรไม่ควรสร้าง" โดยอิงจากบริบทของลูกค้าที่ AI เข้าไม่ถึง

• Context Over Technicality: รู้ว่าเมื่อไหร่ควรเชื่อ AI และเมื่อไหร่ควร Override เพราะ "ความถูกต้องทางเทคนิค" ไม่เท่ากับ "ความถูกต้องตามบริบทธุรกิจ"

• Second-order Effects: มองข้ามช็อตว่าการเปลี่ยน Feature หนึ่งอย่างจะกระทบระบบภาพรวมอย่างไร

• Decision-Making :กล้าตัดสินใจเมื่อข้อมูลไม่ครบ 100%

2. Specification Precision (The Art of Directing AI)
• Unambiguous Intent: แปลงความต้องการที่คลุมเครือจากลูกค้าให้เป็น Specification ที่ชัดเจนระดับที่ AI Agents ทำงานต่อได้ทันทีโดยไม่ต้องถามซ้ำ (แปลง requirement ที่คลุมเครือจากลูกค้าให้เป็น unambiguous, machine-readable intent)

• Constraint-Based Thinking: ระบุ "ข้อห้าม" ให้ชัดเจนพอๆ กับ "สิ่งที่ต้องทำ" คาดการณ์จุดที่ AI จะ Hallucinate หรือไปต่อไม่ได้ ล่วงหน้า

3. AI-Native Workflow Design
• Systematic Workflows: ออกแบบกระบวนการทำงานที่ใช้ AI เป็นขั้นตอนแรก (First-step) และเป็น Default ไม่ใช่ขั้นตอนสุดท้าย หรือ ใช้ AI เสริมการทำงาน

• Quality Gates: สร้าง Prompt Templates และ Evaluation Checklists ที่ทีม (PM, UX/UI, BA, CS) สามารถนำไปใช้ซ้ำเพื่อลดเวลาและข้อผิดพลาดอย่างเป็นรูปธรรม

• Efficiency Benchmarking: กำหนดและวัดผล KPI ด้านประสิทธิภาพที่เกิดจากการใช้ AI (เช่น Lead Time Reduction, Error Rate) เพื่อปรับปรุง Workflow ให้ดียิ่งขึ้นอย่างต่อเนื่อง

• Hybrid Governance: แยกแยะชัดเจนว่าจุดใดใน Workflow ที่ AI ทำได้ 100% และจุดใดที่ต้องมี "Human-in-the-loop" เพื่อตรวจสอบความถูกต้องขั้นสุดท้าย

4. Taste & Critical Evaluation
• The Bar Raiser: ตรวจจับ AI Hallucinations และ Output ที่ "ดูดีแต่ผิดบริบท" ได้อย่างแม่นยำ

• Specific Feedback: ให้ Feedback ที่เฉียบคม (เช่น "Optimize ผิด Metric" หรือ "ขาด Political Dynamics") ไม่ใช่แค่คำสั่งกว้างๆ ว่า "ไปปรับมาใหม่"

5. Team Coaching & Portfolio Delivery
• Continuous Learning Velocity: นำทีมให้ Update ทักษะ AI ทุก 4-6 เดือน และสร้างวัฒนธรรม High Agency (ลงมือทำทันที ไม่รอสั่ง)

• Modern Delivery: บริหารโครงการภาครัฐ/เอกชนให้จบตาม Scope/Time/Budget โดยใช้ AI ทำ Forecasting และ Resource Planning แทนการทำ Report มือ

• ประสานงานข้ามทีม (Dev, Sales, ลูกค้า, Vendors) ใช้ AI ช่วย summarize, track action items, flag risks อัตโนมัติ

• สร้างกำไรให้บริษัท เข้าใจ cost structure, margin, และ AI cost-benefit analysis

คุณสมบัติที่เรามองหา (Qualifications)
• ประสบการณ์ 5+ ปี ด้านบริหารโครงการซอฟต์แวร์, 3+ ปี ในบทบาท Team Lead หรือ PMO

• มี track record ของการ ตัดสินใจที่ส่งผลกระทบต่อธุรกิจ — ไม่ใช่แค่ส่งมอบตาม spec

• เข้าใจ SDLC, Agile/Scrum และ รู้ว่าเมื่อไหร่ควรทิ้ง framework แล้วใช้ judgment แทน

• ประสบการณ์บริหารโครงการทั้งภาครัฐและเอกชน

• มีประสบการณ์ใช้ AI tools “ในงานจริง”

• สามารถเขียน prompt ที่ได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ใช้งานได้จริง

• สามารถ ตรวจจับ AI hallucination และ bias

• เข้าใจ capability และ limitation ของ AI ปัจจุบัน

• Coaching และ Mentor ทีมที่หลากหลาย (PM, UX/UI, BA, CS)

• สร้างวัฒนธรรมทีมที่เน้น judgment, learning velocity, และ accountability

• บริหารทรัพยากรให้เกิดประสิทธิภาพสูงสุด

• ทักษะสื่อสาร นำเสนอ เจรจาต่อรอง แก้ไขปัญหาซับซ้อน

• สามารถทำงานภายใต้แรงกดดันและความเปลี่ยนแปลง

พิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ
• เคย build หรือ direct AI agents/workflows ในงานจริง (ไม่ใช่แค่ใช้ chatbot)

• มี track record วัดผล AI impact ได้ (productivity, cost saving, quality improvement)

• ใบรับรอง PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe หรือเทียบเท่า

• ใบรับรอง ISO Lead Auditor

• ประสบการณ์ด้าน prompt engineering, AI evaluation, หรือ agent orchestration

• เคยสร้าง systematic AI workflows ที่ทีมอื่นใช้ซ้ำได้

ทำไมตำแหน่งนี้ถึงน่าสนใจ
• คุณจะได้ shape วิธีการทำงานของทั้งบริษัท ในยุคที่ทุกอย่างกำลังเปลี่ยน

• ทำงานกับโครงการทั้งภาครัฐและเอกชน — หลากหลาย ไม่ซ้ำซาก

• บริษัทกำลัง invest ใน AI อย่างจริงจัง — ไม่ใช่แค่ buzzword ใน JD

• มีโอกาสสร้าง AI-native PMO ตั้งแต่ต้น — ไม่ใช่ patch ระบบเก่า

สิ่งที่เราไม่ได้มองหา
• คนที่ยังคิดว่า AI เป็น "เครื่องมือเสริม" — ที่นี่ AI เป็น default ไม่ใช่ option

• คนที่วัดผลตัวเองด้วย "จำนวน meeting ที่เข้า" — เราวัดด้วย decision quality และ delivery outcome

• คนที่ต้องการข้อมูลครบ 100% ก่อนตัดสินใจ — ในโลก AI ข้อมูลจะไม่มีวันครบ คุณต้องกล้าตัดสิน

• คนที่ "ส่งเสริมการใช้ AI" แต่ตัวเองไม่ใช้ — Lead by example ไม่ใช่ lead by memo

jobs.title: Technology Risk & AI Governance Principal
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:
The Technology Risk & AI Governance Principal role provides independent second‑line oversight of the organization’s use of AI, ensuring alignment with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards. The role oversees technology and operational risk aspects of AI systems and provides risk‑based recommendations to the AI Council to support informed approval and ongoing use of AI solutions.
Responsibilities
• Governance & Oversight – Provide independent risk challenge to ensure AI solutions comply with governance frameworks, policies, and standards, and coordinate AI Working Group activities and reviews.

• AI Risk Management – Identify, assess, and validate AI specific risks (for example model, data, and usage risks) and work with designated risk owners to ensure appropriate mitigation.

• IT Risk Oversight for AI Systems – Perform second line review and challenge of non AI IT risks associated with AI systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise IT risk frameworks and Group AI standards.

• AI Resilience and Continuity Oversight – Deliver independent risk oversight and challenge over AI related operational resilience, continuity, and recovery readiness for business-critical AI use cases.

• Stakeholder Engagement – Engage with 1st Line technology, data, and business teams to provide guidance on AI risk considerations and control expectations.

• Reporting & Escalation – Communicate AI risk posture, emerging risk themes, and escalate material issues to AI governance forums and senior management as appropriate.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (advanced degree is an advantage).

• 6–10 years of total work experience, with exposure to AI/ML, data analytics, or technology‑enabled solutions.

• Experience in risk management, governance, compliance, or oversight roles is preferred, particularly within regulated or complex environments.

• Sufficient understanding of AI lifecycle, technology risk, and operational risk concepts to provide effective second‑line challenge and oversight.

· Own the Policy's change-control process — review for consistency, clarity and feasibility, and bring forward only targeted, rationale-backed amendments where it proves unclear, contradictory or impractical.
· Define the enterprise AI risk appetite with the AI & Data Committee, translate it into practical controls and templates, and design “fast lanes” so controls speed up low-risk adoption rather than obstruct it.
2. Data governance & classification
· Own the data-classification scheme for AI use (public / internal-with-masking / restricted) and the rules for which data may be used with which class of AI tool, including masking, anonymisation and synthetic-data standards.
· Enforce least-privilege and read-only-by-default principles for AI and agent access to data, files and systems.
3. Risk, compliance, privacy & security controls
· PDPA & privacy (with DPO): privacy impact assessments, data-subject rights, retention and deletion.
· Identity, data & network security: apply IAM controls (SSO, MFA, RBAC, joiner-mover-leaver, privileged-access review) to AI/agent accounts; translate data classification into enforceable DLP/masking rules; partner with IT Security and Architecture on egress, GCP controls (IAM, Secret Manager, logging) and SIEM monitoring.
· Risk-based approvals: operate the Low / Medium / High approval model as the coordinating gatekeeper for AI use cases.
4. Approved AI tools & use-case managemen t
· Own the Approved AI Tool Register and the use-case intake/approval workflow with clear SLAs, and assess new tools, plugins, connectors and MCP servers for risk before approval.
· Maintain the Use-Case Register — each with owner, purpose, data scope, controls, review date and kill-switch plan.
5. AI/automation SDLC, agentic AI & citizen-developer enablement
· Own the unified AI/automation lifecycle (idea → sandbox → production → decommission) with a Lightweight Path for low-risk use and a Managed Path for medium/high-risk use, plus a citizen-developer competency ladder (AI user → automation builder → certified citizen developer → technology-managed developer) with certification and revocation.
· Set guardrails for agentic AI and coding agents — least privilege, human-confirmation gates before merge / deploy / delete, segregation of duties (AI must not approve its own work), kill-switch, rate-limiting and rollback — and require secure-SDLC gates (SAST/SCA/secret-scan, prompt-injection testing) before release.
· Apply extra rigour to automation touching SAP / ERP or other financial systems — transaction integrity, reconciliation, approval-before-posting and segregation of duties — and oversee governance of agentic coding and collaboration tooling (currently Claude Code and Cowork) as adoption grows and the toolset evolves.
6. Monitoring, incident response & audit
· Define log sources, retention and alerting for AI/agent activity (SIEM-integrated) and detect/remediate Shadow AI (unapproved tools or personal accounts).
· Own the AI incident-response process — stop safely, preserve evidence, rotate credentials, notify IT Security / DPO within 4 hours, root-cause and remediate — jointly with IT Security and the DPO, ensuring audit logs and evidence are in place.
7. Enablement, training & culture
· Build and run the AI-governance training curriculum by audience (all staff, tool users, Technology, reviewers) and lead the BU AI Champion network as the central governance point of contact.
· Champion a “use AI fast, responsibly” culture, and define adoption/risk metrics (active users, time saved, override rate, incidents) without rewarding usage volume over safety or quality.
8. Vendor & third-party AI risk
· Assess AI vendors on data-usage terms, residency, certifications and DPAs; monitor model/API changes for control impact and maintain an exit plan to avoid lock-in.
· Work with Procurement and Legal on AI contracts, DPAs and sub-processor oversight.
9. Governance, audit & stakeholder leadership
· Act as operational lead to the AI & Data Committee — preparing risk reporting and escalations — and advise the MD/CTO on AI risk posture and investment priorities.
· Own the control-to-ITGC mapping (access, change, computer operations, backup/recovery, incident, vendor management, segregation of duties, evidence retention) supporting audit and IPO readiness, validated with Internal Audit / Finance, and represent AI governance to auditors, regulators and partners as required.

Required
· 10+ years in data governance, information security, risk & compliance, data privacy or technology governance, incl. 3+ years senior/leadership; genuinely strong in both data and control / policy / governance.
· Working knowledge of Thailand's PDPA sufficient to partner effectively with the DPO on privacy matters, and solid understanding of AI/agentic AI risks (data leakage, hallucination, prompt injection, over-permissioned agents).
· Working understanding of SAP / ERP or equivalent financial-systems risk (transaction integrity, reconciliation, segregation of duties) and of IT General Controls (ITGC) supporting audit / IPO-readiness mapping.
· Working command of security concepts across identity & access, data protection, application/agentic security and incident response, applied concretely — with cloud (e.g., GCP) and network control implementation delivered in partnership with the Cyber Security team.
· Demonstrated ability to write clear, practical policy and translate it into workable, adopted controls.
· Excellent stakeholder management and influence-without-authority across business, technology, legal, security and audit; professional working English, with Thai fluency preferred but not required for the right candidate.
Preferred
· Experience governing enterprise generative-AI deployments (Claude, Copilot, Gemini / Vertex AI) and citizen-developer / RPA programs (e.g. Robot Framework).
· Familiarity with AI-assisted software development, DevSecOps governance, MCP, connectors and agentic-engineering controls.
· Relevant certifications (e.g. CIPP/CIPM, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CDMP, ISO 27001 / 42001 lead) are a plus — a nice-to-have, not a substitute for hands-on experience.
· Background in retail, FMCG or multi-branch operations — a nice-to-have, not essential.

jobs.title: AI Governance Specialist
jobs.description:
Our Company
Do you want to be part of Thailand banking transformation? Data is the core of the new financial services era, and we are open for the opportunity to be part to drive this change at the core.
SCB DataX is a subsidiary of SCBx, the mothership of the financial technology business group comprising Siam Commercial Bank (SCB) and other subsidiaries, a leading financial services and digital services holdings in Thailand and ASEAN.
As part of the transformation of SCBx group of product and technology companies, under the SCBx brand, SCB DataX is the technology company to centralize data and provides AI/ML and data science services and products to the SCBX and its subsidiaries .
With a leading-edge cloud native data & AI platform, our vision is to support the group to providing everyone in our region with the opportunity to prosper.
We work on forward-thinking challenges of centralizing, analyzing and sharing information. We collaborate with companies and experts in many different domains, embrace diversity and all that while having a good laugh and joy in work.

About Team and Role
Staying ahead of AI risks, governance trends, and emerging technologies is critical for responsible AI adoption across SCBX. As part of the SCBX Data & AI Center of Excellence (COE), the Data & AI COE serves as a central intelligence function, tracking AI developments, gathering insights, and shaping SCBX’s AI governance strategy. This role collaborates with SCBX subsidiaries, DataX Model Risk Management, SCBX Data Governance COE, SCBX Data Privacy COE, Cyber COE, and Cloud COE ensuring AI risk intelligence is effectively integrated across the group.
The Specialist - AI Governance, Data & AI COE will be responsible for monitoring AI regulations, analyzing AI risk trends, engaging with industry experts, and operationalizing AI governance policies and standards. The role also includes developing risk assurance marketing materials to build confidence in DataX’s Group Data Zone and AI Platform, securing transparency and trust in AI-driven initiatives. Additionally, this position will lead AI education efforts, expert panels, and internal briefings to keep SCBX at the forefront of responsible AI adoption.

Your Responsibility
• Monitor global AI regulations and trends, ensuring SCBX remains compliant with evolving standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO, OWASP etc.).

• Conduct research on AI governance best practices across financial services industry, global and local regulations, and evolving trends.

• Design AI risk intelligence reports, newsletters, educational content, and awareness programs to enhance AI governance awareness across SCBX.

• Support group‑wide AI governance assurance and communication efforts, risk assurance marketing efforts, ensuring subsidiaries trust SCBX Data & AI COE’s AI governance and data security practices.

• Support organizing and coordinating of expert speaker sessions, AI roundtables, and industry engagements to strengthen AI governance knowledge within SCBX.

• Collaborate with Data governance, Data Privacy, Risk, and Engineering teams to translate AI insights into practical, implementable policies, standards, processes, and supporting artifacts.

• Support Model Risk Management (MRM) tooling and governance, including alignment of AI governance controls with model lifecycle workflows, model inventories, and risk assessment processes.

• Support data strategy alignment, ensuring observatory insights contribute to trustworthy data-driven decision-making and AI model governance across SCBX.

• Support communication campaigns and demonstrate how the Group Data Zone (GDZ) safeguards subsidiary data, including clear articulation of controls, assurance mechanisms, and governance processes , securing trust in DataX as a secure and responsible AI data processor.

Qualifications
• Proven expertise in AI governance, data strategy, analytics, or AI risk management, with a strong track record in monitoring and analyzing AI/ML trends.

• Overall 7+ years of experience with hands-on experience in risk assessment, regulatory analysis, model governance or a related field.

• Experience in developing AI/ML driven strategies, implementing analytics frameworks and/or model governance, and leading cross-functional teams and working in complex, multi‑stakeholder or group‑wide environments.

• Strong ability to bridge business, technology, and governance functions, ensuring AI insights translate into actionable enterprise policies.

• Experience in event management, risk assurance socialization, or industry engagement is an advantage.

• Solid technical familiarity with data infrastructure, analytics tools, and AI model development/validation.

• Formal education in AI/ML, Data Science, Risk Management or other numerical disciplines is preferred but not required if equivalent practical experience is demonstrated.

The Senior Data Scientist plays a key role in designing and delivering AI, machine learning, and automation solutions that drive business impact across retail and digital transformation initiatives. • Implement and support MLOps practices including model deployment, monitoring, retraining, and CI/CD workflows.
• Develop GenAI/LLM-based applications and automation tools to improve operational efficiency.

• Experience with big data processing and cloud platforms such as PySpark and Azure Databricks.
• Strong understanding of statistics, forecasting, experimentation, and model evaluation.
• Experience with MLOps, model deployment, and monitoring processes.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to business stakeholders.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with GenAI, LLM applications, prompt engineering, or RAG pipelines .
• Understanding of data governance and PDPA considerations.
• Experience mentoring or leading junior team members.
• Certifications in AI, Cloud, or Data Science are a plus.
Benefits

• Work on high-impact AI and machine learning initiatives within a leading retail organization.
• Build and deploy real-world AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a modern, cloud-native technology environment.

Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
As a Senior Solution Architect at Tencent Cloud in Thailand, you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption and success of Tencent Cloud services in the region. This position requires a blend of technical acumen, customer-facing skills, and strategic thinking. You will work closely with clients and partners to understand their needs, develop tailored cloud solutions, and ensure successful implementation. Your expertise will contribute to shaping Tencent Cloud's product offerings and go-to-market strategies, making a significant impact on the business landscape in Thailand.

What You Can Do Here
1. Accelerate your growth with an international perspective, engage with top-tier Southeast Asia customers, and deeply participate in the most cutting-edge AI needs of the Southeast Asia market and the continuously evolving cloud industry solutions.

2. Master the latest cloud product capabilities in a full-stack manner - across IaaS, AI, audio/video, security and other product lines. Through project co-building with Southeast Asia customers, continuously improve human-AI collaboration capability and customer project success efficiency.

3. Work closely with a diverse, excellent team in Southeast Asia, and jointly embark on a rapidly changing high-growth journey.

• Serve as the customer's technical consulting expert. Lead Tencent Cloud pre-sales analysis, bidding document authoring, and customer solution communication, and strive to obtain support from the customer's technical decision-making level.

• Deeply explore and follow up on the landing of customer needs. Combined with Tencent Cloud public cloud, private cloud, container, big data, audio/video, AI and other product capabilities, design technical solutions for Thailand SVIP customers and follow up on delivery, continuously strengthening differentiated competitive advantages.

• Possess an AI-Native perspective, be proficient in Tencent Cloud AI product knowledge and effectively promote it. Use AI capabilities to complete project POCs and demos, accelerate migration and delivery, and monitor SVIP customer business quality.

• Promote scaled business growth in key markets. On a daily basis, collect real feedback and industry common needs from Thailand customers, and drive continuous iteration and optimization of cloud products and AI tools.

Who We Look For

• Bachelor's degree or above; majors in computer science, information technology, telecommunications engineering and other related fields are preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in cloud computing pre-sales or solution-related work, covering pre-sales research, bidding document authoring, POC implementation, delivery acceptance, and other project phases.

• Familiar with mainstream public cloud platforms, such as Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc. Have experience using AI technology to assist and drive projects; familiar with at least one AI Agent application and have effectively applied it in work.

• Extremely strong pressure resistance and resilience. Proactively tackle project technical risks and AI implementation challenges, with no shirking or escaping. Take real business results as the sole orientation, and refuse to stay only at paper-level solutions.

• Excellent cross-cultural communication and collaboration ability; fluent English with no barriers to business communication; adapt to the collaboration rhythm of multi-country teams. Thai language proficiency is preferred.

• Strong proactive collaboration awareness; willing to undertake cross-department collaborative work, with no division of work boundaries, and project success as the core goal.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

As a Data Scientist, you will contribute to analyzing complex datasets, developing machine learning models, and deriving insights to enhance our products and services. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business problems that can be addressed through data analysis and modeling. Your proficiency in statistical techniques, machine learning, and data visualization will support data-driven decision-making within the company.

Data Analysis and Modeling:
• Analyze and interpret large and complex datasets using statistical and data mining techniques to identify insights, patterns, and trends.

• Develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms to enhance products and services.

Business Problem Solving:

• Contribute to ensuring data quality and accuracy through data cleansing, validation, and transformation processes.

User Communication

• Get insight from communicating with user to increase product and service quality.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
We are an AI-focused tech provider under Muangthai Group Holding, with a mindset of a technology start-up. We are looking to bring many proven best-in-class AI-powered products and solutions to various businesses. If you are self-motivated, want to be part of the new trend of technology and make a real impact, join us to be part of the growth story.
Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable next-generation data intelligence platforms that support AI agent utilization of data as well as traditional analytics, reporting and decision making for business. You will develop reliable data pipelines, design data lake, lakehouse, and warehouse architectures, work with both structured and unstructured data, build well-structured data models, and support multiple teams in using data effectively. You will work closely with data scientists, analysts, software engineers, business teams, and platform teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, well-modeled, and production-ready.
Data Platform & Architecture
• Design, build, and maintain scalable data platforms, including data lakes, data lakehouses, and data warehouses for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.

• Define data architecture patterns for raw, staging, intermediate, curated, and serving layers.

• Design data ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines for batch and near-real-time use cases.

• Develop pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources, including tabular data, JSON, logs, documents, and text-based data.

• Develop reliable data pipelines that support analytics, dashboards, machine learning, and downstream applications.

• Ensure data platforms are scalable, cost-efficient, secure, and maintainable.

Data Modeling & Data Layer Design
• Design and implement data models that support business reporting, analytics, and machine learning use cases.

• Build and maintain well-structured data layers, such as bronze/silver/gold or raw/staging/mart layers.

• Apply data modeling best practices, including dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and reusable data marts.

• Define clear data contracts, naming conventions, documentation standards, and data ownership practices.

• Work with business and analytics teams to translate requirements into reliable and reusable data models.

Data Pipeline Development
• Develop production-grade data pipelines using Python and SQL.

• Build transformation workflows using tools such as dbt or SQLMesh.

• Build and manage orchestration workflows using Dagster, Airflow, or similar tools.

• Implement data quality checks, validation rules, monitoring, alerting, and failure recovery mechanisms.

• Optimize pipeline performance, cost, and reliability.

Cloud & Infrastructure
• Build and maintain cloud-ready data solutions; experience with AWS cloud services is a plus, but not required.

• Work with AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, RDS, and IAM when applicable.

• Design secure and efficient access patterns for data storage, processing, and consumption.

• Collaborate with infrastructure or DevOps teams to deploy, monitor, and operate data pipelines in cloud environments.

• Follow cloud security, governance, and cost optimization best practices.

Cross-Team Support & Collaboration
• Support data scientists, analysts, business users, and engineering teams with data availability, data quality, and pipeline reliability.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and turn them into scalable technical solutions.

• Provide technical guidance to team members on data engineering best practices.

• Review data pipeline designs, SQL logic, data models, and production readiness.

• Troubleshoot data issues, pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data quality problems.

• Contribute to improving data engineering standards, reusable components, and internal documentation.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.

• At least 4 years of hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, or similar role.

• Strong proficiency in Python for data pipeline development, automation, and data processing.

• Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, joins, window functions, CTEs, performance tuning, and data transformation logic.

• Experience designing and implementing data lakes, data lakehouses, or data warehouses.

• Experience with modern data transformation frameworks such as dbt or SQLMesh.

• Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, data layers, data marts, and analytical data design.

• Experience with cloud-based data architecture; AWS cloud experience is a plus, but not required.

• Understanding of data quality, data validation, monitoring, logging, and pipeline observability.

• Ability to work with cross-functional teams and translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug complex data issues.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, RDS, and IAM.

• Experience with lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.

• Experience with CI/CD practices for data pipelines and analytics code.

• Experience with version control using Git.

• Experience designing data solutions for machine learning, feature engineering, or model inference pipelines.

• Experience with vector databases such as Qdrant or similar tools for embedding storage, similarity search, or AI application use cases.

• Experience with data governance, metadata management, lineage, and access control.

• Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading technical implementation within a data team.

• Understanding of knowledge graph and ontology concept.

Soft Skills
• Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of data engineering solutions.

• Strong collaboration mindset and willingness to support multiple teams.

• Attention to detail, especially around data quality, reliability, and maintainability.

• Ability to balance business needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.

Why work with us?
• Competitive salary

• Bonus subject to performance and company financial results

• Health and life insurance plan

• Provident fund

• Flexible working hours and work environment

• Company sponsored laptop

• Annual health check-up

• Sponsored online courses and career development programs

About the Role
S.B.J. Construction Contractor Co., Ltd. has recently changed its company name to S. J. D. Development Co., Ltd., while retaining the same legal registration. This role is suitable for a person who is highly curious, organized, detail-oriented, and genuinely interested in using AI to solve real business problems.
The successful candidate will work closely with senior management and help develop practical systems that support business development, construction, real estate, sourcing, and international partnerships.
Key Responsibilities
• Research markets, industries, competitors, suppliers, factories, and business opportunities in Thailand and overseas.

• Develop and maintain the SJD China Business Atlas, city database, industry database, and supplier directory.

• Organize business information into clear reports, tables, presentations, infographics, and executive summaries.

• Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve research, documentation, presentation, and operational workflows.

• Prepare professional PowerPoint presentations, company profiles, proposals, reports, and business documents.

• Build and maintain reusable company templates, document standards, and digital asset libraries.

• Manage structured databases using Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools.

• Verify information carefully and provide reliable references and sources.

• Support the Managing Director with strategic research and executive-level information.

• Coordinate with graphic designers, web developers, suppliers, and external specialists when required.

• Continuously identify new AI tools and practical applications that can improve company productivity.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Architecture, Information Technology, Marketing, Data Analytics, Communication, Graphic Design, or a related field.

• Fresh graduates with strong AI, research, and presentation skills are welcome to apply.

• One to three years of relevant experience is an advantage.

• Good command of written and spoken English.

• Strong internet research, analytical, and information-organizing skills.

• Able to use ChatGPT or other generative AI tools effectively.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.

• Experience with Canva, Google Workspace, Figma, Power BI, Notion, or Adobe software is an advantage.

• Able to create clear, professional, and business-ready documents.

• High attention to detail and willingness to verify facts before submission.

• Self-motivated, responsible, and able to work independently.

• Open-minded, ethical, adaptable, and eager to learn new technology.

Employment Arrangement

• The candidate may work remotely but must be available for scheduled online meetings and occasional meetings in Phuket.

• Work performance will be evaluated based on agreed deliverables, quality, accuracy, and the ability to build reusable business systems.

Initial Projects

• Corporate presentation and proposal templates

• SJD knowledge management system

Application Requirements

• Updated resume

jobs.title: Product & Solution Design & Development Manager/Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Product & Solution Design & Development Manager/Senior Manager, Corporate Learning & Capability Transformation

Role Purpose
Own the design and development of IRIS’s L&CT solution portfolio — both the productized offers that give the practice scalable, differentiated IP, and the bespoke solution architectures behind major client engagements. The role converts consulting insight (from IRIS’s O&P work in organization design, performance management, and AI transformation) into capability transformation products: capability academies, leadership and functional development journeys, reskilling programs, assessment and diagnostic instruments, and AI-enabled learning experiences. Success is measured by portfolio quality and win-rate contribution, client capability outcomes, and the reusability and margin of the IP created — not by course volume.

Key Accountabilities
1. Portfolio strategy & productization
• Portfolio architecture: Define and manage the L&CT offer portfolio — flagship products, modular components, diagnostics, and delivery formats — with a clear point of view on where IRIS plays and how it differentiates from content licensors and course marketplaces.

• Product development: Take offers from concept to launch: market and client research, value proposition, capability architecture, learning experience design, pilot, and commercialization (pricing inputs, collateral, sales enablement).

• IP codification: Build reusable IRIS IP — frameworks, playbooks, simulations, toolkits, assessment instruments — that raises delivery quality and margin, and reduces dependence on individual facilitators.

• Portfolio economics: Manage build-vs-partner-vs-license decisions (global content, platforms, faculty) and track product performance: attach rates, delivery margin, client outcomes, and refresh cycles.

2. Solution architecture for major pursuits & engagements
• Deal solutioning: Serve as the design authority on major pursuits with the Business Development team: translate client diagnostics into solution blueprints, learning journey maps, operating models for academies, and measurement frameworks — under proposal-grade time pressure.

• Consulting linkage: Design solutions that begin from organization and business analysis — strategy, operating model, role and skill architecture — so that learning interventions are wired to real performance requirements, not generic competency lists.

• Beyond 70:20:10: Architect blended capability systems: applied projects and business challenges, coaching and manager enablement, communities of practice, AI-assisted practice and feedback, and on-the-job performance support — with formal learning as one component, not the product.

3. Learning experience design & development leadership
• Design standards: Set and uphold IRIS’s design standards for adult learning: evidence-based methods, experiential and simulation-based approaches, Thai-context localization, and executive-grade materials quality.

• Development orchestration: Lead multi-disciplinary development — instructional designers, SMEs, facilitators, external partners, and AI/digital tools — to build programs on time and on budget; personally craft the highest-stakes assets.

• AI-enabled learning: Embed AI across the product lifecycle: AI-assisted content development, personalization, skills diagnostics, simulation/role-play tools, and analytics — and design offers that build client AI capability itself.

4. Impact measurement & continuous improvement
• Outcome frameworks: Design measurement into every solution — behavioral KPIs, capability baselines, business-metric linkage — so IRIS can evidence capability shifts and P&L contribution, not attendance and satisfaction scores.

• Learning loops: Run structured post-engagement reviews; feed delivery insights, client feedback, and win/loss analysis back into product refreshes and new offer development.

5. Practice & capability building
• Faculty & partner network: Curate and develop the facilitator, coach, and SME bench; define certification standards for delivering IRIS IP.

• Team leadership: (Senior Manager) Build and coach a small design and development team; establish tooling, templates, and a product management cadence for the practice.

• Thought leadership: Represent IRIS’s design point of view in client workshops, publications, and market events, in partnership with Business Development.

Experiences — What a Strong Candidate Has Done
• 7–12+ years across learning solution design, capability/OD consulting, or learning product management, with at least 4–5 years designing enterprise-scale solutions for large corporates (Manager: ~7 years; Senior Manager: ~10+).

• Has designed and shipped end-to-end capability programs — corporate academies, leadership pipelines, functional capability builds, or large reskilling programs — from diagnostic through architecture, build, pilot, and scale, ideally for SET-scale Thai corporates or regional enterprises.

• Has productized learning IP: turned bespoke work into repeatable offers with defined components, pricing logic, and sales enablement — and can speak to adoption and margin results.

• Has worked at the seam between consulting and learning: comfortable starting from strategy, operating model, or role/skill architecture and deriving development solutions from it (candidates who have only adapted licensed content or built standalone courses are unlikely to be a fit).

• Demonstrated design range beyond classroom and e-learning: applied/action learning, simulations, coaching architectures, communities, performance support, and blended digital journeys.

• Hands-on experience using AI in learning design or delivery — content generation, personalization, skills assessment, or AI tutors/simulations — and a defensible point of view on where it creates real value.

• Has led design teams and orchestrated SMEs, facilitators, and vendors under proposal and delivery deadlines; experienced in supporting sales pursuits with solution blueprints and pitch content.

• Familiarity with the Thai market’s current design paradigms — global licensed-content models, experiential leadership-development models, and tech-skills bootcamp models — and clear ideas on how to design beyond them.

Required Qualifications & Attributes
• Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s in learning sciences, HROD, organizational psychology, business, or related field preferred. Certifications in relevant methodologies (e.g., design thinking, assessment tools, coaching, agile product management) are a plus.

• Native/fluent Thai and professional-level English; able to design bilingual solutions and present design rationale to executive committees in both languages.

• Deep grounding in adult learning and capability development science — and equal fluency in business strategy and operating models, so that designs are commercially and organizationally literate.

• Product mindset: portfolio thinking, MVP/pilot discipline, user research, and lifecycle management applied to learning solutions.

• Excellent conceptual and visual communication: can turn a messy client problem into a clear capability architecture, journey map, and storyline — at consulting-deck quality.

• High standards of craft and detail under deadline pressure; collaborative operator across BD, delivery, and client teams; intellectually curious about AI, skills, and the future of work.

Work Location: IRIS Consulting, 12A Pearl Bangkok, BTS Ari

jobs.title: Technology Owner – Fraud Department
jobs.description:
The Technology Owner serves as the technology lead within the Fraud Department, translating fraud investigation and operational requirements into scalable technology solutions. The role owns the technical architecture, data platform, AI solution deployment, cloud infrastructure, and vendor coordination supporting the department's fraud detection capabilities.
Working closely with Fraud Operations, IT, Digital, Security, POS, and external technology partners (e.g. Edvent AI), the Technology Owner ensures that fraud technology solutions are designed, integrated, governed, and operated according to enterprise standards while remaining aligned with business objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Strategy & Solution Ownership
• Own the overall technology roadmap for fraud detection, investigation, and operational platforms.

• Define the technical architecture for AI-powered fraud detection systems, investigation portals, data platforms, and supporting operational tools.

• Evaluate and introduce new technologies that improve fraud detection accuracy, investigation efficiency, and operational scalability.

• Translate business requirements from Fraud Operations into technical solution designs and implementation roadmaps.

AI Platform & Vendor Management
• Act as the technology owner for externally developed AI solutions, including computer vision, audio analytics, and machine learning platforms.

• Review technical designs, deployment plans, release readiness, and production support activities delivered by external vendors.

• Coordinate acceptance testing, technical governance, and ongoing operational improvements.

• Monitor vendor performance, cloud resource utilization, and outsourced technology costs.

Cloud & Production Architecture
• Own production architecture for fraud technology solutions deployed on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Define standards covering:

• environment separation (Development, Testing, Production)

• security architecture

• IAM and access control

• service account design

• monitoring and observability

• deployment architecture

• operational resilience

• Coordinate with Infrastructure, Security, and Platform teams to ensure production systems comply with enterprise technology standards.

Data Platform Ownership
• Define fraud data architecture spanning CCTV, POS, HR, investigation data, video metadata, AI inference outputs, and operational logs.

• Work with internal application teams (e.g. POS, CCTV, HR, Digital) to establish data specifications, business identifiers, and integration standards that enable reliable downstream analytics through proper data modeling and PK/FK relationships.

• Ensure fraud analytical datasets are trusted, reusable, and scalable rather than relying on fragile operational workarounds.

• Oversee the design and evolution of business-ready datasets supporting fraud investigations, dashboards, operational reporting, and AI models.

Fraud Technology Operations
• Oversee the technical operation of fraud systems including:

• AI inference services

• investigation portals

• data pipelines

• operational monitoring

• workflow automation

• evidence management platforms

• Drive continuous improvement of operational tooling to increase investigator productivity and reduce manual effort.

Governance & Data Management
• Support the Fraud Director in managing fraud-related information assets including CCTV footage, video metadata, investigation records, and AI-generated outputs.

• Coordinate data access, sharing, retention, archival, and lifecycle management with centralized IT and governance teams.

• Ensure fraud technology solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, and governance policies.

Cross-Functional Leadership
• Act as the primary technology representative for the Fraud Department when working with IT, Digital, Infrastructure, Security, Data Platform, and external technology vendors.

• Align technical implementation with business priorities while balancing operational practicality, scalability, maintainability, and long-term technology strategy.

• Provide technical guidance during solution design, procurement, implementation, and production operations.

Why This Role Exists
Fraud detection is fundamentally a business capability enabled by technology. Success depends not only on AI models, but on robust system architecture, trusted data, secure cloud operations, and close alignment between fraud investigators and technology teams.
This role exists within the Fraud Department—rather than a centralized technology function—to ensure technology decisions are driven by a deep understanding of fraud operations while maintaining enterprise engineering standards. By owning the end-to-end technology landscape, the Technology Owner enables the department to scale AI-driven fraud detection, improve investigation efficiency, and deliver sustainable long-term technology capabilities.

jobs.title: Software Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Imagine being responsible for the integration of enterprise systems to On-Premises and Cloud instances of SAP Products and Non-SAP products for the world’s largest jewellery brand. If you love implementing seamless system integrations, then you might be our next Integration Engineer in Crafting & Supply

We love that you will…
• Assist in developing and maintaining system integrations between on-premises and cloud-based platforms.

• Use programming skills in C# and Python to support the creation of data transformation scripts, automation tools, and integration components.

• Analyse and understand existing integration workflows, data mappings, and system interactions to build foundational knowledge and support enhancement or maintenance activities.

• Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues by identifying root causes, reviewing logs, and collaborating with senior engineers or support teams to ensure minimal disruption to manufacturing operations.

• Integration patterns (e.g., message routing, data mapping, transformation) that ensure reliable and accurate data exchange across systems.

• Support the configuration and use of adapters/connectors such as REST, SOAP , FTP/SFTP, HTTP, and JDBC to enable communication between diverse enterprise applications.

• Assist in implementing security best practices including data encryption, secure file transfer, and token-based authentication for integration processes.

• Participate in transforming data between formats like JSON, XML, and CSV, validating the accuracy and completeness of information exchanged.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including IT, process engineers, and business analysts to understand integration requirements and contribute to effective solutions.

• Help maintain documentation of integration workflows, data mappings, and technical processes for internal use and future reference.

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of reusable scripts and components using C#, Python, or JavaScript to improve integration efficiency and standardization.

• Learn and begin working with event-driven messaging tools (e.g., Kafka, Azure Event Grid) for real-time data processing and alerts.

• Stay updated with new integration tools and platforms, contributing ideas and research to support continuous improvement of integration practices.

We love that you are…
· At least 2 years of experience in software integration /software development
· Familiar with programming languages such as C#, Python or JavaScript and comfortable working with data formats like JSON, XML and CSV
· Exposed to integration concepts and tools (e.g., REST, SOAP, FTP/SFTP, APIs, microservices) with an eagerness to deepen your knowledge of enterprise integration patterns
· A strong problem-solver who enjoys troubleshooting technical issues and collaborating with others to find solutions
· Good English and Thai communication

Welcome to our Crafting & Supply
The magic happens at our crafting facilities, where we combine centuries-old crafting traditions and high-quality materials with modern production techniques. You will be warmly greeted with over 13,000 craftspeople who are excellent at crafting and supplying the world’s largest jewellery brand with our craftsmanship. You will be part of a team of Software Integration people and report to the Director, Engineering.

Join a team that is as diverse and inclusive as our jewellery. We believe and value creative thinking and ensure that there’s equitable opportunities for all.

• Foster your growth and craft opportunities through our learning and development programmes.

• At Pandora, no effort or contribution goes unnoticed. We offer a wide range of opportunities and benefits to ensure that our employees feel valued, supported, and cared for.

• Transportation services are also available to drop you at the closet BTS station and other community areas.

About Pandora Crafting & Supply
Pandora started crafting its jewellery in Thailand in 1989, where our founders fell in love with the delicate craftsmanship of the Thai people. To date, there are two crafting facilities in Thailand, Bangkok, and Lamphun, and we employ more than 13,000 skilled craftspeople. By the end of 2024, there are 113 million pieces sold globally, all of which were hand-finished here in Thailand by our skilled craftspeople using high-quality raw materials and sustainable methods.

About Pandora Group
Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand. Designed in Denmark and crafted in Thailand, Pandora jewellery provides endless opportunities for personalisation, allowing people to express their passions and show who they are. The company’s products are made from high-quality materials and sold in more than 100 countries through 6,785 points of sale, including 2,788 concept stores.
Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and is sourcing lab-grown stones and recycled silver and gold for all its jewellery. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs 37,000 people worldwide, is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange, and generated sales of DKK 31.7 billion (EUR 4.25 billion) in 2024.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Fullstack Software Engineer
Location: Greater Bangkok, Thailand (Nonthaburi)
Reports to: Engineering Lead

About Us
We are a publicly listed consumer finance company (SET) with a mission to deliver essential financial services to the mass market, grassroots, and underserved communities. Though now an established company, we retain our original startup spirit. We are on a mission to grow 10X over the next decade and are looking for a real doer to join our team.
Our culture is defined by pace and passion. We are a team of doers who learn fast and deliver, and we know our success is powered by our people—our greatest asset. Our team of over 2,500 is fueled by the energy of younger generations, who form the majority with an average age of 28, complemented and guided by the expertise of our experienced Gen Y leaders. We seek innovators who are ready to create and build, not just maintain. We value those who act, deliver, and drive real change.
This action-oriented approach makes collaboration central to our work. We believe strong relationships are built through daily in-person interaction, which is why we operate as a fully in-office team. Our environment is vibrant, agile, and results-driven. While we respect those who seek a comfortable work-life balance, this is not that kind of role. We believe that creating anything truly great requires a level of dedication that mediocrity cannot match. We offer a place where you can accomplish in five years what might take others ten and make a tangible impact.

Key Responsibilities
• Fullstack System Design & Build: Design, develop, and deploy scalable, end-to-end features—from backend services to responsive frontends using modern technologies.

• AI-Driven Engineering: Master and steer AI-driven development. You won't just use AI assistants (like Copilot, Rocoode, Cline); you will critically guide, correct, and optimize their output to meet our high engineering standards.

• Performance & Scalability: Obsess over performance. Profile, benchmark, and optimize systems to handle massive, high-concurrency workloads.

• Code Quality & Best Practices: Champion best-in-class engineering standards. Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, and conduct rigorous code reviews.

• Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Partner with product managers and other units to translate complex business needs into simple, elegant technical solutions.

The Ideal Candidate: A Profile of a High-Impact Builder
We are seeking a true 'builder'—an engineer who is a first-principles problem-solver. You see code as a tool to create massive impact. You are a fullstack, systems-level thinker. You have already embraced AI as a force multiplier for your own talent and are driven to build best-in-class products.
Required Experience & Qualifications:
• Proven Engineering Experience: Both fresh graduates and experienced people are welcome. However you need to have a minimum 3 years of software engineering experience (e.g., direct working experience, complex personal projects, open-source contributions).

• Strong Educational Background: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field from a reputable university is required.

• AI-Driven Engineering (Mandatory): This is not about just using AI. This is about your proven ability to correct it. You must demonstrate how you critically review, steer, and take ownership of AI-generated code to ensure its quality, security, and performance.

• Strong CS Fundamentals: Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design.

• Technical Proficiency: Deep proficiency in modern, high-level programming languages and frameworks (e.g., C#, Python, Go, React, Vue). We value your ability to build robust fullstack systems and adapt to the right tools, not your knowledge of a specific list.

Essential Qualities & Skills
• First-Principles Thinker: You can break down complex, ambiguous problems into their core components and build solutions from the ground up.

• High-Ownership & Efficiency: You ship high-quality code efficiently. You take full ownership of your work, from initial concept to production and beyond.

• Intellectual Curiosity: You are obsessed with learning and are constantly exploring new technologies, paradigms, and better ways of building.

• Pragmatic & Results-Driven: You understand the balance between perfect code and shipping on time. You are focused on delivering tangible business value.

• Clear Communicator: You can articulate complex technical ideas clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Requirements
• This role is based full-time at our Headquarters in Greater Bangkok - Pak Kret.

• We need hard workers. We believe that building anything great requires a level of focus and dedication that is incompatible with a conventional "work-life balance." We explicitly reject this mindset because it does not lead to extraordinary outcomes. This is a role for those who are passionate about their work and are willing to dedicate the long hours required for deep, impactful analysis.

Compensation and Benefits
• Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

• The base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You will also receive access to comprehensive benefits, paid leave, and other company perks, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Our company is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence, and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, religion, gender, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

The Data Business Partner (DBP) acts as a strategic bridge between business teams and data/AI capabilities, helping identify, prioritize, and deliver AI, analytics, and automation solutions that create measurable business impact. This role works closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional technology teams to transform business challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities
• Partner with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize AI, analytics, and automation opportunities.
• Translate business needs into structured use cases, workflows, and actionable solution requirements.
• Drive end-to-end delivery of data and AI initiatives from ideation through adoption.
• Manage and prioritize delivery backlog in collaboration with product and technical teams.
• Facilitate Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews.
• Define and track business KPIs to measure solution impact and adoption.
• Collaborate with Data Engineering, Analytics, Governance, and IT teams to ensure solution feasibility and data readiness.
• Document business workflows, user journeys, and process improvements to support scalable transformation.
• Support continuous improvement through stakeholder feedback and usage insights.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
• 5+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
• Data Business Partner / Analytics Translator
• Product Owner (Data/AI)
• Digital Strategy or Consulting
• AI, Analytics, or Automation Delivery
• Strong understanding of business processes, data analytics, AI/ML, and automation concepts.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
• Ability to manage stakeholders and communicate effectively across business and technical teams.
• Experience defining business requirements, user stories, and KPIs.
• Familiarity with SQL, BI tools (e.g., Power BI), and data platforms is preferred.

Additional Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in retail, e-commerce, supply chain, HR, finance, or customer domains.
• Familiarity with AI/GenAI use cases and digital transformation initiatives.
• Experience with backlog management tools such as Jira and Confluence.
• Understanding of data governance and data quality principles.
Benefits
Why Join Us?
• Be part of a high-impact AI and data transformation journey.
• Work closely with business and technology leaders to shape strategic initiatives.
• Drive real business outcomes through AI, analytics, and automation.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a fast-growing digital transformation environment.
• Enjoy a flexible and hybrid working environment based in Bangkok.

jobs.title: Manager Commercial Systems
jobs.description:
Be a part of a revolutionary change
At Philip Morris Trading (Thailand) Co., Ltd. (PMTT), we’ve chosen to do something incredible.
With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy delivering better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

We are seeking a Manager Commercial Systems to lead the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of the digital platforms that power our commercial organization. If you think commercially, bring structure to ambiguity, and thrive in dynamic, international environments, this role offers strong exposure and meaningful impact.

Your Scope & Ownership
You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and execution with end-to-end ownership of commercial systems, including internal sales tools, large-scale Retailer CRM platforms, and AI-enabled initiatives, used by thousands today and scaling to more in the future.

You will drive impact by:
Strategy & Leadership
• Shape the commercial systems strategy and roadmap , aligned with business priorities and growth ambitions

• Translate commercial objectives into clear system outcomes, KPIs, and value cases

• Act as a thought partner to senior and international leaders , translating complexity into decisive actions while advising on digital and AI-driven opportunities

Delivery & Execution
• Lead large-scale initiatives using Scrum / Agile delivery models

• Ensure on-time, on-budget delivery with high adoption and measurable business impact

• Drive continuous improvement in sales productivity, CRM usage, and execution excellence

AI & Digital Transformation
• Lead AI and automation initiatives using enterprise-grade Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Copilot, ensuring solutions are scalable, widely adopted, and embedded into daily commercial workflows

• Identify, prioritize, and scale AI and automation use cases that deliver tangible commercial and operational value

• Turn AI solutions into practical ways of working , moving beyond experimental pilots to tools that are adopted and used consistently

Stakeholder & Change Management
• Navigate complex stakeholder landscapes across Sales, Trade Marketing, Commercial Planning, IT, Data, and Operations to drive alignment

• Lead change management to ensure successful adoption across large commercial organizations

People & Partner Management
• Lead and develop the team, fostering growth while guiding cross-functional initiatives to successful delivery

• Manage external vendors and system partners with clear governance, performance expectations , and accountability

Who we're looking for
• 7+ years of experience in digital transformation, commercial systems, product ownership, or related fields, including 3+ years in a people management role .

• Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in large or matrix organizations

• Strong commercial and business acumen , with a solid understanding of sales operations and route-to-market fundamentals , including field force execution, customer engagement, trade programs, performance management, and how systems drive revenue, efficiency, and execution excellence.

• Excellent communication skills in both English and Thai , with the ability to simplify complex topics for diverse stakeholders in a regional or international corporate environment

• Demonstrated ability to own initiatives from idea to measurable business impact

What we offer
Our success depends on anyone who brings to work a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join PMI and you too can:
• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress.
