jobs.title: Data Engineer (Manager Level)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Data Engineering leader looking to drive enterprise AI initiatives while leading high-performing teams?

Our client, a leading organisation undergoing a major AI and digital transformation, is looking for a Data Engineer Manager to lead the delivery of scalable data platforms that power AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics. This role combines delivery leadership with technical oversight, making it ideal for someone who enjoys enabling teams while maintaining engineering excellence.

What will you be doing?
As the Data Engineer Manager , you will own the successful delivery of data engineering initiatives while providing technical leadership to both the Data Engineering and Data Analytics teams.
Approximately 60% of your role will focus on delivery management—driving sprint execution, prioritising stakeholder requests, and ensuring projects are delivered on time. The remaining 40% will involve providing technical direction, establishing engineering standards, mentoring team members, and ensuring the delivery of trusted, secure, and reusable data products that support enterprise AI use cases.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Manage sprint planning, execution, and delivery across Data Engineering and Data Analytics teams.

• Prioritise workstreams in collaboration with business stakeholders, Product Managers, and AI teams.

• Lead the design and development of scalable batch and streaming data pipelines.

• Build and optimise modern data platforms, including data lakes and data warehouses, for AI and analytics workloads.

• Oversee data integration from ERP systems, IoT devices, APIs, external data sources, and unstructured data.

• Define engineering standards, data quality practices, metadata, lineage, and governance frameworks.

• Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and coaching.

• Establish best practices for CI/CD, cloud operations, security, and platform reliability.

• Support advanced AI initiatives including RAG pipelines, vector databases, and real-time inference.

• Continuously improve platform scalability, performance, security, and cost efficiency.

What we're looking for
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

• 7+ years' experience in Data Engineering, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams or managing technical delivery.

• Proven experience designing, building, and optimising scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines for batch and real-time data processing.

• Proven experience managing Agile delivery, sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement.

• Strong leadership experience mentoring Data Engineers and Analytics professionals while driving technical excellence.

• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL (Scala or Java would be an advantage).

• H ands-on experience with Apache Spark, Kafka/EventHub, Databricks, dbt, and Airflow.

• Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, and Cassandra.

• Experience working with cloud data platforms across AWS , Azure, or GCP.

• Strong understanding of data architecture, cloud-native data engineering, governance, security, and reusable data product design.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and people leadership skills.

If you're passionate about leading teams, delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, and enabling AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now or contact the Cathcart Technology team for a confidential discussion at 02-•••-•878 .

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Data & Micro Services) - 2 Years Contract
jobs.description:
About Us
SCB DataX is the data and AI company of the SCBX (SET: SCB.BK) group. Our mission is to provide the group’s companies the technology, tools, and insights to drive their growth, efficiencies, and customer experiences.
Our leading-edge, cloud-native data platform and AI products enable secure data exchange and cross-pollination of insights, as well as external data enrichment from our data partners.
Our research and development teams are building the next-generation solutions for sharing data and intelligence across the group companies, with the aim to become ASEAN’s most admired AI-led company, making material contribution to AI in our region.
We are proud of being awarded the Thai Board of Investment (BOI) promotion for the development of our state-of-the-art digital platform, and the recognition of our contribution to the Thai economy and tech community.

About Teams & Roles:
As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will ensure high-quality AI-driven data solutions and microservices. You will work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and developers, integrating testing into the agile software development lifecycle.
This role requires technical expertise in microservices, containerized environments (Docker), automation frameworks, and AI model testing. As a QA representative in the Scrum team, you will maintain quality throughout the project lifecycle by actively participating in test planning, execution, and continuous improvement.

Your Responsibility

You will be responsible for designing and developing a comprehensive QA program, which includes creating automated testing strategies and utilizing appropriate tools to ensure efficiency and coverage. You will design and execute usability tests, thoroughly documenting and reporting your findings to the design team. Interaction with clients may be required to understand their product requirements tho­­roughly.
• Own the QA role in the project by ensuring high standards of data quality, automation coverage, and microservice reliability.

• Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and developers to implement test strategies for microservices and AI models.

• Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases/scenarios, and test automation for applications built on microservices, including API and data pipeline testing.

• Understand AI model testing, including feature engineering, label engineering, and model validation.

• Participate in design reviews, providing input on requirements, product design, and potential issues.

• Ensure test planning, execution, and reporting maintain high quality and consistency.

• Track project status, report risks, and proactively anticipate and mitigate potential issues.

• Analyze test results, identifying performance bottlenecks, AI model inconsistencies, microservice defects, and usability concerns.

• Drive test automation by designing robust test scripts for microservices, APIs, and data pipelines.

• Guide and facilitate QA processes within the Scrum team, ensuring that testing activities align with sprint goals.

• Enforce quality control, proactively identifying risks, verifying requirements, and promoting test best practices.

• Generate reports on test execution status, defects, and automation results, while tracking quality metrics.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or other related fields

• Minimum 3 years of Quality Assurance engineering or similar role with extensive experience in automation frameworks and microservices testing.

• Proven experience developing and implementing QA plans.

• Up-to-date knowledge of software test design and testing methodologies.

• Proficiency in automation tools (e.g., Pytest, Testify, JUnit, Postman, Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright).

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Go,Python, Java, JavaScript – NodeJS, AngularJS, TypeScript).

• Strong experience with SQL, NoSQL, and data validation in big data environments.

• Experience in API and microservice testing. Knowing RESTful and GraphQL services is plus.

• Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized testing strategies.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and test automation in cloud-native architectures.

• Proficiency with Git for version control.

• Knowledge of Vector DB and AI-related development is a plus.

• Ability to guide and support QA activities within an Agile/Scrum team, ensuring comprehensive test coverage.

• Strong analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, and excellent communication.

jobs.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About ZILO
ZILO™ is a UK-based FinTech specialising in global asset and wealth management software, built to scale and transform businesses using our own AI technology. Our mission is to digitalise the future of the global asset management industry. We're a team of experts with decades of combined experience at leading global firms, working in a fast-paced, innovative environment where every individual drives real impact.
The Role
As Lead Site Reliability Engineer, you'll provide both technical and people leadership for the SRE team, owning day-to-day operations, technical direction, and engineering delivery. Reporting to the Director of Global Cloud Infrastructure, you'll translate strategic objectives into operational delivery — ensuring a resilient, secure, and highly available cloud platform.
This is a hands-on leadership role: approximately 70% of your time will be spent working alongside the team as an SRE (designing solutions, improving automation, supporting production), and 30% on leading the team (coaching, performance management, workload planning, on-call rotas, and career development). You'll lead from the front, not step away from engineering into pure management.
You'll also help shape the future of AI-assisted operations at ZILO, identifying ways to use AI to improve reliability engineering, incident response, automation, and engineering productivity.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership
• Lead the SRE team by example, staying hands-on and setting the standard for engineering excellence

• Mentor SREs and champion SRE principles across engineering

• Partner with Platform and Software Engineering to improve reliability, scalability, and operability

• Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices

People Leadership
• Coach and develop a high-performing SRE team; run 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development

• Manage workload, priorities, sprint commitments, holidays, and on-call rotas

• Recruit, onboard, and mentor new team members as the team grows

Production Operations
• Own reliability, availability, and performance of ZILO's production platforms

• Define and improve SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets

• Lead capacity planning and performance optimisation

Incident Management
• Lead technical response to high-severity incidents; coordinate post-incident reviews and RCAs

• Drive continuous improvement to reduce MTTD and MTTR

Automation & AI
• Eliminate operational toil through automation and self-service tooling

• Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI for operational efficiency and troubleshooting

• Champion responsible AI adoption across engineering

Observability
• Improve monitoring, alerting, and dashboards using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing

• Design meaningful, low-noise alerts

Operational Duties
• Participate in on-call rota and a rotational UK shift pattern for close collaboration with UK teams

• Support planned maintenance, releases, and out-of-hours changes as needed

Required Skills & Experience
Essential
• Significant experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or SRE, including several years in technical/team leadership

• Proven experience leading an SRE team in production

• Track record balancing line management with hands-on engineering

• Experience with performance management, coaching, and career development

• Experience managing on-call rotas and resource/workload planning

• Strong AWS experience; production Kubernetes (Amazon EKS preferred)

• Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred)

• CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions or similar)

• Observability platform experience (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse preferred)

• Experience running highly available, customer-facing SaaS platforms

• Strong networking, DNS, TLS, and load balancing knowledge

• Experience leading major incidents and RCA processes

• Hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar)

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management

• Willingness to join an on-call rota and rotational UK shift pattern

Desirable
• Financial Services / FinTech experience, ideally in regulated environments

• Experience with Karpenter, container security, and OpenTelemetry

• AWS Professional/Specialty or Kubernetes (CKA) certifications

• Chaos Engineering / resilience testing experience

• Experience building AI agents or agentic engineering workflows

Tech Stack
AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), Terraform, GitHub & GitHub Actions, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse, Linux, Docker, Python/Go/Bash, networking & DNS, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
Candidate Profile
You're a proven engineering leader who has led an SRE team before, passionate about building reliable cloud platforms and solving complex distributed systems problems. You believe great leaders stay close to the technology, thrive under pressure during major incidents, and lead by example rather than hierarchy.
Benefits
• 23 days annual leave

• 15 public holidays

• Provident Fund

• Health insurance (including immediate family)

At Symphony Communication Public Company Limited , we connect businesses through reliable, secure, and innovative telecommunications and digital connectivity solutions. We are seeking a highly skilled and results-driven Senior/Specialist OSS Developer for Network Automation to lead the design, architecture, and development of enterprise-scale network automation platforms. In this role, you will drive the digital transformation from manual workflows to intelligent, automated systems. You will be responsible for integrating OSS (Operations Support Systems) with complex network infrastructures, developing automated network checking services, and establishing AI-driven automation frameworks, large-scale monitoring, and real-time alerting platforms to maximize network operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

AI / Machine Learning / Rule Engines for predictive monitoring, intelligent alerting, and automated incident resolution.

• Network Knowledge (if have): Candidates with knowledge or experience in network operations, including MPLS, DWDM, Internet latency tuning, fiber infrastructure management, and network health validation, will be considered a strong advantage.

• Mindset: Exceptional system architecture thinking with a track record of driving scalable enterprise solutions and converting manual processes into intelligent automated workflows.

Preferred Competencies

• Strong UI/UX sensibility with experience designing user-centric dashboards that optimize operational visibility.

Why Join Symphony?

Driven by innovation, customer focus, and operational excellence, we continue to invest in advanced technologies and talented professionals who are passionate about shaping the future of digital connectivity.

jobs.summary: Founder's right hand at a 21-yr design agency. Drive Notion, ERP & AI projects with zero layers between you and the top. Learn fast, build real.
jobs.title: Founder's Associate
jobs.description:
You'll work side-by-side with the founder of a 21-year-old branding & packaging design agency as he rebuilds how the company runs — Notion, an internally-built ERP, AI tools, content. He built the systems. You make them real across 32 people.
No layers between you and the top. You'll see how every decision gets made, touch every department, and get your hands on AI tools daily. If you're early in your career and want compressed learning instead of a slow corporate ladder — this is that seat.
What You'll Actually Do
Your first 60 days — Notion + AI Platform (our ERP)
• Sit with every departments, capture how they work, and build their Notion workspaces.

• Learn AI — the ERP our MD built himself — inside out, and document it in plain Thai/English.

• Keep a live tracker: what's done, what's pending, what's blocked.

Days 61–90 — Rollout support
• Run check-ins with each department as they start using AI.

• Log bugs and friction points in a clean, standard format for the MD.

• Build simple how-to guides so adoption actually sticks.

Month 3 onward — AI + Content
• Test AI tools against real Square44 use cases; deliver one-page verdicts (what it does, what it costs, whether we should use it).

• Draft the monthly online content calendar for the MD's review.

• Keep Notion and Fable humming as the company grows into them.

How We'll Know You're Winning
• All department Notion workspaces documented.

• Weekly progress log delivered on time, every time.

• Full AI platform learned and documented.

• Every department checked in on at least bi-weekly.

• Issues logged within 24 hours of discovery.

You'll Thrive Here If You…
• Have 1–3 years in operations, project coordination, or founder's-associate-type work — or you're an exceptional fresh grad with proof of work to show.

• Live in Notion, Google Workspace, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and pick up new platforms in days, not weeks.

• Write things down by instinct — you structure information and make it findable without being asked.

• Can turn a bullet point into a finished draft — direction here is often a fragment, not a brief.

• Are genuinely excited to be the engine behind a founder's vision at this stage of your career.

• Communicate strongly in both Thai and English.

To apply: Send your CV plus one thing you've built, organized, or documented that you're proud of — a Notion page, a tracker, a guide, anything. We care more about proof of work than a perfect CV.

You'll own our Kubernetes platform and CI/CD pipelines and help push automation as far as it can go so development stays fast and friction-free. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role reporting to the Application Development Manager.

Key Responsibilities
- Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for continuous, automated delivery across development, staging, and production environments
- Manage Kubernetes clusters, Docker container deployments, and Helm chart configurations — ensuring stability, resource efficiency, and upgradability
- Design and implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions for both cloud and on-premise environments
- Monitor system health, performance, and reliability signals; respond to incidents and drive post-mortem analysis to prevent recurrence
- Own platform reliability engineering: capacity planning, load testing, and SLA monitoring
- Drive automation initiatives to eliminate repetitive manual work, reduce toil, and improve observability
- Establish and enforce security best practices for containerized workloads, secrets management, and network policies
- Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to reduce deployment friction and improve developer experience

Qualifications: (Must have)
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
- 2+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering
- Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm
- Proficiency with CI/CD tooling : Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent
- Scripting skills for automation: Bash and/or Python
- Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals
- Comfortable using AI tools for infrastructure scripting and automation — and able to review/validate AI-generated IaC before it goes to production
Nice-to-Have:
- Experience running Big Data workloads on Kubernetes (e.g., Spark, Kafka)
- Cloud platform experience: AWS, GCP, or Azure
- Monitoring & observability stack experience: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK
- Infrastructure-as-Code tools: Terraform or Ansible
- Familiarity with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
- Exposure to AI/ML deployment or MLOps practices

• A flat organization of people in their 20s — everyone on the team is in their 20s; decisions in a day

• Manage the enterprise IT project portfolio, prioritizing initiatives, optimizing resources, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to expected quality standards.

• Manage relationships with internal stakeholders, vendors, and external partners to ensure successful project outcomes.

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, regulatory requirements, and IT policies throughout the project lifecycle.

• AI Governance & Compliance: Establish and enforce AI governance frameworks, including ethical AI standards, data privacy compliance, risk assessment, and algorithmic accountability across all enterprise AI projects.

• AI Adoption & Change Management: Act as a strategic advisor to foster AI adoption across business units, identifying high-impact AI use cases while building capability and awareness within the project management team.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in IT Project Management, PMO, or related functions, including 3–5 years in a leadership or people management role.

• Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional IT projects and managing multiple initiatives from planning through successful implementation.

• Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and frameworks (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, PMBOK, Scrum) with experience driving project governance and delivery excellence.

• Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage risks, priorities, and project performance effectively.

• Experience in the leasing, banking, financial services, or automotive finance industry is an advantage.

• Proficiency in both Thai and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

• Solid experience in managing and delivering AI/ML, Data Analytics, or Advanced Automation projects from concept to production.

• Strong understanding of AI project lifecycles, lifecycle dependencies (e.g., data preparation, model training, evaluation, deployment), and agile delivery for data-centric projects.

• Familiarity with AI Governance, AI Ethics, Data Governance frameworks, and relevant regulatory requirements surrounding data and AI technologies.

• Ability to act as a bridge between technical AI development teams and non-technical business stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into business value.

About Team & Role The Sr. DevOps engineer will be a part of a cross-functional team responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure data platform and machine learning infrastructure in an enterprise environment. The Sr. DevOps engineers will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of DevOps best practices, implementing, and supporting DevOps tools. They will be responsible for improving the efficiency, reliability, and security of the systems while fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

Your Responsibility
• Design & Implement Observability Solutions:
Architect, build, and manage a comprehensive observability platform, integrating metrics, logs, and traces to provide a unified view of system health.

• Enhance Monitoring & Alerting:
Develop and refine our monitoring and alerting strategies using Grafana and Prometheus. Create meaningful dashboards and configure intelligent, actionable alerts with PagerDuty to minimize downtime and mean time to resolution (MTTR).

• Champion OpenTelemetry:
Lead the adoption and implementation of OpenTelemetry standards across our services to ensure consistent and effective distributed tracing and metric collection.

• Automation & Tooling Development:
Utilize your programming expertise in languages such as Golang or Python to build custom exporters, automation tools, and plugins that extend the functionality of our observability stack.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC):
Apply GitOps principles and IaC tools, such as Terraform, to automate the provisioning and management of our monitoring infrastructure on the Azure cloud platform.

• Collaborate and Mentor:
Partner closely with software engineering, operations, and data/AI platform teams to establish best practices for instrumentation and observability. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other team members.

• Incident Management & Response:
Play a key role in the incident response lifecycle, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and driving post-mortem processes to prevent future occurrences.

• Continuous Improvement:
Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, architectural risks, and opportunities for improvement to drive ongoing enhancements and improvements. Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in the observability space.

Qualifications
• 5+ years of professional experience in a related field such as Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Software Engineering with a focus on infrastructure.

• Deep, hands-on experience with Grafana for building dashboards and PagerDuty for incident management and alerting.

• Strong proficiency with cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure.

• Solid programming and scripting skills, with demonstrated experience in Golang (Go) and at least one other language (e.g., Python, Bash).

• Practical knowledge and experience implementing OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing and metric collection.

• Expertise in managing and working with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Loki, or the ELK Stack.

• Proficient with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and version control systems (Git, GitHub).

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

• Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools, particularly Terraform.

• Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible.

• Significant experience supporting large-scale Data Platforms (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Databricks) and/or AI/ML platforms.

• Experience with other major cloud providers (AWS, GCP).

• Knowledge of microservices architecture, serverless computing, and API gateways.

• A strong commitment to Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles.

jobs.summary: The Senior Data Platform Engineer builds the platform-services layer that turns the enterprise data platform into a product
jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
The Senior Data Platform Engineer builds the platform-services layer that turns the enterprise data platform into a product — API Gateway baseline, knowledge graph, event stream, semantic layer, data-product catalogue, vector search, anti-corruption-layer patterns, and the Python / TypeScript SDK framework that internal product teams consume. This is a senior software-engineering role focused on shipping platform capability with API contracts, SDKs, and governance baked in.

Key Responsibilities • Design, build, and operate the platform API Gateway baseline — authentication, rate limiting, observability, versioning, contract tests, deprecation policy.
• Build and operate the Knowledge Graph platform — schema design, ingestion, query API, scaling, observability — exposed as a platform service to internal consumers.
• Build and operate the Event Stream platform — domain-event topology, partitioning, schema registry, retention; integrate with downstream catalogue and KG.
• Build and operate the Semantic Layer service — business-meaningful query API on top of the lakehouse, consumed by internal product teams and AI agents.
• Build and maintain the Data Product Catalogue — data-product registration, freshness SLOs, schema contracts, governance hooks at publish time.
• Build and operate the Vector Search Service infrastructure (pgvector, Milvus, Qdrant, or comparable) — index, scaling, observability — partnered with AI engineering on embedding model selection and retrieval relevance.
• Author and maintain the Anti-Corruption-Layer Patterns Library — reusable patterns for legacy system integration (Oracle, SAP, WMS) via events and ACL only; never direct DB writes.
• Build and maintain the Python and TypeScript SDK framework — consumed by product teams and AI engineering for all platform-service calls.
Requirements
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• 8+ years software engineering with production ownership of platform services at multi-team scale.
• Strong Python (production services, async, observability) and TypeScript at senior level.
• API-first design discipline — OpenAPI 3.1, REST, gRPC; versioning, semver, deprecation policies, contract tests.
• Production experience with at least one of: knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Neptune, TigerGraph), event streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs), or vector databases (pgvector, Milvus, Qdrant).
• Distributed systems fundamentals — concurrency, message queues, idempotency, observability, performance.
• SDK / client library design for multi-language consumption; semver, breaking-change policy, documentation discipline.
• Cloud + Databricks (or equivalent lakehouse) production experience; Azure preferred.

Preferred Qualifications • Production knowledge-graph experience at scale (multi-million entities); semantic layer / data products in production.
• Multi-language SDK design across Python and TypeScript / Java; OSS library maintenance.
• Retail / commerce data integration — Oracle (RMS, RPM, PMS, SIM), SAP, WMS; strangler-fig patterns.
• Vendor certifications such as Databricks Data Engineer Professional, Azure Solutions Architect, or comparable.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Pipelines & Data Quality) - Data Platform
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to own the pipeline-standardization and data-quality program for the enterprise lakehouse. This role ships compliance gates that block non-compliant deployments, stands up the data-quality framework, builds the dashboards business users trust, and drives measurable reductions in data incidents across the retail data estate.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, ship, and operate a pipeline-compliance checker that validates naming, metadata, config schema, DQ-rule declarations, and cluster-policy reference on every new deployment.
• Deploy a data-quality framework (Great Expectations, Databricks DQ Rules, or equivalent) across new production pipelines; build a domain onboarding template; configure alert routing by severity.
• Build and publish the Data Quality Dashboard — quality health by domain, source, table; near-real-time refresh; freshness, completeness, accuracy.
• Establish Source Change Management agreements with key source systems (SLA contracts, change-request process, automated schema-change alerting); map source lineage end-to-end.
• Lead the migration playbook to bring the legacy pipeline estate to standard; mentor engineers executing migration; own the playbook, not every migration.
• Drive data-incident reduction through prevention (compliance gate, DQ framework, DCM, lineage), not reactive firefighting; lead incident response and post-mortems for major DQ failures.
• Partner with platform engineering on Event Stream domain-event schemas and data-product contracts.
• Author runbooks, code review at senior level, and contribute to engineering culture.
Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.
• 5+ years designing, building, and operating production data pipelines on a major lakehouse or warehouse (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery).
• Strong PySpark and SQL; understands Spark performance tuning at production scale.
• Deep experience with data-quality frameworks (Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda, Monte Carlo) — has defined SLAs, set thresholds, tuned alert noise.
• Built and operated medallion / multi-layer lakehouse architectures with explicit transformation layers.
• Solid Git / CI experience for data code; opinions on testing data transformations.
• Comfortable defining and enforcing standards (naming, partitioning, retention, PII tagging) and reviewing PRs against them.
• Cloud platform experience (Azure preferred; AWS / GCP transferable).

Preferred Qualifications
• Streaming experience (Spark Structured Streaming, Delta Live Tables, Flink, Kafka Streams).
• Data modeling discipline (Kimball, Data Vault 2.0) with clear rationale; Unity Catalog production experience (lineage, tags, RLS).
• Retail data exposure — POS, inventory, replenishment, loyalty — and BI optimization for Power BI consumption.
• Vendor certifications such as Databricks Data Engineer Professional or Azure Data Engineer Associate.

jobs.title: Senior Manager QA Engineering & Release Operations
jobs.description:
About Us
SCB DataX is the data and AI company of the SCBX (SET: SCB.BK) group. Our mission is to provide the group’s companies the technology, tools, and insights to drive their growth, efficiencies, and customer experiences.
Our leading-edge, cloud-native data platform and AI products enable secure data exchange and cross-pollination of insights, as well as external data enrichment from our data partners.
Our research and development teams are building the next-generation solutions for sharing data and intelligence across the group companies, with the aim to become ASEAN’s most admired AI-led company, making material contribution to AI in our region.
We are proud of being awarded the Thai Board of Investment (BOI) promotion for the development of our state-of-the-art digital platform, and the recognition of our contribution to the Thai economy and tech community.
About Teams & Roles
As QA Engineering & Release Operations Senior Manager, you will provide strategic leadership for DATAx’s Quality Engineering and Release Operations functions.
You will define and execute the organization's quality, release, automation, and AI transformation strategy, ensuring scalable operating models, strong governance, and measurable improvements in delivery performance across DATAx platforms and products.
This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, and Technology leadership teams to build future-ready quality and release capabilities that support business growth, operational excellence, and organizational scalability.
Your Responsibility
Strategy, Governance & Transformation
• Define and execute the QA Engineering and Release Operations strategy aligned with DATAx business and technology objectives.

• Establish organizational quality standards, governance frameworks, release controls, and operating models.

• Drive automation-first and AI-enabled transformation initiatives to improve quality, productivity, delivery speed, and operational efficiency.

• Build and mature future capabilities in Quality Engineering, Release Engineering, Automation Governance & Release (AGR), and AI-driven quality practices.

Quality, Release & Operational Excellence
• Govern quality assurance, testing practices, release readiness, and change management across DATAx platforms and services.

• Ensure effective quality gates, risk management practices, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance.

• Oversee organizational quality and release performance, driving continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Metrics, Insights & Executive Reporting
• Define and own QA and Release KPIs, quality intelligence, dashboards, and executive reporting.

• Utilize quality and operational metrics to identify risks, improve predictability, and support data-driven decision making.

• Provide strategic recommendations to leadership based on delivery, quality, and release performance trends.

Leadership & Organizational Development
• Lead QA and Release Engineering managers, team leads, and teams across in-house and outsourced resources.

• Drive workforce planning, succession planning, capability development, and organizational effectiveness.

• Oversee resource strategy, vendor governance, capacity planning, and budget management.

• Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and engineering excellence.

Stakeholder & Business Partnership
• Partner with Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, DevOps, and Business leaders to align quality and release objectives with organizational priorities.

• Act as a trusted advisor to leadership teams on quality, release, risk, automation, and operational excellence matters.

• Champion the adoption of automation, AI, and emerging technologies to support business outcomes and long-term scalability.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related fields.

• 10+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, QA, Release Engineering, or related technology delivery disciplines.

• At least 5 years of leadership experience managing QA, Quality Engineering, Release Engineering, or technology delivery teams.

• Proven ownership of quality, release, or delivery outcomes at program, portfolio, or organizational level.

• Strong experience in quality strategy, governance, delivery assurance, risk management, and operational excellence.

• Experience leading automation, AI, digital transformation, or process improvement initiatives with measurable business outcomes.

• Strong understanding of modern quality engineering practices, release governance, and software delivery lifecycle.

• Experience managing organizational budgets, workforce planning, vendor relationships, and capability development.

• Experience with data platforms, cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and AI-enabled solutions is highly desirable.

• Experience in banking, financial services, or regulated industries is preferred.

• Strong strategic thinking, executive communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities & Key Activities
1. Maintenance Planning and Execution
Responsibilities
Plan, coordinate, and execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure that all assigned systems, products, and equipment remain fully operational throughout the project lifecycle.
Key Activities
• Develop and implement maintenance plans in accordance with project schedules and customer requirements.

• Execute maintenance activities while ensuring compliance with approved procedures, technical standards, and project timelines.

• Inspect products, systems, and equipment to verify operational readiness.

• Monitor equipment performance and identify potential issues before failures occur.

• Verify the availability of spare parts, maintenance tools, and required resources prior to maintenance activities.

• Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance to minimize equipment downtime.

• Evaluate maintenance methods and recommend process improvements to enhance operational efficiency.

• Research emerging technologies and industry best practices for continuous service improvement.

• Perform product testing, maintenance verification, and functional validation following maintenance activities.

• Develop or revise maintenance procedures whenever operational improvements are identified.

2. Technical Documentation Management
Responsibilities
Prepare, maintain, and continuously improve technical documentation supporting maintenance operations and customer services.
Key Activities
• Develop maintenance manuals, technical work instructions, inspection procedures, and engineering documentation.

• Prepare preventive maintenance schedules and maintenance records.

• Maintain technical documentation in accordance with company document control procedures.

• Ensure all technical documents remain accurate, complete, and up to date.

• Produce maintenance reports and technical summaries for internal and external stakeholders.

• Prepare presentation materials and training documentation for customer training programs.

• Support preparation of technical documents required for project acceptance, inspections, demonstrations, and commissioning.

3. Technical Support and Customer Service
Responsibilities
Provide professional technical support to customers throughout the post-delivery service period while ensuring customer satisfaction and service excellence.
Key Activities
• Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues reported by customers.

• Analyze root causes of equipment failures and recommend corrective actions.

• Respond to customer technical inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

• Coordinate maintenance activities with customers to minimize operational disruption.

• Conduct on-site technical support when required.

• Perform product inspections and operational assessments.

• Deliver user training on product operation and basic maintenance procedures.

• Support customers during system testing, commissioning, and acceptance activities.

• Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers or relevant technical specialists when necessary.

4. Internal Coordination
Responsibilities
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and continuous operational improvement.
Key Activities
• Report maintenance status, technical issues, project progress, and operational risks to supervisors.

• Coordinate with Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Quality Assurance, and other related departments.

• Follow up on action items and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.

• Share technical knowledge and lessons learned with team members.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

• Utilize customer feedback to improve maintenance processes and service quality.

5. Documentation Control and Quality Compliance
Responsibilities
Maintain document accuracy while ensuring all maintenance activities comply with organizational quality standards.
Key Activities
• Prepare internal and external technical documentation.

• Maintain document version control in accordance with company procedures.

• Utilize centralized document management systems for information sharing.

• Review and update engineering documentation regularly.

• Prepare system performance reports and maintenance summaries.

• Ensure all maintenance records comply with quality management requirements.

• Support internal and external audits when required.

6. Customer Relationship Management
Responsibilities
Build and maintain long-term professional relationships with customers and project stakeholders.
Key Activities
• Deliver professional after-sales services with a customer-focused mindset.

• Maintain effective communication with customers throughout maintenance activities.

• Promote a positive corporate image through professional conduct.

• Address customer concerns promptly and effectively.

• Provide accurate information regarding maintenance scope and service agreements.

• Ensure customer satisfaction through timely issue resolution and high-quality service delivery.

Job Qualifications
Education
• Bachelor's Degree or higher in:
• Software Engineering

• Artificial Intelligence (AI)

• Radio Frequency (RF) Engineering

• Telecommunications Engineering

• Mechanical Engineering

• Electrical Engineering

• Electronics Engineering

• Computer Engineering

• Information Technology

• or other related engineering disciplines.

Experience
• Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

• Candidates with at least one year of relevant maintenance or engineering experience will be given special consideration.

Other Qualifications
• Good command of spoken and written English.

• Experience coordinating technical matters with international vendors is preferred.

• Experience in maintenance engineering or after-sales technical support.

• Experience working with government organizations or public sector engineering projects is an advantage.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Good interpersonal and communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.

• Strong customer service mindset.

• Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

• Flexible and adaptable to changing work environments.

• Willingness to continuously learn emerging technologies.

• Basic understanding of System Integration.

• Ability to read engineering drawings, technical diagrams, and system schematics.

• Understanding of government procedures, procurement processes, and public-sector project environments is advantageous.

jobs.summary: The Senior Data Governance Specialist builds and runs the data-governance tooling that makes the program real.
jobs.title: Senior Data Governance Specialist
jobs.description:
The Senior Data Governance Specialist is the senior individual contributor who builds and runs the data-governance tooling that makes the program real — the PDPA compliance scanner, the data-catalogue automation, the access-control sync, the AI model-governance evidence. This role makes policy technically true and measurable across the enterprise data estate.

Key Responsibilities • Design, build, and operate an automated weekly PDPA compliance scanner on data-catalogue assets — checking classification completeness, retention-tag presence, access-control alignment — and maintain machine-readable audit evidence ready for regulators on demand.
• Drive data-catalogue (Databricks Unity Catalog or equivalent) technical adoption — bulk registration tooling, classification tagging, lineage capture, metadata-quality checks — with measurable coverage targets.
• Implement automated Row-Level Security sync integrated with Azure AD; reduce access-ticket volume through self-service and automated provisioning.
• Maintain the AI model-governance register and operationalise governance directives into the model-deployment CI / CD gate; build and run the GenAI audit trail.
• Build and operate the schema-governance CI check — no unreviewed schema change reaches production; maintain the exception workflow and audit log.
• Implement the data-classification framework (public / internal / confidential / restricted) at scale; tie to retention and access policy; detect classification drift.
• Partner with Data Stewards as the technical enabler — build the tools they rely on (DQ triage UI, glossary entry flows, source SLA dashboards).
• Partner with the Data Protection Officer and Legal on enforcement, incident response, and audit cycles; co-own data-product governance with platform engineering.
Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.
• 5+ years total data-engineering / governance-engineering experience, with 3+ years on data governance tooling and compliance (catalog operations, access-control automation, classification, lineage).
• Strong Python — builds production services (scanner, CI checks, automations); solid SQL fluency; comfortable reading PySpark.
• Thailand PDPA literacy — translates a requirement into an automated control; GDPR or comparable regime experience welcome.
• Production experience with a data catalog (Databricks Unity Catalog, Collibra, Atlan, Purview, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent).
• Designed and implemented access-control automation in cloud data platforms (RBAC + RLS + IAM integration).
• Git / CI production discipline; cloud platform experience (Azure preferred).
• Can write a clear design doc and partner with engineers, legal, and security stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications • Hands-on Databricks Unity Catalog production experience (tags, lineage, RLS, system tables); AI Model Governance exposure (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act awareness, model-registry governance gates).
• Data contracts implementation (Gable, Schemata, or in-house); policy-as-code (OPA, Rego) or CI-based policy enforcement.
• ISO 27001 / SOC 2 evidence-collection experience; retail loyalty / POS data context (consent, PII at retail scale).
• Vendor or industry certifications such as Databricks Data Engineer Professional, DAMA CDMP, PDPA training (Thai DPO programme), or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (DevSecOps)
jobs.description:
Location: Bangkok (Hybrid)
About the Role:
Cathcart Technology is partnering with a fast-growing AI-driven tech company in Bangkok to hire a Security Engineer to help strengthen the security posture of their cloud infrastructure, containerised platforms, and engineering workflows.
You'll work closely with the DevOps, engineering, and product teams to build practical, effective security controls across cloud (AWS) and containerised environments, while supporting secure software delivery practices and compliance readiness. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys solving real security problems inside a fast-moving engineering team.
Key Responsibilities
• Design and maintain security controls across AWS infrastructure, including network segmentation, access control, secrets management, and hardening baselines

• Strengthen the security posture of Kubernetes and containerised workloads, including image scanning, runtime protections, and cluster hardening

• Build and maintain security gates within CI/CD pipelines — SAST, dependency scanning, container scanning

• Manage vulnerability assessment programs and coordinate remediation across infrastructure, container, and platform layers

• Support internal penetration testing and security validation activities

• Implement and maintain security monitoring, logging, and alerting (SIEM) across cloud and production environments

• Automate infrastructure security using Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Ansible)

• Support compliance initiatives and translate requirements into technical implementation and evidence

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field

• Hands-on experience in security engineering, DevSecOps, or cloud/infrastructure security

• Solid working knowledge of AWS security fundamentals (IAM, VPC, EKS, security groups)

• Experience with containerisation and Kubernetes in a production environment

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating security tooling into deployment workflows

• Comfortable scripting in Bash or Python to automate security workflows

• A background in DevOps or software engineering experience is a strong plus

• Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with engineering and product teams

Nice to Have
• Exposure to SIEM tooling, vulnerability scanning platforms, or internal pentesting

• Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001

If you are an experienced Security Engineer looking to make a real impact on the security of AI-driven technology, we would be glad to hear from you.
Please contact Cathcart Technology at 02-•••-•878 for further information.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Bangkok Based)
jobs.description:
Join Us!

Amity, through its AI Research and Application Center, is advancing the frontier of applied AI research across natural language processing, large language models, agentic systems and generative AI. We build intelligent products that serve millions of users and partner organisations across Southeast Asia and Europe. Our research engineers sit at the intersection of scientific inquiry and production engineering—discovering new methods, validating them rigorously, and shipping them into real-world products.

Your Impact:

As an AI Research Engineer at Amity AI Research and Application Center you will own ambitious research goals while ensuring that breakthroughs translate into scalable, production-grade systems.

You will:

• Identify high-impact research problems, formulate hypotheses, design experiments and advance the state of the art in areas aligned with the lab’s mission.

• Publish findings at top-tier conferences and top-tier leaderboard and contribute to the broader AI research community.

• Bridge the gap between research prototypes and production systems, ensuring novel methods are robust, efficient and deployable at scale.

• Shape the lab’s research roadmap and propose initiatives that create measurable business and societal value.

• Mentor junior researchers and engineers, fostering a culture of scientific rigour and collaborative innovation.

Your Day-to-Day:

Research & Experimentation

• Conduct original research in one or more areas: large language models , NLP, computer vision, reinforcement learning, generative models, agentic AI or multimodal learning.

• Design and run rigorous experiments—including ablation studies, benchmark evaluations and statistical analyses—to validate new methods and architectures.

• Survey, reproduce and extend state-of-the-art results from recent literature; maintain a reading group culture within the team.

• Develop novel algorithms, model architectures and training strategies that push performance boundaries on real-world tasks.

Model Development & Optimisation

• Design, train and fine-tune large-scale deep learning models (LLMs, diffusion models, multi-modal models) using modern frameworks such as PyTorch, TRL, Unsloth or verl. (Reinforcement Learning Experience is plus)

• Optimise model performance through techniques such as knowledge distillation, quantisation, pruning, mixed-precision training and efficient attention mechanisms.

• Build and improve training infrastructure for distributed, large-scale model training across GPU/TPU clusters.

• Develop evaluation frameworks and metrics to systematically measure model quality, safety and robustness.

Applied Research & Productionisation

• Translate research outcomes into production-ready features—building proof-of-concepts (PoCs), prototypes and scalable AI services.

• Design and operate RAG pipelines (ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, re-rankers) with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch) to support retrieval-augmented applications.

• Architect and ship LLM-powered agents and chatbots using agentic patterns (tool/function calling, planning, memory, multi-agent orchestration) with robust safety and fallback mechanisms.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into customer-facing platforms via APIs and microservices.

Data & Infrastructure

• Curate, clean and build high-quality datasets for pre-training, fine-tuning and evaluation; design data pipelines for continuous data collection and annotation.

• Implement and maintain scalable ML infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and experiment-tracking tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar).

• Monitor deployed models, design automated retraining pipelines and ensure ongoing model quality through observability and alerting.

Knowledge Sharing & Community

• Author technical papers, internal reports and blog posts that communicate research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Present research at internal seminars, external conferences and community meetups.

• Contribute to open-source projects and public benchmarks to enhance Amity’s visibility in the research community.

Your Ideal Profile:

Required

•
Education: Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field.

•
Research Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML research or research engineering, with demonstrated ability to design experiments, analyse results and iterate on methods.

•
Publication Track Record: At least one first-author or co-author publication at a recognised venue (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, AAAI, or equivalent), or equivalent demonstrated research output (patents, technical reports, significant open-source contributions).

•
Deep Learning Expertise: Strong proficiency with Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow); solid understanding of model architectures (Transformers, diffusion models, GNNs) and training techniques (RLHF, DPO, SFT, pre-training).

•
Engineering Rigour: Ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code; familiarity with software engineering best practices (version control, code review, testing, CI/CD).

•
Mathematical Foundations: Strong grounding in linear algebra, probability, statistics, optimisation and information theory.

Preferred:

•
Agentic & LLM Systems: Experience designing agentic architectures (tool/function calling, planning, memory, multi-agent orchestration via frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen or CrewAI).

•
RAG & Knowledge Systems: Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, embedding models, hybrid search and vector databases.

•
Distributed Training: Experience with large-scale distributed training across multi-GPU/TPU environments (DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron-LM or similar).

•
Cloud & MLOps: Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) and ML operations tooling (MLflow, W&B, Kubeflow).

•
Open-Source Contributions: Active contributions to well-known AI/ML open-source projects or libraries.

•
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to distill complex research into clear recommendations for diverse stakeholders.

What's in it for you:

At Amity Solutions, we are dedicated to creating a dynamic and supportive work environment that prioritizes growth, learning, and inclusivity. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, embracing diversity in ethnicity, gender, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, and age. Join our Bangkok team to enjoy a wide range of benefits as we innovate and grow together.

Discover more about our team values, benefits, and career opportunities at Amity Solutions Bangkok on our official website.

jobs.title: AI Engineer Manager
jobs.description:
LEXTECH is a Thai AI technology company at the intersection of Customer Experience and human interaction — specializing in Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision. As part of OSD Group, one of Thailand’s leading infrastructure and technology groups, we build products that help businesses understand, engage, and respond to their customers at scale.
Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Research
• Stay ahead of the AI/ML landscape and translate emerging developments into actionable decisions for the team — particularly across Large Language Models, computer vision, and applied NLP. The field moves fast. “We’ll look into it later” is how you become irrelevant.
• Evaluate and benchmark new technologies against current implementations. Own the recommendation on whether to adopt, adapt, or hold. Not everything that trends on Papers With Code belongs in production.
• Define the technical direction for AI/ML initiatives, balancing innovation with production stability across a mix of production models and LLM-powered applications.
Hands-On Implementation
• Architect and lead the development of ML solutions end-to-end — from problem framing and model selection through to deployment and monitoring.
• Apply pragmatic judgment on when to fine-tune foundation models, when to use RAG or prompt-based approaches, and when classical ML still wins. No ideology, just results.
• Own optimization decisions: model performance, inference efficiency, and resource utilization. Accuracy without scalability is a prototype, not a product.
Team Management
• Lead and grow a small team of ML Engineers — including workload planning, technical mentorship, and performance development.
• Set clear standards for code quality, experimentation rigor, and model lifecycle management across the team.
• Act as the bridge between technical execution and business stakeholders — translating requirements into scoped ML work and communicating results without the jargon tax.
Qualifications
Required
• Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or equivalent field. What you’ve built matters more than where you studied.
• Proven hands-on experience delivering end-to-end ML solutions in production environments — not just research or notebooks.
• At least 3 years of experience in AI/ML disciplines.
• Currently hold a position of Senior-level at minimum. We are not looking for entry level position.
• Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring a technical team, even informally.
• Strong command of Python and comfort working in Linux-based environments.

Technical Depth
• Strong fundamentals in classical ML and deep learning — you should know why things work, not just that they work. Hands-on experience with PyTorch preferred.
• Fluent in the modern LLM stack: fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG, and agentic patterns. Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent is a plus.
• Applied experience across both Computer Vision (detection, classification, segmentation, tracking) and NLP (transformer architectures, embedding models, semantic search).
• MLOps sensibility: model versioning, monitoring, and retraining discipline. 10+ models and a growing fleet of LLM-powered apps don’t babysit themselves either.
Soft Skills & Mindset
• Genuine curiosity about human behavior as expressed through language and imagery — this isn’t decorative, it’s core to what we build.
• Strong English reading and writing proficiency — most of the literature, tooling, and collaboration happens in English.
• Comfortable with ambiguity. At this level, the problems are rarely well-defined before you arrive.

jobs.title: AI Engineer (Enterprise Systems)
jobs.description:
About the Role
As an AI Engineer on our Enterprise Systems team, you will be embedded directly in the trenches of our most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll take AI from proof of concept to production, navigate the chaos of real customer environments, and make complex agentic systems actually deliver business outcomes.

This is a consulting and hands-on delivery role. You will write production-grade code, architect intelligent agent workflows, debug pipelines at midnight before a go-live, and then walk into a boardroom the next morning to explain what you built and why it matters.

You'll own the full arc — from discovery and design through deployment and adoption — and your success is measured by one thing: does the customer's business actually change because of the AI you delivered?

If you love AI deeply, want to get your hands dirty across the entire delivery lifecycle, and feel equally at home talking to a team and writing LLM orchestration logic, this role was written for you.

What You'll Do
Enterprise AI Delivery

• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their workflows, data environments, and operational constraints — and build AI solutions that fit their reality, not a sanitized sandbox

• Own implementations end-to-end: from scoping and solution design through integration, testing, deployment, and handoff

• Rapidly diagnose technical blockers — messy data, broken integrations, edge cases, legacy system quirks — and solve them yourself without waiting on a queue

Agentic AI Engineering

• Design, build, and orchestrate multi-step AI agents that automate complex workflows across enterprise systems

• Work with frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, or similar to architect reliable, production-ready agentic pipelines

• Apply sound judgment about what should be automated vs. what requires human-in-the-loop, and design accordingly

• Continuously tune agent behavior based on real-world usage patterns you observe in the field

Technical Breadth

• Build custom integrations, connectors, and data pipelines to bridge enterprise tech stacks with AI infrastructure

• Work across the stack — APIs, vector databases, LLM APIs, cloud infrastructure, and front-end surfaces — to deliver complete, working systems

• Write clean, maintainable code that others can build on top of

Product & Feedback Loop

• Identify patterns across customer engagements that signal genuine product opportunities — and advocate for them with engineering and product teams with precision

• Contribute to building internal tooling and repeatable delivery assets (deployment templates, agent blueprints, evaluation frameworks) that make the next implementation faster

• Optionally: take ownership of building product features or internal tools that emerge from your field insights

Requirements

Must-Haves

• 3+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years focused on AI/ML systems in production environments

• Hands-on experience building with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models) — prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, evaluation

• Experience designing and deploying agentic AI workflows — multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, planning

• Strong programming skills in Python; comfortable with APIs, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and enterprise databases

• Proven ability to work directly with enterprise customers or technical stakeholders — you can translate complexity into clarity

• End-to-end ownership mindset: you're not done when the code ships; you're done when the customer succeeds

Strong Signals We'll Look For

• You've debugged a production AI system that was misbehaving inside a customer's environment and fixed it under pressure

• You've built something agentic that actually ran in production — not just a toy demo

• You have opinions about AI system design, and you can back them up with experience

• You've identified a customer problem that became a product feature

• You've shipped something end-to-end — a product, a tool, a system — that you designed yourself from scratch

The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here

• Genuinely obsessed with AI. You follow the field closely, experiment constantly, and have strong convictions about where it's going

• Builder-first. When you see a problem, your instinct is to build a solution — not write a requirements doc and wait

• Comfortable with ambiguity. Enterprise environments are messy. You adapt fast, learn from what you observe, and iterate in real time

• Outcome-driven. You measure success by customer impact, not lines of code or tickets closed

Low ego, high ownership. You'll do what it takes — including the unglamorous work — to get something across the finish line

Benefits

• Competitive Salary

• Flexible working hour

• Hybrid Working

• Group health insurance

• You pick your equipment (Mac / Windows)

• Grab Food and Grab Transportation

• Free snacks & drinks (at the office)

• Pay 100% for Job-related Training Courses

• Free language course and certificate fee

jobs.description:
Solutions Engineer, AI (Thai National Only)

Location: Bangkok, Thailand Level: Junior to Mid-level

About Oriona

Oriona is a Bangkok-based enterprise AI platform built around a simple problem: most companies can't trust the answers their AI gives them. We provide a governed orchestration layer that connects large language models to enterprise data, runs securely in the customer's own environment, and keeps costs and accuracy under control. We work hands-on with enterprise clients to take AI from promising demo to production, and we're growing our team to meet that demand.

About the role

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer who can sit at the intersection of technology and customers. You'll work across the full customer journey: from pre-sales technical conversations, through solution design in the project phase, to hands-on forward-deployed work embedding with clients to make sure Oriona delivers real value.

This is a varied, customer-facing role for someone who enjoys both the technical depth and the people side of building solutions.

What you'll do

• Partner with the sales team as the technical voice in customer conversations: demos, scoping, answering technical questions, and addressing security and architecture concerns

• Translate customer needs into solution designs and help shape how Oriona is deployed for each client

• Work directly with customers during implementation, sometimes embedded with their teams, to configure, integrate, and troubleshoot

• Build proofs of concept and help customers see what's possible

• Act as a bridge between customers and our product/engineering teams, feeding back what you learn in the field

•
Support customers through onboarding and into early adoption

What we're looking for

• Comfortable being technical and customer-facing at the same time: you can talk to engineers and business stakeholders

• Some experience with software, cloud, data, or AI/ML (formal or self-taught)

• Able to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and system architecture at a working level

• Strong communication skills in Thai and English, since you'll be working with local enterprise clients

• Curious, hands-on, and willing to learn quickly in a fast-moving space

•
Bonus: exposure to LLMs / generative AI, enterprise software sales cycles, or solution consulting

Nice to have

• Background in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field

• Experience in a startup or fast-paced environment

• Familiarity with enterprise data, security, or governance concerns

Principal Software Development Engineer I
Work location: Prasert – Manukitch Road, Nawamin, Khet Bueng Kum Bangkok Krung Thep Maha Nakhon [Bangkok] 10240, Thailand
Reports to: Engineering Leadership / CTO Office
Preferred Experience: 10 to 15 Years

The Role
The Principal Software Development Engineer I is a senior technical leader who sets architecture and engineering direction across multiple teams and engagements.
The Principal SDE I tackles the company's most complex technical challenges, defines platform and solution architectures for enterprise AI systems in regulated environments, and elevates engineering capability across the firm.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role with broad organisational influence.
At the company, all engineers are expected to use AI tools effectively in their daily work. AI assistants and workflow automation tools are expected to improve engineering productivity, testing, debugging, documentation, and delivery execution.

What You Will Do
• Define architecture and technical strategy across multiple engagements, platforms, and teams.

• Lead the design of complex, large-scale, secure production systems for regulated enterprise clients.

• Set engineering standards, reference architectures, and best practices adopted firm-wide.

• Provide deep technical leadership on the most challenging delivery and reliability problems.

• Partner with delivery leadership, architects, and senior client stakeholders on technical direction and proposals.

• Drive build-vs-buy, technology selection, and platform investment decisions.

• Mentor senior and staff engineers, and grow the technical bench across teams.

• Contribute reusable platforms, accelerators, and frameworks that scale delivery.

• Champion responsible, effective use of AI tools across engineering.

What We Are Looking For
• 10 to 15 years of experience delivering and architecting production software at scale.

• Recognized depth in system design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architecture.

• Extensive AWS expertise, including security, networking, and enterprise deployment patterns.

• Track record setting technical direction across multiple teams or a business line.

• Experience in regulated industries (financial services, telco, insurance) is strongly valued.

• Strong influence, communication, and stakeholder leadership skills.

• Continued hands-on engineering credibility.

What Sets You Apart
• You have owned architecture for mission-critical systems in regulated enterprises.

• Experience architecting AI/agentic platforms at scale.

• You have shaped engineering culture, standards, and reusable platforms across an organization.

• You are a recognized technical authority and mentor.

Travel and Location
The company's clients are based across Southeast Asia, ANZ, and Japan. Travel and onsite engagement requirements may vary depending on project needs. Relocation support may be considered based on business requirements.

Language
Fluency in spoken and written English is required across all markets. Strong communication skills are important for collaboration across engineering teams, delivery teams, and enterprise stakeholders.

Certifications
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional certifications are strongly valued.

jobs.description:
Location : RSU Tower, Sukhumvit 31, Bangkok, Thailand : Hybrid
Company Overview
SS&C is a global provider of investment and financial services and software for the financial services and healthcare industries. Named to Fortune 1000 list as top U.S. company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut and has 20,000+ employees in over 90 offices in 35 countries. Some 18,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest institutions to local firms, manage and account for their investments using SS&C's products and services.
Overview for senior role:
We are looking to hire New grad to Senior AI Developers to drive the technical evolution of our automation capability, moving beyond traditional RPA limits to build entirely new, highly sophisticated solutions that were previously impossible. In this role, you will design and build resilient, code-first frameworks using Python, C# .NET, and Typescript. You will own the technical design of end-to-end solutions, using Blue Prism Work HQ to manage RPA and Agentic processes. This is a hands-on software engineering role for developers who want to pioneer next-generation intelligent automation, build complex tool-use infrastructure from scratch, and establish the development standards for a growing team.
Key Responsibilities
• AI-Driven Development: Build, optimize, and maintain scalable automation workflows using Claude Code and modern AI development tools to accelerate software delivery and agentic workflows.

• GenAI & Agentic Orchestration: Develop and deploy autonomous AI agents and skills that interact with advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) via the SS&C AI Gateway, seamlessly blending them with WHQ Agents and Digital Workers.

• Modern UI Automation: Design and build robust, resilient automation frameworks targeting desktop applications via FlaUI and modern web systems using Playwright, completely moving away from legacy application spying techniques.

• Enterprise Work Queue Management: Design and optimize high-throughput automation architectures utilizing Blue Prism v7 Work Queues (Work HQ) to manage transactional data, case locking, and exception handling for hybrid AI-human workflows.
