jobs.title: Senior Project Manager — AI Data Collection & Annotation
jobs.description:
About Andovar:
Andovar builds large-scale multilingual data collection and annotation datasets used to train ASR, TTS, and other AI models — for example, multi-locale telephony/IVR speech corpora spanning dozens of languages, with strict audio specifications and heavy structured annotation. Pricing these projects is genuinely hard: every quote is a puzzle of interacting cost drivers, and nearly every new project surfaces a factor we have not priced before.
We are looking for a rigorous, analytical mind to own the deconstruction and costing of these quotes building them from first principles and stress-testing quotes prepared by others.This is not a client-facing role. It is for someone intellectually curious to master every layer of the data collection and annotation industry, and who enjoys taking a messy, ambiguous scope and resolving it into a clean, defensible cost model.

Key Responsibilities
Account and delivery ownership
• Own 2–4 complex, high-volume accounts end-to-end — including new-client pilots where speed and first impressions decide whether the account scales.

• Install early-truth checkpoints on every project: pilot batches, week-one acceptance-rate checks, and contributor-funnel math, so wrong assumptions surface while they are still cheap to fix.

• Run delivery against explicit capacity math — what one PM, one language, one contributor pool can produce per day — instead of gut-feel commitments.

Client leadership
• Lead client communication for your accounts: pilot reviews, scope negotiation, delivery forecasts and risk calls. You keep control of scope in writing.

• Translate ambiguous client requirements into precise operational instructions, acceptance criteria and QA workflows.

• Handle unknowns openly: surface them early, convert them into questions with owners and dates, and manage client expectations while they are being resolved.

• Proactively reach out — to client stakeholders and to internal departments (recruitment, vendor management, engineering, finance) — to get what your project needs. You chase; you don't wait.

Pre-sales, commercial and margin
• Participate in pre-sales for your domain: quotation, sampling and pilot scoping alongside Sales — and give a feasibility verdict before we commit, not after.

• Track project-level financials — budget, vendor spend, forecast vs. actual — and flag margin erosion early enough to act on it.

• Own the invoicing step on your accounts: accurate, on-time invoicing inputs, and follow-up with the client through to payment.

Team leadership
• Lead a pod of project coordinators, interns and freelance PMs across countries; design shift coverage and handovers so client hours (including US/EU evenings) are covered without points of failure.

• Mentor juniors to independently run standard projects, so senior time stays on client-facing and high-complexity work.

• Own escalations on your accounts and resolve them; escalate upward with options, not problems.

Process and instrumentation
• Improve SOPs, trackers and reporting so status reflects reality — acceptance rates, throughput and margin visible weekly, not discovered at invoicing.

What we're looking for
• Agency-side experience is mandatory: 5+ years delivering projects for external clients in an agency or client-services environment — software development, research/custdev, data collection or related — of which 2+ years at senior level.

• Owned client relationships directly — expectations, escalations and scope negotiations, not just the trackers. You can show how you kept a client confident through a project going sideways.

• A proactive operating style with evidence: you reach out to client stakeholders and internal departments to unblock your projects, surface unknowns early, and turn them into named risks with owners and dates.

• Managed distributed freelance, vendor or subcontractor delivery teams, including performance management.

• Ran projects with budget or financial responsibility: budgeting, forecasting, vendor spend control, and invoicing follow-through with clients.

• Participated in pre-sales: quotes, proposals, samples or pilots — and can talk about one you shaped.

• Fluent professional English, written and spoken (C1+); confident client-facing communication.

• Based in Asia time zones (UTC+5 to UTC+9), with flexibility for evening calls with US/EU clients.

• Advanced command of project tracking and reporting tools (Excel plus Airtable, Jira, Asana, Monday.com or similar).

What we offer
• Remote-first role with a distributed, international team.

• Senior scope with real decision authority — and a visible path toward Program Manager / Head-of-delivery responsibility as the division grows.

• Direct exposure to frontier AI companies and the fastest-growing segment of the language industry.

• Compensation built for owners: base salary plus a bonus on each successful project clos

is a Frontier Systems Integrator building agentic AI systems for leading banks, telecommunications companies, insurers, and retailers across Asia Pacific.

We operate exclusively on AWS and leverage partnership programmes that provide co-sell reach, funded innovation opportunities, and delivery credibility across multiple markets. We value individuals who are technically capable, collaborative, commercially aware, and focused on delivering measurable business outcomes.

The Role
The Strategist plays a key role in connecting client business objectives with the company's technical delivery teams. This role is responsible for understanding client challenges, mapping business processes, designing agentic workflows, validating solutions, and helping clients realize measurable business value.
The role works closely with both client stakeholders and internal engineering teams to translate business problems into structured workflows and implementation-ready requirements.
This is not solely a requirements-gathering role. The expectation is to remain accountable for business outcomes and delivery impact throughout the engagement lifecycle.
At the company, all team members are expected to use AI tools effectively in their daily work. Whether mapping processes, developing value cases, designing workflows, or preparing workshops, AI assistants and agentic tools are expected to improve speed, quality, and execution effectiveness.

What You Will Do
• Lead discovery sessions and process-mapping activities for client engagements. Understand current workflows, decision points, operational inefficiencies, data flows, and risk areas to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvements.

• Support the development of value cases by quantifying business impact across areas such as cost reduction, productivity improvement, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency.

• Design agentic workflows in collaboration with Architects and Engineering teams. Define workflow logic, required data inputs, human review checkpoints, expected outputs, and success metrics.

• Create functional specifications, BRDs, user stories, workflow documentation, and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can clearly execute.

• Work closely with UX/UI teams to ensure business requirements are translated into intuitive and high-quality user experiences.

• Use AI tools and AI-assisted development platforms to prototype workflows, validate outputs, and demonstrate concepts to stakeholders before engineering implementation begins.

• Use ALM tools such as JIRA and Confluence to manage requirements, defects, test cases, and project documentation.

• Develop functional test plans, test scenarios, and test cases, and participate in functional and system integration testing activities.

• Contribute to engagement case studies by documenting business outcomes, measurable impact, and client success metrics.

• Support pre-sales activities, including discovery workshops, proposal inputs, and value case development for prospective engagements..

What We Are Looking For
• 5-9 years of experience in management consulting, enterprise technology strategy, business analysis, product management, or related roles, preferably within BFSI or Telecommunications environments.

• Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts, including RAG, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop workflows, and AI evaluation methodologies.

• Hands-on experience using AI tools, coding assistants, and workflow prototyping platforms as part of day-to-day delivery activities.

• Strong understanding of at least one industry vertical such as banking, telecommunications, or insurance, including operational workflows and business processes.

• Ability to develop structured and measurable business value cases with clearly defined business outcomes.

• Experience writing detailed functional specifications, BRDs, workflow diagrams, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.

• Strong workshop facilitation, stakeholder communication, and presentation skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively across business, product, UX/UI, and engineering teams.

What Sets You Apart
• You actively use AI tools to improve discovery, process mapping, workflow design, and value case development.

• You have experience facilitating stakeholder workshops and aligning teams around measurable business outcomes.

APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/speechify

Speechify is a text-to-speech app that makes it easy for the world to access information. 20+ million people use our Google Chrome extension, web app, iOS app, and Android app. our mission is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Our amazing users are students, professionals, and productivity lovers. Many of them have learning differences like dyslexia and ADHD, while many just want to read faster and listen on the go. With Speechify you can turn any book, document, or website into audio, and listen while you’re in the car, doing laundry, walking your dog, making dinner, working out, skydiving—whatever your daily routine is! Speechify also powers Medium, the Star Tribune, The Direct, and more. Easily add text-to-speech to your website.

Cliff Weitzman, our fearless CEO, founded Speechify in 2017 in a dorm room at Brown University so he could share with others the incredible text-to-speech software he’d been working on. Cliff has dyslexia and he was frustrated with how much time and energy it took for him to read. Advanced TTS technology was a total gamechanger, it allowed him to finish his readings 3x faster than a normal reader and to better comprehend and retain information.

At Speechify our goal is for reading to never be a barrier to learning for anyone. Nothing should hold you back from learning information quickly and effectively.

Speechify has grown to employ over 100 team members spread out across the globe in just a few short years. We're proud of the incredible team with members who were previously leaders and senior engineers at companies like Snapchat, Apple, Spotify, Amazon & Uber. We all love and prioritise ownership, delivering value with speed, learning as much as we can and making our users feel empowered.

The Role

APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/speechify/jobs/5587139004

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

Overview

As Speechify expands, our AI team seeks a Senior Backend Engineer. This role is central to ensuring our infrastructure scales efficiently, optimizing key product flows, and constructing resilient end-to-end systems. If you are passionate about strategizing, enjoy high-paced environments, and are eager to take ownership of product decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

• State of the art voice cloning

• Low latency and cost effective text to speech

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products.

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive.

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity.

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry.

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture.

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more.

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.

And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Ideal Profile

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• Proven experience in backend development: Python

• Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers.

• Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact.

• Experience with Docker and containerized deployments.

• Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes.

• Preferred: Experience deploying NLP or TTS models to production.

What's on Offer?

• Excellent career development opportunities

jobs.title: Lead AI Consultant (BPM)
jobs.description:
Job purpose

aCommerce is the region’s leading ecommerce service provider. With over 800 talented staff and operations in Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines.

We are seeking a highly skilled, cross-functional Lead AI Consultant . In this role, you will embed with various business units—including Supply Chain, Marketing, Inventory Control, Accounting, and Finance, back office operations —to diagnose operational challenges, gather complex requirements, and architect high-impact, AI-driven solutions.

You are the ultimate translator. You possess both the acute business acumen of a Business Analyst to uncover real-world problems and the deep programming proficiency needed to convert those problems into granular, technical blueprints. Your primary deliverable is a production-ready technical design that our dedicated AI development team can seamlessly execute.

Core Responsibilities

•
Internal Business Consulting: Partner directly with leadership and domain experts across Marketing, Supply Chain, Inventory, and Finance to deeply understand their workflows, identify pain points, and uncover data-driven optimization opportunities.

•
Business & Systems Analysis: Extract, analyze, and document complex business rules, transforming vague departmental needs into highly structured functional and technical product requirements.

•
AI Solution Blueprinting: Design end-to-end technical blueprints and system architectures for AI products. This includes defining data pipelines, data model structures, API integrations, and model performance metrics (e.g., accuracy thresholds) so that engineering teams can build with minimal ambiguity.

•
Technical Feasibility & Prototyping: Leverage your programming background to validate data availability, query databases, and build occasional quick proofs-of-concept (PoCs) to prove feasibility before handing work over to the core development team.

•
Product Lifecycle Management: Own the product lifecycle from initial discovery through delivery. Define the minimum viable product (MVP) scope, manage risk, and ensure the engineering output aligns perfectly with the original business intent.

Required Technical & Professional Skills

1. Hands-On Technical Programming (Proficient Level)

Because you will be designing the technical framework for the AI development team, you must speak their language fluently. Hands-on coding testing will be part of our interview process.

•
Python: Proficient in data analysis, manipulating data structures, and working with core AI/ML packages.

•
SQL: Expert-level capability to write complex queries, joins, and aggregations across relational databases to locate and assess business data.

•
C++: Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, memory management, and compiled logic to architect high-performance components or system integrations.

•
JavaScript / TypeScript: Capable of understanding web architecture, front-end data handling, or building simple prototype UIs to demonstrate how an AI feature will look to the end-user.

2. Business Analysis & Domain Knowledge

• Demonstrated experience translating abstract business problems into technical product documentation (PRDs, wireframes, user stories, architecture flows).

• Functional familiarity with key business operations:

• Supply Chain & Inventory: Forecasting, demand planning, logistics optimization.

• Finance & Accounting: Fraud detection, anomaly detection, automated reconciliation.

3. Core Product Skills

• Proven track record of designing "blueprints" or technical product specs that engineers have successfully built and deployed.

• Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to explain highly complex AI concepts (like neural networks, transformers, or regression models) to non-technical business leaders in plain English.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field.

• 5+ years of experience navigating hybrid roles such as Technical Consultant, Solutions Architect, Project Manager or Business Analyst.

• Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience specifically working on Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning projects .

• Experience in engaging with Senior Management to gain consensus and sponsorship for key initiatives

• Strong command of written and spoken English is required. Good command of the Thai language is a strong plus.

• Deep understanding of current AI tools, generative AI technologies, agent systems, and emerging ecosystem trends.

• Knowledge of data privacy, security standards, and ethical considerations surrounding corporate AI deployment.

• Familiarity with the software development lifecycle to effectively collaborate with developers and technical product managers.

Solutions Sales – AI and SaaS จำนวน 1 ตำแหน่ง (กรุงเทพมหานคร)
อัตราเงินเดือน: 20,000-40,000 บาท
พร้อมประกันสุขภาพ และโอกาสในความก้าวหน้าในหน้าที่การงาน
Qualifications
• วุฒิการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรี วิศวกรรมคอมพิวเตอร์, เทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ, วิทยาศาสตร์คอมพิวเตอร์, หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• วุฒิการศึกษาระดับปริญญาตรี วิศวกรรมคอมพิวเตอร์, เทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ, วิทยาศาสตร์คอมพิวเตอร์ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• มีทักษะนำเสนอผลิตภัณฑ์ นำเสนอโซลูชั่น (Solution/Product Presentation)

• มีทักษะในการวิเคราะห์โซลูชั่นทั้งปัจจุบัน (Requirement and AS-IS Analysis) และการออกแบบโซลูชั่นในอนาคตให้กับลูกค้า (Solution Design)

• มีทักษะในการคำปรึกษา (Consulting), สาธิตการใช้งาน (Demonstrating), และจัดทำ Prove of Concept (POC) หรือ Prove of Execution (POE) ใสการนำเสนอโซลูชั่นหรือผลิตภัณฑ์

• มีความรู้ ความเข้าใจหรือประสบการณ์ในธุรกิจด้าน IT/Technology ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับ AI, Software, Software-as-s-Service (SaaS), Application หรือ Cloud Solution ที่เป็น Multi-Cloud หรือ Hybrid Cloud ที่ทำงานร่วมกันระหว่าง On-premise และ On-Cloud ได้

• มีทักษะในการแก้ไขปัญหา (Problem Solving), การค้นคว้าข้อมูล (Research), การทดลอง (Experimental) สำหรับการหาคำตอบของปัญหาต่างๆเพื่อตอบสนองความต้องการของลูกค้าได้เป็นอย่างดี

• มีความเป็นผู้นำ มีความรับผิดชอบสูง มีไหวพริบดี มนุษย์สัมพันธ์ดี สามารถทำงานต่างจังหวัดได้ และมีความสนใจธุรกิจด้าน Software และ Cloud

• สามารถ พูด อ่าน เขียน ภาษาอังกฤษได้ดี หรือ ดีเยี่ยม (หากมีข้อมูลด้านการสอบภาษาอังกฤษจากหน่วยงานชั้นนำหรือองค์กรรับรองชั้นนำจะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ)

• สามารถเดินทางไปศึกษาดูงานและอบรมทั้งในและต่างประเทศได้

• หากมีประสบการณ์ด้าน Solution/Technical Sales, Presales, Solution Specialist, Solution Architect หรืออื่นๆที่เกี่ยวข้องกับธุรกิจหรือผลิตภัณฑ์ด้าน Software และ Cloud จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

• หากมีใบประกาณียบัตรหรือใบรับรองทางด้าน AI, SaaS, Software หรือ Cloud จากผู้ให้บริการชั้นนำอาทิเช่น Microsoft หรืออื่นๆที่เกี่ยวข้อง ในระดับ Associate หรือ Expert หรือระดับที่เทียบเท่า จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

• มีทักษะในการเรียนรู้ได้ด้วยตนเอง เรียนรู้ได้รวดเร็ว ด้วยเครื่องมือ Generative AI

• มีความเข้าใจด้าน Responsible AI ครอบคลุมทั้ง AI Ethics, AI Security และ Data Privacy และสามารถนำเสนอโซลูชันที่สอดคล้องกับมาตรฐาน ESG และ Regulatory Compliance ที่ลูกค้าต้องการได้

Job Description
• ติดตั้ง กำหนดค่า และดูแลรักษาเซิร์ฟเวอร์ทั้งแบบ Physical และ Virtual

• ออกแบบสถาปัตยกรรมของโซลูชั่น (Solution Design) และนำเสนอโซลูชั่น (Solution Presentation) เกี่ยวกับ Software และ Cloud ในส่วนที่เป็น SaaS, PaaS และ IaaS ให้กับลูกค้า

• ติดต่อประสานงานลูกค้าเพื่อนำเสนอ (Present), เก็บข้อมูลความต้องการและสถานะปัจจุบัน (Gather Requirement and AS-IS), วิเคราะห์ความต้องการ (Requirement Analysis), และออกแบบโซลูชั่น (Solution Design) หรือ เลือกโซลูชั่น (Solution Selection) ที่เหมาะสมกับลูกค้าแต่ละราย เพื่อสร้างแนวทางในการนำเสนอสิ่งที่จะเป็นในอนาคตของลูกค้าได้ (TO-BE)

• จัดทำและตรวจสอบ Term of Reference (TOR), รายละเอียดผลิตภัณฑ์ (Specification) และ Solution/Product Catalog ของโซลูชั่นหรือสินค้าที่นำเสนอลูกค้า

• ให้คำปรึกษา (Consulting), สาธิตการใช้งาน (Demonstrating), และจัดทำ Prove of Concept (POC) หรือ Prove of Execution (POE) ใสการนำเสนอโซลูชั่นหรือผลิตภัณฑ์ของบริษัทฯ

• มีความเข้าใจผลิตภัณฑ์และสามารถออกแบบโซลูชั่น AI และ SaaS ที่เป็น Multi-Cloud หรือ Hybrid Cloud ที่ทำงานร่วมกันระหว่าง On-premise และ On-Cloud ได้

• เข้าใจผลิตภัณฑ์และสามารถติดต่อประสานงานกับเจ้าของผลิตภัณฑ์เพื่อประสานร่วมมือในการออกแบบ การแก้ไขปัญหาและการหาข้อมูลเชิงลึกผลิตภัณฑ์ในการออกแบบโซลูชั่นที่ตอบโจทย์ความต้องการของลูกค้า

• วิเคราะห์ปัญหา ศึกษาคู่มืออุปกรณ์ เชื่อมโยงการทำงานของอุปกรณ์แต่ละชนิด เพื่อให้ระบบสามารถทำงานร่วมกันได้ดี ในกรณีมีการบูรณาการระหว่างโซลูชั่น (Integrated Solution Design, Consult, and Support)

• ให้คำปรึกษาช่างเทคนิค และแผนกอื่น ๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องเกี่ยวกับผลิตภัณฑ์

• คิด สร้างสรรค์ นวัตกรรมใหม่ๆ เพื่อพัฒนาโซลูชั่นขององค์กร

• สนับสนุนงานด้านการขาย การตลาดและการบริการตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย

• ปฏิบัติงานที่ สำนักงานกรุงเทพ (70%) สามารถเดินทางไปฏิบัติงานต่างจังหวัด ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมายได้ (30%)

• ปฏิบัติงานตามหน้าที่ที่ได้รับมอบหมายเพิ่มเติม

Benefits
• ฝึกอบรมและพัฒนาทักษะด้านเทคโนโลยีอย่างต่อเนื่อง

• ค่าที่พัก (กรณีปฏิบัติงานต่างจังหวัด)

• ค่าเดินทาง ค่าน้ำมันรถ

• ค่าโทรศัพท์

• โบนัสประจำปี (ตามผลประกอบการ)

• ประกันสังคม และประกันสุขภาพกลุ่ม

• ค่าใช้จ่ายในการสอบใบ Certification

• โอกาสในการศึกษาดูงานและพัฒนาทักษะ

jobs.title: AI Integrator
jobs.description:
The AI Integrator gives the CEO one consolidated view of all AI across Banpu Group — and ensures every use case delivers measurable business value. Sitting within Organization Transformation, this role acts as the strategic bridge between leadership, business units, and technology teams, driving AI adoption coherently from strategy to operations. The role operates across four areas: portfolio visibility, ROI measurement, AI adoption (inorganic & organic), and cross-team coordination.

1. Portfolio & CEO Dashboard

• Maintain the AI Initiative Registry — all use cases with owner, stage, and live status across Assets and Corporate.

• Operate the CEO single-view dashboard: portfolio heatmap, risk flags, and value indicators.

• Curate and present the quarterly AI Portfolio Review pack for Excom and Transformation Committee.

• Run the intake process so every new initiative is captured from day one.

2. Value Capture & ROI Measurement

• Own and publish the group-wide ROI methodology across productivity, cost, revenue, and risk.

• Apply pre/post measurement to every use case passing the pilot gate.

• Operate the AI Value Scorecard linked to CEO KPIs; surface laggards and outperformers each quarter.

3. AI Adoption — Inorganic & Organic

• Inorganic: Collaborate with external consultants, HR, Banpu Academy, and Digital & Innovation to introduce and integrate ready-made AI solutions into business units.

• Organic: Work alongside Deploy Engineers to embed AI naturally into existing departmental workflows — ensuring adoption is sustainable, not forced.

• Translate CEO Change Agenda into top-down use cases; set context and advocate for AI adoption at department level.

4. Coordination & Cadence

• Bi-weekly registry syncs with Asset AI leads; monthly AI Operating Council with Strategic Capability Group.

• Monthly and quarterly portfolio reviews with the Transformation Committee.

• Coordinate with Tech Stack Builder (Cloud, Data Architecture, Cybersecurity, IoT, Enterprise Architecture) to ensure AI use cases are technically viable and secure.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or related fields; Master’s degree (e.g., MBA) is preferred.

• 10+ years in strategy, business transformation, management consulting, or enterprise program management.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description:
Manatal is an HRTech software service (B2B SaaS) company headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Manatal is one of the fastest-growing start-ups in the region and is backed by Surge and Sequoia Capital. Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries, and has been recognized by Forbes as the Best Recruiting Software of 2024.

Our mission is to offer the best-in-class AI-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing and recruitment transformation.

This is an outbound growth engineering role for someone who enjoys building systems, automating workflows, improving data quality, and using AI to help sales teams generate more qualified pipeline.

The GTM Engineer, Outbound role will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing Manatal's outbound prospecting engine. This person will own the process, tools, data, automation, and playbooks that allow SDRs to consistently generate qualified meetings at scale.

Role Overview

We're looking for a technical and process-driven outbound growth builder to help scale Manatal's outbound engine.

Your mission is simple: Build a repeatable outbound system that enables SDRs to generate 4 to 5 qualified meetings per day with recruitment agencies and staffing firms.

You will work closely with the outbound sales team, but your main responsibility is not to cold call, send emails, or manually prospect. Your responsibility is to build the system behind the team: target accounts, enriched data, qualification rules, AI workflows, outreach logic, reporting, and repeatable playbooks.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong interest in growth automation, agentic AI, outbound systems, CRM workflows, data enrichment, and revenue process design.

Responsibilities

• Design and build a repeatable outbound prospecting system for recruitment agencies and staffing firms.

• Define and improve Manatal's outbound ICP, account segmentation, and qualification logic.

• Build workflows to source, enrich, score, and route high-quality accounts and contacts to SDRs.

• Use tools such as HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, N8N, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Agents, AI agents, APIs, scraping tools, and modern outreach platforms such as Growth Machine, Lemlist, Instantly, Smartlead, Respond.io, or similar tools.

• Build AI-assisted workflows for account research, lead scoring, personalization, messaging support, prospect prioritization, and SDR task automation.

• Automate repetitive outbound tasks, including data collection, enrichment, qualification, CRM updates, reporting, and workflow monitoring.

• Define the activity model required for SDRs to consistently generate 4 to 5 qualified meetings per day.

• Build and improve outbound sequences, messaging frameworks, call openers, LinkedIn messages, WhatsApp messages, email templates, and follow-up structures for SDRs to use.

• Analyze outbound performance to identify bottlenecks across data quality, outreach, conversion, and meeting quality.

• Create clear dashboards and reports to track outbound activity, conversion rates, meeting volume, pipeline creation, and process performance.

• Document outbound workflows, playbooks, SOPs, CRM rules, qualification criteria, and automation logic.

• Train and support SDRs on how to use the outbound process, tools, workflows, and playbooks effectively.

• Collaborate with Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, and Management to improve outbound performance.

• Other tasks as directed by the CEO or Management.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in growth operations, outbound operations, sales development operations, revenue operations, growth marketing, sales automation, data automation, or a similar role.

• Strong experience building workflows, automations, or systems that improve lead generation, outbound productivity, sales efficiency, or pipeline creation.

• Strong understanding of lead generation, enrichment, segmentation, data quality, qualification logic, and workflow automation.

• Experience using AI, automation, and data tools to improve outbound or revenue generation processes.

• Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, N8N, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Agents, AI agents, APIs, scraping tools, outreach automation tools, or similar platforms.

• Ability to design practical workflows that connect lead generation, enrichment, CRM, outreach channels, reporting, and SDR execution.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with activity data, conversion rates, funnel performance, data quality, and pipeline metrics.

• Ability to reverse engineer the activity model required to generate 4 to 5 qualified meetings per SDR per day.

• Strong process documentation skills, including SOPs, playbooks, workflow maps, CRM rules, automation logic, and operational guidelines.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to turn unclear business problems into structured workflows and practical solutions.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Bilingual communication in English.

• Prior experience in B2B SaaS, HRTech, recruitment technology, staffing, or recruitment agencies is a plus.

• Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, scraping, AI agents, or workflow automation is a strong plus.

• Direct cold calling or closing experience is not required.

Working with Manatal

• This role is based at our Bangkok office in the heart of the city center.

• As a team of diverse cultures and nationalities, English language proficiency is required.

• We enjoy collaborating in person, and the team is working on-site.

Why You'll Enjoy Working with Manatal

• Well-funded start-up backed by Surge & Sequoia.

• Be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B SaaS start-ups in the region.

• Collaborate with talented individuals in the industry.

• Join a lively and highly international team.

• Indulge in a challenging and innovative working culture.

• Two weeks of work from anywhere per year.

jobs.title: Junior Associate - Tech & AI
jobs.description:
Your Impact

You will work as a typical McKinsey consultant, leveraging your strong passion for Tech & AI work.

In a team of typically ~3-5 consultants, you will shape and drive end-to-end digital transformations across business, technology, process and people, creating value by reinventing the core of our client's businesses. This work includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, developing and communicating recommendations. You’ll also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members.

You’ll also gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm. You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on your team.

Your responsibilities will include partnering with our clients, from data owners and users to C-level executives, to understand their needs and build impactful analytics solutions. You will travel to our clients’ offices to deliver presentations, gather information, or share knowledge. You will contribute to cross-functional problem-solving sessions with your team and deliver presentations to colleagues and clients. Additionally, you will translate business problems into analytical problems, develop models aimed at solving our clients’ and users’ problems, and ensure they are evaluated with the relevant metrics.

You will be based in the Bangkok office, working with Tech & AI at McKinsey, which brings together the best of McKinsey’s digital capabilities to help our clients use digital technology to transform their businesses. As part of this group, you’ll join a global team working on everything from AI-led transformation, strategy to agile, cloud, cybersecurity, digital transformation and IT modernization.

You will also collaborate with clients across a diverse range of sectors and industries, working on projects that span various functions. As part of our global team, you'll partner with colleagues from across McKinsey & Company to help clients deliver breakthrough products, experiences, and businesses, covering both technology and non-technology topics like operations, strategy, corporate finance, marketing, and sales etc.

Our office culture empowers us to try new ideas and experiment and are expected to be constantly learning and growing. There is also a strong emphasis on mentoring others in the group, enabling them to grow and learn.

Your Growth
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

•
Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.

•
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.

•
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

•
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

• Bachelor's degree, ideally either in business (economics, finance, management) or a technical field (engineering, computer science, data science)

• 2+ years of work experience preferred, leveraging analytics/AI for product growth and management, or in technical roles (data scientists / data engineers / software engineers)

• Outstanding record of academic achievement, with functional knowledge or passion in Digital, Technology and IT, as well as business and strategy

• Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities

• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and effectively with people at all levels in an organization

• Willingness to travel

• Skills to communicate complex ideas effectively

jobs.title: Technical SpecialistNew
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Technical Specialist role is primarily focused on delivering the technical aspects of implementation related to the InterSystems TrakCare patient centric healthcare solution. TrakCare is a browser based solution that is developed and implemented using the InterSystems IRIS for Health for database for data storage, application logic and integration requirements. Technical specialists will be trained and expected to be proficient in the use of IRIS for Health and various operating systems including Unix, Linux and MS Windows. Technical Specialists work as part of the implementation team for projects or one-off customer requirements.

Responsibilities

• The tasks typically undertaken by a technical specialist as part of a project are:

Integration

Technical specialists are responsible for:

• Development of documentation related to implementation requirements. Each interface or task is documented from a functional and technical point of view including the functionality provided, connectivity requirements and technical aspects of the interface or task. Interface documentation may be used to provide a business case for a new interface or to document an interface that is to be delivered as part of a contract.

• Implementation of the interface including unit and system testing.

• Documentation of the “as built” interface including technical set up and any related dependencies.

• Support of the interface including changes required to interface requirements over time.

System Management

• Technical specialists may be required to:

• Install and configure the TrakCare solution in multiple environments and servers on a project by project basis

• Update TrakCare installations with the latest version.

• Apply application patches and ad-hoc releases.

Development

• TrakCare is developed primarily by InterSystems TrakCare developers however occasionally there is a need for Technical Specialists to undertake customer specific development for example development of reports or data extracts.

Management

• Liaise with client or business analyst regarding ongoing enhancement requests.

• Advise and assist the Project Managers during implementation.

• Manage the resolution of any outstanding acceptance issues before and after project go-live.

General Operational

• Provide support on the TrakCare data dictionary.

• Provide advice and best practices to clients for technical areas such as networks, configurations, architectures etc.

• Provide technical support for troubleshooting and performance analysis for reports, stored procedures, interfaces, data conversions, data migration scripts and user defined features and functions.

• Monitoring and responding to Technical Team calls on the TRC logging system.

• Production of training materials for technical courses such as system, custom development or reporting.

• Production of technical documentation such as reference materials, installation instructions, user guides, knowledge base articles.

• Responsible for participating in on-site technical training if required.

• Responsible for participating in on-site technical implementations if required.

• Responsible for participating in the on call 24-hour roster service during implementation.

• Other duties may be directed by the Company from time to time.

Experience and Qualifications

• Knowledge of web orientated languages, including SQL, HTML and Java script.

• Experience with database scripting languages for example T-SQL or PL-SQL.

• Experience with data analysis and database methodologies.

• Knowledge of AI, machine learning and generative AI concepts, capabilities and limitations.

• Ability to use Company-approved AI tools for documentation, development, troubleshooting and data analysis, and to validate outputs.

• Understanding of responsible AI, including privacy, security, patient confidentiality, bias and human oversight.

• Experience with Microsoft Office.

• Be able to design and write technical documents.

• Well versed in Internet / Intranet concepts and Microsoft IIS.

• Experienced in customer focused support.

• Proven ability to lead and deliver results as required within specific time frames.

• Good presentation and communication skills.

• Ability to conduct training and develop training materials.

• Ability to work within a team in a cross departmental environment.

• Available for out of office hours work and willing to travel.

• Keen to learn new technologies and new applications.

• Experience of delivering applications to the healthcare sector. (desirable)

• Software Engineering experience. (desirable)

• Familiarity with healthcare related integration including HL7 standards and protocols. (desirable)

Education and Training

• Relevant University Degree.

About InterSystems

InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit InterSystems.com.

AI Disclaimer

InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information). InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.

Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience. AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.

jobs.description:
หน้าที่ความรับผิดชอบ
1. ดำเนินการจัดเตรียมความพร้อม และวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลด้านสุขภาพขนาดใหญ่ เพื่อให้มั่นใจว่าข้อมูลมีความถูกต้อง และพร้อมใช้งาน โดยรวมถึงการทำความเข้าใจในโครงสร้าง คุณภาพ และรายละเอียดเฉพาะของชุดข้อมูล
2. ดำเนินการวางแผนผังข้อมูล ของมาตรฐานคำศัพท์ และรหัสทางการแพทย์ระหว่างฐานข้อมูลด้านสุขภาพต่างๆ พร้อมทั้งพัฒนาอัลกอริทึมและเครื่องมือ เพื่ออัตโนมัติกระบวนการวางแผนผังข้อมูลให้เกิดความสอดคล้องและถูกต้องในชุดข้อมูลที่มีอยู่
3. สามารถดึง และเก็บข้อมูลที่เกี่ยวข้องจากแหล่งข้อมูลที่ไม่มีโครงสร้าง เพื่อนำมาใช้ในการเพิ่มความสมบูรณ์ให้กับชุดข้อมูล พร้อมทั้งตรวจสอบความถูกต้องและความน่าเชื่อถือของข้อมูลด้วยเทคนิคการตรวจสอบที่เข้มงวด
4. ดำเนินการสร้าง และนำโมเดลการเรียนรู้ของเครื่อง (Machine Learning) มาใช้งานเพื่อสนับสนุนแอปพลิเคชันด้านสุขภาพ โดยมีการจัดทำรายงานเพื่อติดตามตัวชี้วัดความสำเร็จ และประสิทธิภาพของโมเดลอย่างต่อเนื่อง
5. ติดตามผลลัพธ์ของการประมวลผลข้อมูล และตรวจสอบประสิทธิภาพของระบบอย่างต่อเนื่อง มีความรับผิดชอบในการรักษาความปลอดภัย และเสถียรภาพของข้อมูล เพื่อป้องกันการละเมิดหรือการสูญหายของข้อมูล
6. จัดทำรายงาน และแดชบอร์ดที่มีความสอดคล้องกับข้อมูลที่ประมวลผล เพื่อติดตามตัวชี้วัดความสำเร็จ และประสิทธิภาพของโมเดล รวมถึงข้อมูลอื่นๆ ที่สำคัญ ใช้ข้อมูลและรายงานผลลัพธ์ที่ได้ในการให้ข้อมูลเชิงลึก เพื่อสนับสนุนการตัดสินใจ และวางกลยุทธ์ทางธุรกิจ
7. ประสานงาน และร่วมมือกับนักพัฒนาซอฟต์แวร์ ผู้เชี่ยวชาญทางการแพทย์ และผู้จัดการผลิตภัณฑ์ในการค้นหา และพัฒนาแนวทางแก้ไขปัญหาที่ขับเคลื่อนด้วยข้อมูลสำหรับความท้าทายในด้านสุขภาพ พร้อมทั้งติดตามความก้าวหน้าล่าสุดในเทคโนโลยีสุขภาพ AI และ Data Science เพื่อส่งเสริมการสร้างนวัตกรรมภายในบริษัท
8. ร่วมวางแผนงานกับผู้จัดการโครงการ และผู้จัดการทั่วไป เพื่อให้มีความสอดคล้องกับความต้องการของลูกค้า รวมถึงเข้าร่วมการประชุม การหารือ กับลูกค้า อันเกี่ยวเนื่องกับโครงการหรือผลิตภัณฑ์ของบริษัทที่ได้รับผิดชอบหรือได้รับมอบหมาย
9.วิเคราะห์ปัญหา ตั้งสมมุติฐาน ค้นคว้า ออกแบบการทดลอง และรายการผลการทดลองได้
10.สร้าง prototype หรือ demo เพื่อช่วยทีม sale นำเสนอ

คุณสมบัติ
1. ปริญญาตรีหรือสูงกว่าในสาขาวิทยาศาสตร์ข้อมูล (Data Science), วิทยาการคอมพิวเตอร์, สถิติ, คณิตศาสตร์ หรือสาขาอื่น ๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
2.มีประสบการณ์ในตำแหน่ง Data Scientist 3-5 ปี
3. มีทักษะการเขียนโค้ดที่แข็งแกร่งในภาษา Python หรือ R
4. มีความเชี่ยวชาญในการใช้ภาษา SQL เพื่อดึง, จัดการ และวิเคราะห์ข้อมูล
5. มีประสบการณ์ในการใช้ไลบรารีวิเคราะห์ข้อมูล เช่น Pandas, NumPy
6. มีประสบการณ์ในการสร้าง Visualization ด้วยไลบรารี เช่น Matplotlib หรือ Seaborn
7. มีความเข้าใจอย่างลึกซึ้งในหลักการของ Machine Learning และสถิติ
8. มีประสบการณ์ในการสร้างโมเดลและใช้เฟรมเวิร์ก เช่น Scikit-learn, TensorFlow หรือ PyTorch
9. มีความสามารถในการแปลงปัญหาทางธุรกิจให้เป็นปัญหาเชิงข้อมูล
10. มีทักษะการสื่อสารที่ยอดเยี่ยม สามารถอธิบายข้อมูลเชิงลึกและการวิเคราะห์ที่ซับซ้อนให้แก่ผู้ที่ไม่มีความรู้ทางเทคนิคได้

jobs.description:
Why SoftwareOne? SoftwareOne and Crayon have come together to form a global, AI-powered software and cloud solutions provider with a bold vision for the future. With a footprint in over 70 countries and a diverse team of 13,000+ professionals, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talent to grow, make an impact, and shape the future of technology. At the heart of our business is our people. We empower our teams to work across borders, innovate fearlessly, and continuously develop their skills through world-class learning and development programs. Whether you're passionate about cloud, software, data, AI, or building meaningful client relationships, you’ll find a place to thrive here. Join us and be part of a purpose-driven culture where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your career can go global.

The role Are you passionate about designing intelligent, data-driven solutions that help businesses make smarter decisions?

Do you thrive on solving complex challenges using cutting-edge cloud and AI technologies?

Are you ready to be a trusted advisor, shaping the future of data and AI for leading enterprises?

At SoftwareOne, you’ll join a global, diverse team of professionals dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences. We empower our teams to innovate, collaborate, and continuously develop their skills through world-class learning and development programs.

As a Presales Solution Architect – Azure Data & AI, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing data analytics and AI solutions on the Azure platform. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design end-to-end solutions, and provide technical guidance to ensure scalable, secure, and high-performing architectures.

• Solution Design: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design end-to-end data and AI solutions, and create architectural diagrams and documentation.

• Azure Expertise: Leverage extensive knowledge of Azure services such as Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, AI Foundry, Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Purview, Fabric , Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI to architect robust platforms.

• Data Modeling & integration: Design and optimize data models to support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence needs while ensuring data integrity and performance.

• Scalability and Performance: Architect solutions that are scalable, high-performing, and cost-efficient, considering factors like data volume, query complexity, and user concurrency.

• Security and Compliance: Implement security measures and best practices to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

• Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, data scientists, business analysts, and partners to understand their needs and provide technical guidance.

What we need to see from you
• Experience in solution architecture or presales roles, with a focus on data analytics and Azure cloud technologies (no specific years required).

• Extensive hands-on experience with Azure services such as Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Purview, Fabric, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure OpenAI, and Power BI.

• Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and data governance principles.

• Ability to design secure, scalable, and high-performing architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and mentoring others.

• Commitment to inclusive, collaborative teamwork and continuous learning.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:
• Data Analysis / Data Scientist is responsible for leading data-driven initiatives to enhance product performance, manufacturing capability, and process reliability. This role combines "advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, and manufacturing domain expertise" to uncover insights, solve complex technical problems, and enable Smart Manufacturing across Magnecomp.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Analyze high-volume manufacturing, metrology, and product performance datasets to identify trends, correlations, and failure patterns.

• Apply statistical techniques (SPC, DOE, regression, and multivariate analysis) to support process optimization and variation reduction.

• Build predictive models (machine learning, anomaly detection) to forecast product quality, detect early drift, and optimize process parameters.

• Define new data parameters, sensors, and measurement requirements for improving process visibility.

• Integrate analytics solutions into factory systems (Database, Analysis, Dashboard platforms).

• Lead data-driven projects for product failure analysis and yield improvement.

• Provide effective data analysis with proven validation results and useful analysis to team.

• Collaborate with Design and Product Engineering Teams to evaluate model simulations, analyze test data, and propose design improvements.

• Support Process Engineering by identifying root causes of variation and defining corrective/preventive actions.

• Evaluate and deploy advanced Al/ML solutions (e.g., for visual inspection, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance).

• Partner with IT and Manufacturing Systems teams to develop automated data pipelines, databases, and dashboards.

• Provide technical leadership in cross-site (Internal and External MPT) engineering problem-solving activities.

• Prepare clear reports summarizing insights, modeling results, and recommendations for engineering and management review.

• Present complex technical findings in an understandable and actionable format to cross-functional teams.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Education Required:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or related technical fields.

Skill Required:
• Strong expertise in data mining/exploring, statistical analysis, and machine learning.

• Proficiency in: SQL, Python, JMP / Minitab, Power BI, Grafana, KNIME, TensorFlow, Pytorch & Scikit-Learn.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to interpret complex datasets.

• Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving and ability to work independently.

Experience:
• Hands-on experience in data analytics roles (2-5 years).

• Experience integrating data with manufacturing systems (databases, automation and dashboard systems).

• Project management skills with proven cross-functional collaboration.

• Experience in HDD/suspension/precision manufacturing is an advantage.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Build. Scale. Sustain.

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first engineering approach for accelerating the delivery of digital products and revolutionizing platform modernization. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We're proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion and a B Corp-certified company.

• We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally: 5 continents, 10 countries, 500+ experts from 50+ nationalities across the Americas, Europe, and APAC

• We are robust and resilient: 100% independent and 0 debt

• We are entrepreneurs and passionate experts: we invest in what we genuinely believe and work as a collective intelligence

• We are positive, courageous, caring, doers committed to excellence

About Gen-e2™

While the market is still largely AI-augmenting delivery, we have reinvented the SDLC to be AI-First. Leveraging 16 years of digital transformation expertise, Gen-e2™ is a close collaboration between generative AI and our best engineers:

• We now generate 95% of the entire product, including code, documentation, infrastructure as code, and design, powered by GitHub Copilot

• Quality exceeds the output of our best traditional engineering teams

• A product repository gives AI full project context for higher-quality generation

• A library of rules and prompts enforces coding standards, design principles, and security guidelines, ensuring enterprise-grade scalability

The Gen-e2™ result

We deliver end-to-end products 2-3x faster than traditional approaches. As Head of Engineering, you are accountable for making sure that is genuinely true across our Thailand projects.

Your Role

At PALO IT, AI-Native is the default. As Head of Engineering, your primary focus is engineering quality and the rigorous application of Gen-e2™ across our Thailand operation.

You will be directly involved in a selection of projects, working hands-on alongside teams and setting the standard that others calibrate against. Beyond your own projects, you will coach Tech Leads, establish engineering standards that apply across the delivery portfolio, and develop engineers at all levels.

Overall delivery operations sit with the COO. Your focus is different: how well we engineer, not whether we ship. You are the person who defines and protects what good looks like at PALO IT Thailand, across every technical decision made on our projects.

You will also contribute to presales, bringing engineering credibility and practical delivery insight to bids and client conversations.

Key Responsibilities

Gen-e2™ Rigour and AI-Native Standards Core Mandate

• Own the quality and consistency of Gen-e2™ application across the Thailand engineering team, auditing adoption, identifying gaps, and working with teams to close them

• Define and maintain the engineering standards playbook, covering prompt libraries, coding conventions, AI output validation, security guidelines, and quality gates

• Continuously improve the Gen-e2™ methodology based on what you observe in delivery, what works and what does not

• Evaluate new AI tools and practices that could meaningfully improve quality or velocity

• Be the internal escalation point for hard technical problems, the person teams come to when they are stuck

Embedded Delivery Excellence

• Take direct technical leadership on selected projects, working alongside teams rather than managing from a distance

• Ensure Gen-e2™ is applied with real rigour on the projects you lead, including AI-assisted code generation, automated testing, CI/CD discipline, and structured code review

• Identify and address technical risks and quality issues early, before they become delivery problems

• Share learnings from your own projects with Hive Masters and Tech Leads working on others, and lift standards across the team

People Development and Engineering Culture

• Mentor and develop Hive Masters and Tech Leads, building their technical depth, engineering judgement, and AI-native capability over time

• Foster a culture of craftsmanship and continuous improvement, where engineers take pride in quality and learn from every project

• Support performance conversations and career development for engineers, in partnership with the COO

• Contribute to hiring decisions, helping to assess technical capability and generative AI aptitude in candidates

• Run engineering communities of practice, including knowledge-sharing sessions, technical retrospectives, and cross-team learning

Presales Support Supporting Role

• Contribute engineering expertise to bid and proposal processes, including scoping, effort estimation, and solution validation

• Review technical assumptions in RFP responses to ensure commitments are realistic and deliverable using Gen-e2™

• Join client conversations where technical credibility is needed to progress an opportunity

• Provide input on team composition and technical approach for proposed engagements

Must-Have Experience

• 8 or more years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of hands-on technical leadership on complex delivery projects

• Deep expertise in software engineering practices: architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, and DevOps. You should be able to do this work yourself and teach it credibly

• Experience in a consulting or client-delivery environment, working across multiple projects and technology stacks

• Proven ability to mentor and develop engineers, improving team capability over time

• Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, TDD, and iterative development

• Experience participating in presales or bid processes, contributing to scoping, estimation, and technical proposals

• Demonstrated daily use of AI tools in your engineering work

Generative AI Skills Required

• Hands-on, daily use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor. This should be how you currently work

• Strong understanding of prompt engineering for code generation, documentation, architecture review, and automated testing

• Experience validating and governing GenAI outputs, including reviewing AI-generated code, identifying errors, and enforcing quality guardrails across a team

• Able to build and codify standards for AI-native engineering, including rules, prompt libraries, and playbooks, and to get a team to actually follow them

• Good judgement about when AI output is fit for purpose, when it needs revision, and when to work without it, and the ability to teach that judgement to others

Good to Have

• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), particularly around architecture and CI/CD in cloud-native environments

• Background across multiple technology domains including mobile, DevOps, and full-stack. Breadth is more useful than deep specialization at this level

• Experience working with AI/ML services in a delivery context, such as LLMs, RAG pipelines, or AI agents integrated into products

• Familiarity with enterprise software patterns including micro-services, API design, and event-driven architecture

What Success Looks Like at PALO IT

Gen-e2™ is real

AI-native practices are applied consistently and correctly across teams. You can point to specific evidence of how and where.

Your projects set the bar

The projects you work on directly are the ones others look at as examples of how PALO IT engineers.

Engineers are growing

Hive Masters and Tech Leads are more technically capable and more confident in their AI-native practice than they were a year ago.

Standards stick

The engineering playbook is current and teams actually use it. Quality gates are enforced in practice, not just documented.

Teams get unblocked

When a team hits a hard technical problem, you are the person who helps solve it, using expertise rather than authority.

Bids are credible

Your input on proposals is trusted by the sales team. Technical estimates hold up when the project starts.

More About PALO IT

We are eager to adapt to change, learn from our experiences, and move to meet our planet's urgent needs. We are continuously taking action to:

• Become a climate net-zero company

• Deliver projects with a positive social and environmental impact

• Train 100% of our workforce on impact

• Achieve B Corp certification across all global offices

• Continuously measure and improve employee happiness

Our clients are among the world's most successful companies. We work with Fortune 1000s, SMEs, and start-ups who want to make an impact, become global leaders, and solve complex challenges.

What We Offer

• Stimulating, AI-native working environment

• Unique engineering leadership career path

• International mobility across 10 countries

• Internal R&D projects and Gen-e2™ practice

• Knowledge sharing and global community

• Personalized training and learning budget

• Entrepreneurship and intrapreneurship culture

• B Corp values: impact, wellbeing, excellence

We prioritize local talent

We will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Thailand and do not require visa sponsorship.

PALO IT Thailand is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions will be based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. PALO IT does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexuality, national origin, age, disability, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

Protecting your privacy and the security of your data are longstanding top priorities for PALO IT. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing recruitment-related activities. Please consult our Privacy Notice to learn more.

Speechify is a text-to-speech app that makes it easy for the world to access information. 20+ million people use our Google Chrome extension, web app, iOS app, and Android app. our mission is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Our amazing users are students, professionals, and productivity lovers. Many of them have learning differences like dyslexia and ADHD, while many just want to read faster and listen on the go. With Speechify you can turn any book, document, or website into audio, and listen while you’re in the car, doing laundry, walking your dog, making dinner, working out, skydiving—whatever your daily routine is! Speechify also powers Medium, the Star Tribune, The Direct, and more. Easily add text-to-speech to your website.

Cliff Weitzman, our fearless CEO, founded Speechify in 2017 in a dorm room at Brown University so he could share with others the incredible text-to-speech software he’d been working on. Cliff has dyslexia and he was frustrated with how much time and energy it took for him to read. Advanced TTS technology was a total gamechanger, it allowed him to finish his readings 3x faster than a normal reader and to better comprehend and retain information.

At Speechify our goal is for reading to never be a barrier to learning for anyone. Nothing should hold you back from learning information quickly and effectively.

Speechify has grown to employ over 100 team members spread out across the globe in just a few short years. We're proud of the incredible team with members who were previously leaders and senior engineers at companies like Snapchat, Apple, Spotify, Amazon & Uber. We all love and prioritise ownership, delivering value with speed, learning as much as we can and making our users feel empowered.

The Role

APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/speechify/jobs/5032760004

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

Overview

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You’ll Do

• Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline

• Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.

• Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.

• Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team’s dataset roadmap to power Speechify’s next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

What we offer

• A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.

• An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.

• A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.

• An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.

• Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.

• Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.

• Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products.

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive.

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity.

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry.

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture.

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more.

jobs.title: Computational Data Modeler - AMEA
jobs.description:
The Computational Data Modeler plays a critical role in strengthening Crop Protection R&D by designing reusable data and knowledge structures that make complex scientific information interoperable, discoverable, and AI‑ready. By translating domain complexity into robust computational models and knowledge foundations, the role enables predictive data analytics, scalable digital products, and next‑generation AI solutions across the region – AMEA & JANZ

Accountabilities:

Data Engineering and Computational Modelling

• Design computational data models, reusable schemas, and structured data frameworks that improve interoperability, consistency, and machine usability across the R&D data ecosystem.

• Define reusable entity structures, metadata patterns, relationships, and data contracts that support integration across experimentation systems, analytics environments, and digital products.

• Translate scientific and business complexity into scalable model logic and reusable data structures that support analytics, digital workflows, and AI-enabled applications.

Context- and Knowledge-Driven Data Modelling

• Develop context-rich data models that connect scientific data, metadata, documents, protocols, business rules, and domain concepts into reusable knowledge assets

• Create information structures that preserve scientific meaning and operational context to improve consistency across functions and over time

• Improve discoverability and reuse by formalizing relationships, definitions, and contextual attributes across fragmented systems and data sources.

Ontology, Knowledge Graph, and RAG Foundations

• Apply ontology principles to define consistent concepts, hierarchies, relationships, and machine-readable rules across priority R&D data domains

• Support the development of R&D knowledge graph foundations by modeling relationships between experiments, protocols, observations, methods, assets, and decisions

• Enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and other knowledge-driven AI approaches by improving retrieval structures, contextual linkages, and connections between structured and unstructured information

AI-Ready Data Platform Enablement

• Contribute to AI-ready data platforms by defining reusable knowledge layers, integration patterns, and data-readiness standards

• Partner with platform owners, Bioinformatics leads and technical stakeholders to scalable AI integration, and reliable information retrieval

Collaboration with Data Scientists and Bioinformatics Leads

• Collaborate with Data Scientists and Bioinformatics lead to ensure analytical, digital, and AI solutions are built on reusable and scalable data foundations

• Contribute to shared architecture discussions, design reviews, and foundational modelling decisions aligned with business and platform needs

Documentation, Standards, and Change Enablement

• Document modelling standards, ontologies, schemas, and reusable reference patterns to support consistent adoption across teams

• Provide technical guidance on computational data models, ontology structures and AI-ready data design approaches

Governance, Safety, and Professional Standards

• Ensure data models and knowledge structures align with governance, security, lineage awareness, traceability, and responsible AI enablement standards

• Balance architectural rigor, usability, innovation, usability, and practical business value to support scalable implementation

jobs.title: Sr Engineer (Slider Factory Control System Engineer)
jobs.description:
Factory Control Systems (FCS) is responsible for driving, developing, and deploying solutions that enhance the performance, quality, and efficiency of Slider manufacturing processes. We deliver data analytics, data visualization, advanced process control systems, and AI/Machine Learning solutions to accelerate Smart Factory initiatives and Slider modernization. We work closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, Process Engineering, Maintenance Engineering and customers, to drive manufacturing excellence and support HAMR and future-generation products.

• Analyze KPIV and KPOV data to identify root causes, drive corrective actions, and prevent process failures or downstream excursions.

• Develop and deploy advanced process control and AI-driven solutions to improve manufacturing performance, including SPC automation, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and failure prevention.

• Design and implement automated monitoring and visualization systems using SQL, KNIME, Python, Power-BI and Tableau, integrating data from multiple enterprise sources to provide real-time insights and early detection of process anomalies.

• Collaborate with Process Engineering (PE), Maintenance Engineering (ME), IT, and cross-functional teams to operationalize analytics, AI/ML, and process control solutions that enhance process stability, product quality, and manufacturing efficiency.

• Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a good command of English.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.

• Proficiency in data analytics, software development, and solution design to deliver high-quality business applications.

• Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI technologies, with the ability to apply them to solve manufacturing and business challenges.

• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctoral degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related Engineering field.

• 3–5 years of experience in manufacturing data analytics, process control, software development, AI/ML, or related fields.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop and deploy data-driven, automation, and AI/ML solutions to address manufacturing and business challenges.

• Proficiency in SQL, Python, database technologies, and web development tools; experience with Java, C#, or other programming languages is an advantage.

• Experience with data analytics, visualization, and workflow automation platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, KNIME, JMP, Minitab, or equivalent tools.

• Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, and their practical applications in manufacturing environments is preferred.

• Knowledge of Slider manufacturing processes and KPIV/KPOV concepts is an added advantage.

Korat Thailand

Our Korat facility is our largest manufacturing site worldwide, with more than 10,000 employees. Here, our team produces cloud-based storage equipment, from individual storage components to finished drives. Employees enjoy ample on-site parking, free shuttle vans and buses within the city of Korat, as well as transportation to and from Bangkok and Khon Kaen province on weekends. At work, you can grab a delicious breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks at one of our 24/7 on-site canteens or coffee shops. We offer table tennis, basketball, volleyball, a running/walking trail, and exercise classes in our on-site fitness center. In addition, there are relaxing spaces with comfortable seating both indoors and outdoors, perfect for taking a break during the day. Additionally, consider joining any of our employee resource groups (ERGs), such as Seagate Women in Leadership Network (SWLN), Seagate PRIDE: Thailand chapter, or Seagate Asia’s parents and caregivers group. We also have many on-site recreation events and opportunities to give back to the local community.
