You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of our Google Workspace (GWS) ecosystem, establishing robust data security protocols, and leading the integration of AI tools to enhance our operational efficiency. This role requires a blend of technical expertise and managerial foresight to build a scalable foundation for our growing team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
IT Infrastructure & GWS Management
• Administer and optimize the Google Workspace (GWS) environment, including user lifecycle management, advanced Gmail security, and Shared Google Drive architecture.

• Manage hardware procurement, inventory, and vendor relationships.

• Ensure 99.9% uptime for all essential business applications and cloud services.

Security, Data Centralization and Systems Integration
• Develop and implement company-wide cybersecurity policies such as Multi-factor authentication (MFA), SSO, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and data encryption.

• Design and execute a data centralization plan to eliminate information silos and ensure the necessary information is accessible to the relevant parties.

• Bridge the gap between different business platforms like Asana, BambooHR, Airtable etc. building automated pipelines and APIs that allow them to seamlessly share data and eliminate manual data entry.

• Perform regular security audits and vulnerability assessments to protect sensitive intellectual property.

AI Optimization & Strategy
• Identify opportunities to integrate AI and Automation into daily workflows (e.g., Gemini for Google Workspace, LLM-based internal tools, or automated scripting).

• Train staff on AI best practices and prompt engineering to increase organization-wide productivity.

• Stay ahead of emerging tech trends to recommend tools that provide a competitive advantage.

Website Development & Maintenance
• Oversee the technical administration, hosting, security (such as SSL certificates and automated backups), and performance optimization of the primary organization website (jumpfoundation.org) and any associated landing pages

• Collaborate with the internal marketing team to implement front-end or back-end updates, manage Content Management Systems (CMS), and ensure seamless website integration with internal automated data pipelines

Leadership & Operations
• Manage the IT budget/spending and provide regular reporting on system health and project milestones to senior leadership.

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for IT processes and user guides for employees.

• Act as the bridge between technical requirements and business goals.

QUALIFICATIONS & ABILITIES
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

• 3+ years of working experience in IT administration, AI Optimization, and Data Security

• Expert-level knowledge of Google Workspace Administration (Certification is a plus)

• Proven track record of implementing data security system in GWS

• Strong understanding of AI/ML integration (experience with OpenAI API, Google Gemini, or workflow automation tools like Zapier/Make)

• Problem-solving mindset with the passion for creating systems where none currently exist

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where AI tools and security needs evolve weekly

• Proficiency in English and Thai languages to adapt to a multi-lingual working environment

BENEFITS & COMPENSATION:
• Access to Group Health Insurance Program

• Extensive Leave Program

• Relocation stipend (if applicable)

• Connectivity within JUMP’s global network of partners and collaborators that innovate education across the world

• Opportunity to contribute to the long-term strategy and direction of the organization

• Being a part of a fast-growing non profit social enterprise with global opportunities

CHILD SAFEGUARDING:
At JUMP! Foundation, we prioritize child safety and require all applicants to adhere to our Child Protection Policy. This commitment involves signing a declaration of any criminal convictions, providing three professional references known for over two years, and undergoing a thorough background check from the candidate’s home or most recent country of residence. Acceptance and adherence to our Child Protection Policy and conduct guidelines for working with children are essential conditions of employment.

ABOUT JUMP! FOUNDATION:
JUMP! Foundation is a non-profit organization that believes in inspiring, empowering, and engaging youth through collaborative and innovative experiential learning programs. JUMP! offers a series of leadership activities suited for students at international schools and universities, including in-school workshops (JUMP! Schools programs) and outdoor adventure trips (JUMP! Experience programs). We facilitate participants to develop personal, community, and inter-community leadership skills. To help realize our vision for a world in which young people fulfill their true potential, JUMP! donates a proportion of its revenue to support experiential youth-focused development projects around the world.

JUMP! is committed to employment equity. We encourage qualified applicants from members of minority groups, indigenous people, LGBTQ+ people, and all those with the knowledge, skills, and values to engage effectively with diverse communities.

For more information: Visit our Website

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Lead data engineers at Thoughtworks develop modern data architecture approaches to meet key business objectives and provide end-to-end data solutions. They might spend a few weeks with a new client on a deep technical review or a complete organizational review, helping them to understand the potential that data brings to solve their most pressing problems. On projects, they will be leading the design of technical solutions, or perhaps overseeing a program inception to build a new product. Alongside hands-on coding, they are leading the team to implement the solution.

*Due to the nature of the projects , this role requires the successful candidate to be a Thai Citizen *

Job responsibilities

• You will lead and manage data engineering projects from inception to completion, including goal-setting, scope definition and ensuring on-time delivery with cross team collaboration.

• You will collaborate with stakeholders to understand their strategic objectives and identify opportunities to leverage data and data quality.

• You will design, develop and operate modern data architecture approaches to meet key business objectives and provide end-to-end data solutions.

• You will be responsible to create, design and develop intricate data processing pipelines, addressing clients' most challenging problems.

• You will collaborate with data scientists to design scalable implementations of their models.

• You write clean and iterative code based on TDD and leverage various continuous delivery practices to deploy, support and operate data pipelines.

• You will lead and advise clients on how to use different distributed storage and computing technologies from the plethora of options available.

• You will develop data models by selecting from a variety of modeling techniques and implementing the chosen data model using the appropriate technology stack.

• You will be responsible for data governance, data security and data privacy to support business and compliance requirements.

• You will define the strategy for and incorporate data quality into your day-to-day work.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

• You have experience in leading the system design and implementation of technical solutions.

• Working with data excites you; You have created Big Data architecture, can build and operate data pipelines, and maintain data storage, all within distributed systems.

• You have a deep understanding of data modeling and experience with modern data engineering tools and platforms.

• You have hands-on experience with Python (must have), Spark, and big data processing.

• You have experience with at least one Cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). And, Databricks experience is preferred.

• You have experience in writing clean, high-quality code using the preferred programming language.

• You have built and deployed large-scale data pipelines and data-centric applications using any of the distributed storage platforms and distributed processing platforms in a production setting.

• You have experience with data visualization techniques and can communicate the insights as per the audience.

• You have experience with data-driven approaches and can apply data security and privacy strategy to solve business problems.

• You have experience with different types of databases (i.e.: SQL, NoSQL, data lake, data schemas, etc.).

Professional Skills

• You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders throughout projects, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.

• You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.

• You don’t shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.

• You coach, mentor and motivate others and you aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.

• You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.

• You are a proven leader with a track record of encouraging teammates in their professional development and relationships.

• Cultivating strong partnerships comes naturally to you; You understand the importance of relationship building and how it can bring new opportunities to our business.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

jobs.title: Golang Developer (IOT)
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a talented Golang Developer (IOT) to join BIGGOLD DIGITAL INNOVATION CO., LTD. in Bangkok. This is a contract position that offers an exciting opportunity to work on Internet of Things (IOT) projects using Go programming language. As a Golang Developer specialising in IOT, you will play a crucial role in developing robust, scalable, and efficient software solutions that power our IOT initiatives. This position is instrumental in driving our technological innovation and delivering high-performance applications that connect and manage IoT devices and systems.
Key responsibilities
• Design and develop IOT applications and services using Go (Golang), ensuring code quality, performance, and security standards are met

• Build and maintain backend systems and microservices that support IOT device communication, data processing, and integration

• Collaborate with hardware engineers and cross-functional teams to understand IOT requirements and translate them into scalable software solutions

• Implement APIs and protocols for IOT device connectivity, including MQTT, CoAP, and other relevant communication standards

• Develop and optimise database solutions for handling large volumes of IOT sensor data and real-time analytics

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices and coding standards

• Perform code reviews and contribute to the improvement of development processes and workflows

• Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues in IOT systems and deployed applications

• Participate in testing, debugging, and deployment of IOT software solutions across various environments

What we're looking for
• Proven professional experience as a Software Engineer or Golang Developer, with a minimum of 2-3 years of hands-on experience with Go programming language

• Strong understanding of IOT architecture, protocols, and technologies, including experience with IoT platforms and frameworks

• Solid knowledge of RESTful API design and development, as well as experience with microservices architecture

• Experience with real-time data processing, stream processing, or event-driven architectures

• Familiarity with databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or InfluxDB for handling IOT data

• Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, preferably with experience deploying IOT solutions

• Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• Preferred: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerisation technologies

• Preferred: Familiarity with IoT security best practices and protocols

• Preferred: Experience working on embedded systems or edge computing solutions

Please attach your CV, transcript, copy of your ID card, and certificates (if any) to ••••@biggolddigital.com .
Only applicants who submit complete documents will be considered.
BIGGOLD DIGITAL INNOVATION CO., LTD. is crucial to the development of technology for organizations, playing a vital role in driving the organization.

What we offer

BIGGOLD DIGITAL INNOVATION CO., LTD. is committed to providing a supportive and dynamic working environment where our employees can thrive and grow. We offer competitive compensation packages commensurate with experience and qualifications. As part of our commitment to employee wellbeing and professional development, we provide opportunities for continuous learning and skill enhancement through training programmes and industry conferences. We foster a collaborative culture that encourages innovation and creative problem-solving. This contract position offers the flexibility to work on cutting-edge IOT technology whilst maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We also provide a professional workplace in the heart of Bangkok with access to modern facilities and collaborative spaces.
About us

BIGGOLD DIGITAL INNOVATION CO., LTD. is a forward-thinking technology company specialising in digital innovation and IOT solutions. We are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technology to solve complex business challenges and create meaningful impact for our clients. Our team comprises talented software engineers, architects, and innovators who are dedicated to delivering high-quality solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. With a focus on emerging technologies such as IoT, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing, we are positioned at the forefront of digital transformation. We believe in investing in our people and creating an environment where they can develop their skills and advance their careers.
Apply now

If you are a skilled Golang Developer with a passion for IOT technology and are ready to make an impact with BIGGOLD DIGITAL INNOVATION CO., LTD., we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter, and any relevant portfolio or GitHub links showcasing your work. Join us in shaping the future of IOT innovation.

jobs.title: Microsoft Power Platform & AI Developer (Data Analyst & Automation Specialist)
jobs.description:
ตำแหน่ง: Microsoft Power Platform & AI Developer (Data Analyst & Automation Specialist)
บริษัท เยี่ยมพาณิชย์ อินเตอร์เนชั่นแนล จำกัด กำลังมองหาผู้พัฒนาที่มีความชำนาญด้าน Microsoft Power Platform และ AI เพื่อเข้ามาร่วมทีมของเรา คุณจะเป็นส่วนสำคัญในการสร้างโซลูชั่นดิจิทัลที่ตอบโจทย์ความต้องการของธุรกิจ
หน้าที่หลัก:
• Multi-Department Power BI Dashboards : ดึงข้อมูลและเชื่อมโยงตารางจาก Dynamics 365 เพื่อสร้างและดูแล Dashboard วิเคราะห์ข้อมูลระดับสูง พร้อมระบบ Auto-Refresh ให้กับแผนกต่าง ๆ เช่น
• ฝ่ายขาย (Sales) : สรุปยอดขายยอดฮิต, อัตราการเติบโต (YoY/QoQ), ยอดขายแยกตามพนักงาน/พื้นที่, พฤติกรรมการซื้อซ้ำ และการวิเคราะห์กลุ่มลูกค้า (RFM Analysis)

• ฝ่ายคลังสินค้าและจัดซื้อ (Inventory & Procurement) : รายงานสต็อกคงเหลือ, อัตราการหมุนเวียนสินค้า (Stock Turnover), แจ้งเตือนสินค้าจม (Dead Stock)/สินค้าใกล้หมดอายุ, และการวิเคราะห์ระยะเวลาส่งมอบของซัพพลายเออร์ (Vendor Lead Time)

• ฝ่ายบัญชีและการเงิน (Finance & Accounting) : รายงานอายุหนี้ค้างชำระ (AR/AP Aging), สรุปกระแสเงินสด (Cash Flow Projection) และการเปรียบเทียบต้นทุน-กำไร

• Logistics & Truck Load Optimization : พัฒนาแอปพลิเคชันด้วย Power Apps สำหรับแผนกขนส่ง เพื่อคำนวณปริมาตรสินค้า (CBM) และน้ำหนักรวมในแต่ละบิลอัตโนมัติ ช่วยให้พนักงานขนส่งเลือกจัดบิลสินค้าบรรจุได้เต็มคันรถอย่างแม่นยำและคุ้มค่าที่สุด

• AI & Voice Automation : ออกแบบและพัฒนาระบบ Voice-to-Order เชื่อมต่อ LINE Messaging API เข้ากับ Power Automate และ AI API (เช่น OpenAI Whisper + Claude) เพื่อแปลงข้อความเสียงภาษาพูดของทีมขาย ให้กลายเป็นโครงสร้างข้อมูลและสร้าง Sales Order ในระบบ Dynamics 365 ได้โดยอัตโนมัติ

• Warehouse & Business Automation : พัฒนาระบบการทำงานอัตโนมัติด้วย Power Automate เพื่อลดขั้นตอนการทำงานด้วยมือ (Manual Tasks) เช่น ระบบใช้ AI (OCR) ถอดข้อมูลจากรูปถ่ายใบส่งของเพื่อรับสินค้าเข้าคลัง หรือคัดกรองเอกสาร PDF (PO/Invoice) เข้าสู่ ERP ทันที

• วิเคราะห์ข้อมูลเชิงลึกจากแหล่งข้อมูลต่างๆ และนำเสนอผลลัพธ์ที่มีประโยชน์ต่อองค์กร

• สร้างกระบวนการอัตโนมัติเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพในการทำงาน

• ให้คำแนะนำและสนับสนุนทีมงานอย่างต่อเนื่อง

• ติดตามและปรับปรุงโซลูชั่นให้สอดคล้องกับความต้องการที่เปลี่ยนแปลงไป

ทักษะ คุณสมบัติ และประสบการณ์:
• ปริญญาตรีหรือสูงกว่าในสาขาวิศวกรรมคอมพิวเตอร์ วิทยาศาสตร์คอมพิวเตอร์ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง (ยินดีรับผู้ที่มีประสบการณ์ตรงจากสาขาอื่น)

• มีทักษะและความเชี่ยวชาญในการใช้งาน Power BI, Power Automate และ Power Apps เป็นอย่างดี (สามารถดีไซน์ UI ของแอปพลิเคชันให้ผู้ใช้หน้างานใช้งานได้ง่าย)

• สามารถเขียนสูตร Advanced DAX และใช้งาน Power Query เพื่อสร้าง Logic การคำนวณและ Data Model ที่ซับซ้อนของแต่ละแผนกได้

• มีความเข้าใจโครงสร้างข้อมูล และมีประสบการณ์ในการเชื่อมต่อข้อมูลจาก Microsoft Dynamics 365 หรือ Microsoft Dataverse / OData / SQL

• มีประสบการณ์หรือความเข้าใจในการเชื่อมต่อ API ภายนอก (เช่น LINE Messaging API, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API) เข้ากับระบบ Microsoft Ecosystem

• มีความคิดเชิงตรรกะ (Logical Thinking) สามารถสื่อสารกับ User หน้างาน (ฝ่ายขาย/คลังสินค้า/ขนส่ง/บัญชี) เพื่อแกะโจทย์ธุรกิจออกมาเป็นระบบและรายงานที่ใช้งานได้จริง

• ทักษะการสื่อสารที่ดี สามารถทำงานเป็นทีมได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

สนใจสมัครตำแหน่งนี้? เข้ามาร่วมเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของทีมพัฒนาดิจิทัลของเราที่ บริษัท เยี่ยมพาณิชย์ อินเตอร์เนชั่นแนล จำกัด ตอบสนองความท้าทายทางธุรกิจด้วยสมรรถนะที่โดดเด่นของคุณ สมัครตำแหน่งพัฒนา Microsoft Power Platform & AI Developer ที่นี่วันนี้

jobs.description:
Job Descriptions:
• Corporate Data Standardization: Define, document, and enforce data definitions and business logic to guarantee single-source-of-truth consistency across all BOL’s products.

• Bridging Business and AI: Act as the critical translator between business stakeholders and technical pods. You will break down complex5regulatory needs into highly structured data requirements for our downstream AI Engineering and Data Science teams.

• Enabling AI Use Cases: Ensure the underlying data architecture is properly structured to feed our predictive AI, behavioral biometrics, and hyper-personalized customer experience engines without latency or data quality issues.

• Secure by Design: Embed PDPA compliance and strict access controls into the foundational architecture to ensure customer privacy is maintained across all personalized insights and API integrations.

• Audit Point of Contact: Act as the primary point of contact for all internal and external audits regarding data operations.

• Data Lineage: Establish and maintain comprehensive data lineage—tracking the lifecycle of data from customer origin, through our core systems, all the way to final regulatory and business reports. You must be able to clearly defend report logic to auditors.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, Cybersecurity or related field.

• 0-5 years of experiences blending data architecture, data governance, and technical business analysis within financial services sector (commercial banks, or regulated FinTech).

• Deep, hands-on understanding of Bank of Thailand (BOT) reporting requirements, AML/KYC mandates, and Thai PDPA.

• Strong capability in designing modern cloud data architectures, data modeling, and master data management (MDM).

• Proven track record of managing data lineage, working directly with IT auditors, and utilizing data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra, Alation).

• Exceptional ability to translate complex technical constraints to key stakeholders while simultaneously explaining strict regulatory business logic to software and AI engineers.

jobs.title: Pricing Analyst - Data Collection & Annotation
jobs.description:
Andovar builds large-scale multilingual data collection and annotation datasets used to train ASR, TTS, and other AI models — for example, multi-locale telephony/IVR speech corpora spanning dozens of languages, with strict audio specifications and heavy structured annotation. Pricing these projects is genuinely hard: every quote is a puzzle of interacting cost drivers, and nearly every new project surfaces a factor we have not priced before.
We are looking for a rigorous, analytical mind to own the deconstruction and costing of these quotes building them from first principles and stress-testing quotes prepared by others.This is not a client-facing role. It is for someone intellectually curious to master every layer of the data collection and annotation industry, and who enjoys taking a messy, ambiguous scope and resolving it into a clean, defensible cost model.

Key Responsibilities
Quote Development & Cost Modeling
• Break complex DCA project scopes into their component cost drivers and build detailed, defensible quotes from the ground up, working from client specifications and historical project data.

• Identify and account for every factor that affects pricing: language scarcity/tier, audio specifications (e.g., 8kHz telephony vs 16kHz wideband), noise/SNR requirements, speaker and demographic stratification, script authoring, transcription and annotation depth, QA overheads, sourcing costs, compliance requirements, and delivery timelines.

• Build structured cost models that show unit pricing, volume impact, and margin contribution. Document all assumptions clearly so the Operations Manager and wider team can understand and pressure-test the logic.

Scope Analysis & Risk Identification
• Audit and pressure-test quotes prepared by others, catching missing scope, mis-costed drivers, unrealistic timeline assumptions, and margin risk before they reach a client.

• Surface ambiguities and gaps in project briefs early. Ask the hard questions: Is the script authoring timeline realistic? Are QA checkpoints sufficient? Have we accounted for speaker sourcing risk in this market?

• Identify cost sensitivities and develop contingency models. Flag which factors (e.g., speaker availability, annotation complexity) have the biggest impact on project economics.

Continuous Learning & Model Refinement
• Proactively surface new pricing factors on novel projects that were not considered in prior quotes, and fold them into our models. Document what you learn so the team benefits.

• Continuously deepen your understanding of the entire data collection and annotation value chain: sourcing, recording, annotation, QA, tooling, and delivery. Build models of cost behavior across different project types, languages, and geographies.

• Maintain and evolve pricing templates and reference data. Recommend updates to cost assumptions as we learn from delivered projects.

• Collaborate with Operations, QA, and Studio teams to validate pricing assumptions against actual delivery costs and quality metrics.

Analysis & Communication
• Build detailed spreadsheet models that isolate cost drivers, test sensitivity to changes in assumptions, and clearly show margin impact of scope variations.

• Communicate pricing logic clearly and concisely to the Operations Manager and wider team. Be able to explain your reasoning in writing and in discussion; challenge (respectfully) other cost estimates if you see flaws.

• Prepare pricing memos and documentation that capture the logic behind quotes — this protects the company if scope disputes arise post-engagement.

What we're looking for
• Master's degree in Mathematics, Physics, or a closely related quantitative field. Finance or Economics also welcome.

• A sharp, first-principles analytical mind comfortable decomposing ambiguous problems and reasoning about many interacting variables at once.

• Exceptional attention to detail, you catch the thing everyone else missed.

• Strong written communication able to explain complex cost logic clearly and concisely.

• Self-driven and intellectually curious, with a genuine appetite to learn a specialised industry deeply.

• Strong spreadsheet fluency and comfort with structured, quantitative modelling. (Python/SQL a plus, not required.)

Why This Role
AI is moving fast, and the quality of human data is what separates models that work from models that truly understand. A steep learning curve into a fast-growing corner of the AI industry. We're scaling quickly and the biggest operational challenge ahead is deploying the right contributors, at speed, without cutting corners on quality or ethics. We're working closely with an international team across Bangkok and beyond.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior data engineers at Thoughtworks are engineers who build, maintain and test the software architecture and infrastructure for managing data applications. They are involved in developing core capabilities which include technical and functional data platforms. They are the anchor for functional streams of work and are accountable for timely delivery. They work on the latest big data tools, frameworks and offerings (data mesh, etc.), while also being involved in enabling credible and collaborative problem solving to execute on a strategy.

*Due to the nature of the projects, this role requires the successful candidate to be a Thai Citizen *

Job responsibilities

• You will develop and operate modern data architecture approaches to meet key business objectives and provide end-to-end data solutions.

• You will develop intricate data processing pipelines, addressing clients' most challenging problems.

• You will collaborate with data scientists to design scalable implementations of their models.

• You will write clean, iterative code using TDD and leverage various continuous delivery practices to deploy, support and operate data pipelines.

• You will use different distributed storage and computing technologies from the plethora of options available.

• You will develop data models by selecting from a variety of modeling techniques and implementing the chosen data model using the appropriate technology stack.

• You will collaborate with the team on the areas of data governance, data security and data privacy.

• You will incorporate data quality into your day-to-day work.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

• You have hands-on experience with Python (must have), Spark, and big data processing.

• You have experience with at least one Cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

•
Databricks experience is preferred.

• Working with data excites you; You can build and operate data pipelines, and maintain data storage, all within distributed systems.

• You have hands-on experience of data modeling and modern data engineering tools and platforms.

• You have experience in writing clean, high-quality code using the preferred programming language.

• You have built and deployed large-scale data pipelines and data-centric applications using any of the distributed storage platforms and distributed processing platforms in a production setting.

• You have experience with data visualization techniques and can communicate the insights as per the audience.

• You have experience with data-driven approaches and can apply data security and privacy strategy to solve business problems.

• You have experience with different types of databases (i.e.: SQL, NoSQL, data lake, data schemas, etc.).

Professional Skills

• You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders throughout projects, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.

• You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.

• You don’t shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.

• You are eager to coach, mentor and motivate others and you aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.

• You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.

Engineering - Technology at Coda

At Coda, our goal is to make our mark in the high-volume payments and e-commerce industry – and we are levelling up fast. To stay in stride with the dynamic environment, we focus on building robust, distributed systems that can effortlessly handle traffic spikes. Moreover, our ambitious roadmap necessitates innovative tools to streamline the development lifecycle and sustain our swift momentum.

We place great value on balancing teamwork with individual autonomy, allowing our teams to make the most of modern cloud infrastructure. Our tech stack is solidly based on AWS cloud, with a keen interest in infrastructure-as-code and the creation of new microservices via the Quarkus framework. Our toolbox includes JSON and GRPC, multiple data storage integrations, queues, OpenTelemetry, and more.

But what truly defines us? It's our incredible team. We hire top talent and give them the freedom to push Coda's technology and products to exciting new levels. We believe that genius can strike anywhere, so we promote ownership and cultivate a servant leadership culture that lets engineers take the reins on features.

•
Build and maintain high-performance, scalable data systems and architectures that enable faster, deeper insights across the organization.

•
Design and develop robust ETL/ELT pipelines for both batch and streaming data using modern software engineering practices.

•
Deploy, manage, and monitor cloud-based data infrastructure with a heavy emphasis on automation and reliability.

•
Support Data Scientists by streamlining, automating, and deploying machine learning models and supporting modern AI agentic workflows.

•
Improve and maintain data quality, data modeling, and governance standards across our Data lakehouse.

•
Communicate effectively with stakeholders, and engineer solutions that empower analysts and product teams.

•
A solid background in Software Engineering with practical experience managing and processing "Big Data" within data lakes and data warehouses.

•
Hands-on experience creating, deploying, and maintaining cloud infrastructure using Terraform .

•
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL , alongside deep comfort with core software development principles.

•
Practical experience in one or more backend programming languages (Java, Scala, Go, Rust, C++, etc.) and the ability to spin up on new languages quickly.

•
Experience working with major data warehouse/lake platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP) and designing complex DAGs in Airflow (or similar orchestration tools).

•
Experience with data streaming tools and frameworks such as Spark Streaming and Kafka.

•
Exposure to, or strong interest in, MLOps (Machine Learning operations) and building/comfort with AI agentic workflows .

•
Solid understanding of data modeling, cataloging, governance, and quality monitoring.

•
Experience developing scalable data architectures in accordance with global compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, or PDPA).

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued.

Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
Job Description (มีประสบการณ์ทำงานด้าน software development อย่างน้อย 1 ปี)
เรากำลังมองหา Software Engineer ที่สามารถพัฒนา web application, backend service และทำงานร่วมกับ AI tools / coding agents ได้
ตำแหน่งนี้เหมาะกับคนที่ชอบสร้าง product จริง เรียนรู้เร็ว เข้าใจพื้นฐานการเขียนโปรแกรม และสามารถใช้ AI เป็นเครื่องมือช่วยเพิ่ม productivity ได้อย่างมีความรับผิดชอบ

ขอบเขตการทำงาน
1. พัฒนา web application ด้วย TypeScript และ modern frontend framework
2. พัฒนา backend API / backend service
3. ออกแบบและเชื่อมต่อ database ด้วย ORM เช่น Prisma
4. ทำงานร่วมกับทีมเพื่อออกแบบ feature, API, data model และ user flow
5. ใช้ AI tools / coding agents เพื่อช่วยเขียน code, debug, refactor และเพิ่ม productivity
6. Review และทำความเข้าใจ code ที่ AI generate มา ไม่ copy-paste โดยไม่เข้าใจ
7. แก้ไข bug และปรับปรุง code ให้ maintainable
8. ทำงานร่วมกับ Git / GitHub และ workflow ของทีม
9. เขียน README หรือ documentation ที่จำเป็นสำหรับ project

Technical Skills
- TypeScript
- React
- TanStack Start
- Tailwind CSS
- REST API / HTTP
- Git / GitHub
- Basic database knowledge
- Basic backend development

มีประสบการณ์หรือพร้อมเรียนรู้
- Bun
- Elysia
- Prisma
- SQLite / PostgreSQL หรือ relational database อื่น ๆ

AI Skill Requirement
1. ใช้ AI tools เช่น Pi, OpenCode, KiloCode, Codex, Claude, Cursor หรือ coding agent อื่น ๆ ได้
2. เขียน prompt ให้ AI เข้าใจ context ของงาน
3. อ่านและตรวจสอบ code ที่ AI สร้างให้
4. อธิบายได้ว่า code ทำงานอย่างไร
5. Debug code ที่ AI generate มาได้
6. ไม่ copy-paste code โดยไม่เข้าใจ
7. ใช้ AI เพื่อช่วยคิด solution, refactor, test และแก้ bug

> ไม่จำเป็นต้องเก่งทั้ง stack และ AI ตั้งแต่แรก
> แต่ต้องมีอย่างน้อยอย่างใดอย่างหนึ่งที่แข็งแรง:
> พื้นฐาน coding ดี หรือ ใช้ AI ได้ดีและเข้าใจ output

จะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษถ้ามีประสบการณ์กับ:
- Elysia / Hono / Express
- Prisma
- Docker
- Go
- Shadcn UI
- AI SDK
- Mastra
- OpenAI / OpenRouter / LLM API
- Building internal tools
- Fullstack project ตั้งแต่ frontend ถึง backend
- เคย deploy application จริง
- เคยทำงานกับ coding agent หรือ AI automation

Candidate Profile เหมาะกับคนที่
- ชอบเรียนรู้เทคโนโลยีใหม่
- ใช้ AI เป็นเครื่องมือในการทำงาน
- กล้าถามเมื่อไม่เข้าใจ
- อธิบายสิ่งที่ตัวเองทำได้
- ไม่กลัวการ debug
- รับ feedback ได้
- สนใจทั้ง frontend, backend และ AI application
- อยากทำ product จริง ไม่ใช่แค่เขียนตาม task

สิ่งที่ต้องส่ง:
1. CV / Resume
2. GitHub profile
3. Portfolio หรือ project ที่เคยทำ
4. ตัวอย่าง project ที่ภูมิใจ หรือ link demo ถ้ามี
5. เขียนสั้น ๆ ว่าเคยใช้ AI tools อะไรในการ coding และใช้อย่างไร

jobs.title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1)
jobs.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively. You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.

You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.

Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
• Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.

• Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.

• Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.

• Good understanding of using ITSM tools and ITSM processes.

• Strong planning skills, considering possible changes and circumstances.

• A strong work ethic, including the capacity to put in longer hours when necessary.

• Adaptability to changing environments.

• A client-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.

• The aptitude to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.

• Excellent active listening skills, confirming understanding and seeking relevant information.

• A positive outlook and resilience under pressure.

• A bachelor’s degree in information technology/computing or equivalent experience.

Workplace type:
On-site Working
About NTT DATA
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

Equal Opportunity Employer
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an @nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us.

We are looking for a fullstack software engineer to work on our platform, both frontend and backend developmen. Our product encompasses IoT, data engineering and green technology.

What You'll Do
You'll build and ship across our stack — from the rider app and dealer tools to S-Charge backend services and internal dashboards. Small team, real ownership, no layers between you and production. We expect one AI-native developer to ship what a traditional team of three ships.

Responsibility
• Own features end-to-end: Design, build, test, deploy, and monitor — both frontend and backend.

• Work across the ecosystem: The SLEEK app, S-Charge platform, dealer/internal tools, and the APIs connecting them.

• Use AI tools by default: Utilize Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent as your primary workflow for scaffolding, refactoring, writing tests, debugging, and documentation.

• Review and harden AI-generated code: You're the engineer, the AI is the accelerant; you own the code quality.

• Collaborate directly: Work closely with the Tech Lead and CEO on priorities; proactively propose technical solutions rather than waiting for specs.

• Maintain velocity: Keep shipping speed high without letting the codebase rot.

Qualifications
• 2–5 years full stack experience: You're comfortable in both frontend and backend, and can deploy what you build independently.

• Provably AI-native: You already code daily with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar. (Note: In the interview, we'll give you a real task and watch how you work with AI tools — this is the core of the assessment).

• Strong technical judgment: You know when to trust AI output and when not to — you can spot hallucinated APIs, bad design patterns, and security issues in generated code.

• Fast and pragmatic: You'd rather ship a working v1 this week than a perfect v1 next month.

• Self-managing: You break down your own work, communicate progress clearly, and flag blockers early.

• Language: Thai or English working proficiency (the team is Thai-speaking; documentation is mixed).

Nice-to-haves:
• Strong familiarity with NestJS + TypeORM (including handling complex relations and database migrations).

• Solid understanding of the Next.js Server vs. Client Components architecture.

• Experience building high-performance web applications that handle complex server state and data fetching using React Query .

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.

We are looking for an independent, passionate, and persuasive Senior Security Engineer to join our Security Engineering team. You will play a crucial role in driving vulnerability remediation and securing applications from the outset, utilizing cutting-edge solutions to effectively prevent attacks and safeguard the business.

• Work closely with the engineering team on all security initiatives, ensuring products are built securely by default and that audits and remediation efforts are managed to achieve smooth, timely resolution.

• Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability analyses to identify threats and security gaps in existing and new systems and architectures.

• Perform vulnerability scanning across networks, systems, middleware, and databases, then assess each finding by likelihood and potential impact to prioritize what matters.

• Manage the remediation lifecycle with a risk-based approach, ensuring vulnerabilities are resolved in line with accepted industry standards.

• Implement and manage static and dynamic code analysis (SAST/DAST) in CI/CD pipelines; perform source code security reviews and advise developers on remediation.

• Manage the end-to-end process for externally reported vulnerabilities and bug bounty submissions.

• Lead initiatives that measurably reduce risk across our application and infrastructure stack, including applying AI/ML tooling where it delivers real leverage.

• Use scripting and automation to remove manual toil and improve team workflows, rather than defaulting to manual processes out of habit

• Take strong ownership of outcomes beyond assigned tasks: proactively identify risks, surface them early to the right stakeholders, and drive resolution without waiting to be asked.

• Clarify vulnerabilities and risks directly with product and engineering stakeholders rather than assuming; communicate bad news, delays, scope changes, and newly discovered risks early, and always pair them with options, not just problems.

• Stay flexible and resourceful, taking on new challenges as the business evolves

• At least 5+ years in cybersecurity, of which 3+ years is focused on vulnerability management

• At least 3+ years in software development and scripting (Java, Node.js, Python) with continued hands-on use. Able to independently write scripts and simple web apps to solve day-to-day security needs

• Solid foundations in networking, operating systems, and applications

• Demonstrated track record of self-directed work rather than just completed assignments, with concrete examples of risks you identified, owned, and drove to resolution independently, including picking up new skills as needed

• Strong stakeholder management: able to clarify vulnerabilities and risks directly with product and engineering, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

• Experience building dedicated internal tools, dashboards, or CI/CD integrations beyond ad hoc scripting

• Experience in bug bounty, penetration testing, and vulnerability assessment

• Knowledge of cloud security

• Knowledge of container security

• Knowledge of AI security

• Knowledge of DevSecOps and security tools in CI/CD

• Hold OSCP, OSWE, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, GPEN, and/or CREST certification

• Experience with a tech or financial services company

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued.

Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
Company description Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Overview Digital Platform Engineer - Hybrid 1-year Contract

The Digital Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining digital infrastructure to enable machine connectivity, real-time data integration, and visualization within manufacturing environments. The role focuses on establishing reliable data pipelines from shopfloor equipment (e.g., new plating line machines), ensuring seamless integration with SCADA systems, and enabling real-time monitoring and analytics through platforms such as Grafana. This position plays a critical role in building scalable and secure digital foundations to support smart factory initiatives and operational excellence.

Summary

The Digital Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining digital infrastructure to enable machine connectivity, real-time data integration, and visualization within manufacturing environments

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Setup & Configuration

• Design and implement infrastructure required to support machine connectivity and data acquisition (edge devices, gateways, network configurations)

• Configure environments for data ingestion, processing, and visualization (on-prem / cloud / hybrid)

• Ensure system reliability, scalability, and security of all platform components

Machine Connectivity & OT Integration

• Establish connectivity with manufacturing equipment (e.g., plating line machines, sensors, PLCs)

• Integrate machine data using industrial protocols (e.g., OPC-UA, MQTT, Modbus, REST APIs)

• Ensure stable and secure communication between OT and IT environments

• SCADA Integration: Collaborate with automation engineers to interface seamlessly with SCADA systems and PLCs (e.g., Siemens, Rockwell) to extract telemetry and status data.

• Data Pipeline Reliability: Ensure the continuous, low-latency ingestion of high[1]frequency machine data from the shop floor to core databases.

Real-Time Data & Visualization

• Grafana Ecosystem: Own the administration, configuration, and optimization of Grafana for the manufacturing environment. Classification: Pandora Internal

• Dashboard Development: Build, maintain, and standardize real-time dashboards tracking OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), chemical parameters (for the plating line), energy consumption, and machine health.

• Data Storage Management: Manage and optimize Time-Series Databases (e.g., InfluxDB, Prometheus, TimescaleDB) to store and query high-volume machine logs efficiently.

Collaboration & Governance

• Partner with the Manufacturing Automation, Maintenance, and Plating Operations teams to translate production needs into technical requirements.

• Enforce cybersecurity best practices for IT/OT convergence, ensuring shop-floor data pathways are secure.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical/Automation Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Industrial Automation (OT) role within a manufacturing environment.

Key Skills

Expert-level knowledge of Grafana, MQTT, OPC-UA, time-series databases, Python, Bash, Node-RED, connecting PLCs/SCADA systems

Must have Skills

Data Visualization & Storage: Expert-level knowledge of Grafana and experience with time-series databases.

• Connectivity Protocols: Strong hands-on experience with MQTT, OPC-UA, and connecting PLCs/SCADA systems.

• Infrastructure & OS: Proficiency in Linux/Windows Server administration, networking concepts (routing, firewalls, VLANs), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Scripting: Basic programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Node-RED) for data transformation and glue-code.

Good to Have Skills

• Strong troubleshooting skills with a knack for diagnosing complex data-flow bottlenecks between physical machines and software layers.

• Excellent communication skills to act as the "bridge" between traditional IT teams and shop-floor operators.

• Agile mindset, comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving digital transformation environment.

Others

• Hybrid Work - 4 days a week, work from the office

• Office Location - Gemopolis Industrial, Prawet, Bangkok

• Contract - 1 year

• Should be fluent in Thai and English

• Number of Interviews- 2

jobs.description:
APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/speechify

Speechify is a text-to-speech app that makes it easy for the world to access information. 20+ million people use our Google Chrome extension, web app, iOS app, and Android app. our mission is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Our amazing users are students, professionals, and productivity lovers. Many of them have learning differences like dyslexia and ADHD, while many just want to read faster and listen on the go. With Speechify you can turn any book, document, or website into audio, and listen while you’re in the car, doing laundry, walking your dog, making dinner, working out, skydiving—whatever your daily routine is! Speechify also powers Medium, the Star Tribune, The Direct, and more. Easily add text-to-speech to your website.

Cliff Weitzman, our fearless CEO, founded Speechify in 2017 in a dorm room at Brown University so he could share with others the incredible text-to-speech software he’d been working on. Cliff has dyslexia and he was frustrated with how much time and energy it took for him to read. Advanced TTS technology was a total gamechanger, it allowed him to finish his readings 3x faster than a normal reader and to better comprehend and retain information.

At Speechify our goal is for reading to never be a barrier to learning for anyone. Nothing should hold you back from learning information quickly and effectively.

Speechify has grown to employ over 100 team members spread out across the globe in just a few short years. We're proud of the incredible team with members who were previously leaders and senior engineers at companies like Snapchat, Apple, Spotify, Amazon & Uber. We all love and prioritise ownership, delivering value with speed, learning as much as we can and making our users feel empowered.

The Role

APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/speechify/jobs/5411578004

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

• Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions

• Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app

• Work within a dedicated product team

• Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap

• Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

What We offer:

• A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product

• An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle

• The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry

• A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture

• Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives

• Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world

• Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.

And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Ideal Profile

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base

• Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product

• Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience

• Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction

• Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time

• Focus. We’re a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down

• Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

• Swift Programming Language

• SwiftUI experience

• Experience in Multithreading Programming

• Working with CI/CD infrastructure

• Experience with Fastlane

• SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID

• Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What's on Offer?

• Great work environment

jobs.description:
Responsibility (หน้าที่และความรับผิดชอบ)
• วิเคราะห์ความต้องการทางธุรกิจของลูกค้า และออกแบบ Cloud Solutions ที่เหมาะสม ครอบคลุม AWS, Microsoft Azure และ Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• ให้คำปรึกษาด้าน Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Migration, Hybrid Cloud, Multi-Cloud และ Cloud-Native Architecture เพื่อสนับสนุนการเปลี่ยนผ่านสู่ระบบคลาวด์

• ออกแบบ Solution Architecture พร้อมจัดทำ Technical Proposal, Solution Architecture Diagram, Bill of Materials (BOM), Scope of Work (SOW) และเอกสารประกอบการเสนอราคา

• ประเมินขนาดการใช้งาน (Sizing) และวิเคราะห์ต้นทุนการใช้งาน Cloud (Cost Estimation / Cost Optimization / FinOps) เพื่อให้เหมาะสมกับงบประมาณของลูกค้า

• นำเสนอ (Presentation) และสาธิตโซลูชัน (Demo) รวมถึงดำเนินการ Proof of Concept (PoC) เพื่อพิสูจน์ประสิทธิภาพก่อนการตัดสินใจลงทุน

• ทำงานร่วมกับทีม Sales, Technical Engineer, Cloud Provider และ Distributor เพื่อออกแบบและส่งมอบโซลูชันที่ตรงตามความต้องการของลูกค้า

• ประสานงานกับ Vendor และ Cloud Provider เช่น AWS, Microsoft, Google และ Partner อื่น ๆ เพื่อยืนยันความถูกต้องของโซลูชันและแก้ไขปัญหาทางเทคนิค

• ให้คำแนะนำด้าน Cloud Security, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Landing Zone Design และ Best Practices ในการใช้งาน Cloud

• ติดตามเทคโนโลยีและแนวโน้มใหม่ เช่น AI/Generative AI, Kubernetes, Container, Serverless, DevOps และ FinOps เพื่อนำมาพัฒนาโซลูชันให้ทันสมัย

• เข้าร่วมการอบรมและสอบ Certification ของผู้ผลิต (Vendor) เพื่อพัฒนาความรู้และความเชี่ยวชาญอย่างต่อเนื่อง

Qualification (คุณสมบัติ)
• ปริญญาตรีหรือสูงกว่า สาขาวิทยาการคอมพิวเตอร์, เทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ, วิศวกรรมคอมพิวเตอร์ หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง

• มีประสบการณ์อย่างน้อย 2-5 ปี ในตำแหน่ง Presales, Cloud Solution Architect, Cloud Engineer หรือ Technical Consultant ด้าน Cloud Infrastructure

• มีความรู้และประสบการณ์ในการออกแบบ Cloud Solutions บน AWS, Microsoft Azure หรือ Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• มีความเข้าใจด้าน Cloud Migration, Hybrid Cloud, Multi-Cloud, Cloud Networking, Virtualization และ Cloud Security

• มีความสามารถในการออกแบบ Solution Architecture พร้อมจัดทำ Proposal, BOM, SOW และเอกสารเชิงเทคนิค

• มีความรู้ด้าน Cost Optimization, FinOps และการประเมินทรัพยากร (Sizing & Capacity Planning)

• หากมีความรู้ด้าน Container, Kubernetes, Docker, Serverless, DevOps หรือ CI/CD Pipeline จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

• มีทักษะการวิเคราะห์และแก้ไขปัญหาเชิงเทคนิค พร้อมสามารถออกแบบโซลูชันให้ตอบโจทย์ธุรกิจของลูกค้า

• มีทักษะการสื่อสารและการนำเสนอที่ดี สามารถอธิบายเรื่องเทคนิคให้ทั้งผู้บริหารและผู้ใช้งานเข้าใจได้ง่าย

• สามารถทำงานร่วมกับทีมขาย ทีมวิศวกร และ Vendor ได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

• สามารถเดินทางเข้าพบลูกค้าและปฏิบัติงานนอกสถานที่ได้

หากมีใบรับรองด้าน Cloud จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ เช่น

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager (BFSI)
jobs.description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

About the Role

As a Strategic Account Manager at Trend AI, you will lead and grow strategic enterprise relationships across BFSI accounts in Thailand. You will be at the forefront of our mission to protect organisations in an AI-powered world — acting as a trusted advisor, a commercial driver, and the face of Trend AI to some of the most important organisations in the region.

This is a high-impact, client-facing role for a seasoned sales professional who thrives on building deep partnerships, navigating complex enterprise environments, and delivering results that matter — to the customer and to the business.

Primary Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary account lead for assigned major BFSI accounts, acting as a trusted advisor on cybersecurity strategy and solutions

• Build deep, multi-level relationships from IT teams to the C-suite, understanding client priorities, planned initiatives, and long-term business goals

• Translate client challenges into compelling, tailored Trend AI solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes

• Proactively identify and drive new opportunities within the account portfolio, balancing relationship depth with sharp commercial instincts

• Partner with resellers and Global System Integrators to expand reach and accelerate deal cycles

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Pre-Sales, Technical, Regional Account Managers, and Marketing teams

• Maintain a disciplined and accurate forecast using Salesforce and Trend AI’s sales tools

• Stay current on industry trends, the competitive landscape, and Trend AI’s evolving product and solution portfolio

Secondary Responsibilities

• Represent Trend AI at industry conferences, trade shows, and seminars

• Support the planning and execution of marketing and promotional programmes

• Ensure all relevant account information is documented and maintained in Salesforce

Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in enterprise account management within IT or cybersecurity

• Proven track record of managing and growing BFSI accounts with consistent quota attainment

• Hands-on experience selling cybersecurity, networking, or IT solutions with strong knowledge of the competitive market

• Demonstrated ability to engage and influence at C-level stakeholders

• Good knowledge of virtualisation and cloud-based security solutions preferred

What We’re Looking For

• Customer-obsessed, commercially driven, and collaborative by nature

• A self-starter who takes ownership and operates with a high degree of independence

• Resilient and intellectually curious — able to keep pace with a fast-moving cybersecurity landscape

• Comfortable representing Trend Micro externally as a thought leader and brand ambassador

#LI-ZA1
#LI-Hybrid

We embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation. Join Trend Micro and Thrive with us.

jobs.title: Mid/Senior Business Analyst (Tech/AI)
jobs.description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a strategic and highly analytical Mid/Senior Business Analyst to drive our project pipeline alongside the Chief Business Officer (CBO) and technical leaders. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of business strategy and deep tech—dissecting complex client problem statements, framing solutions, and transforming high-level business logic into production-ready functional designs. If you excel at presenting to C-Level executives and enjoy turning messy requirements into structured tech proposals, this is your next challenge.

Key Responsibilities
• Evaluate business cases, anticipate requirements, dissect problem statements, and form hypotheses. Translate needs into fit/gap analyses, proposed solutions, functional designs, and implementation phases.

• Partner with Graphic Designers to deliver high-quality work outputs, including presentation slides, solution plans, functional specification documents, test reports, and training materials.

• Work closely with the Chief Business Officer (CBO) and Sales team to drive the AI project pipeline. Monitor resources to ensure high-quality and timely pitching presentations to optimize business opportunities.

• Maintain smooth and timely communication with clients. Gather inputs, organize workshops, and actively manage relationships with senior client executives and C-Level suites.

• Work closely with stakeholders across the company (CEO, CBO, CTO, Chief Data Science, Sales, and Tech teams). Lead meetings and produce clear summaries, findings, and next steps.

• Understand the context of the client's industry and technical requirements for pitching. Stay updated on the latest Tech, AI, and IT advancements, applications, and use cases.

Qualifications
• Minimum 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a related field.

• Must have previous experience in Management Consulting, AI/ML, Tech Startups or Software House .

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Strong analytical, logical, and conceptual thinking skills.

• Proven ability to logically frame large chunks of quantitative and qualitative data into structured visualizations, reports, and presentations.

• Exceptional presentation and communication skills with the ability to influence and align with C-Level executives.

• Advanced competency in both spoken and written English and Thai .

• High proficiency in Microsoft applications (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook).

• Highly motivated, accountable, customer-centric, and able to multitask effectively across changing timelines and resources.

Why Join Us?
• Work from Home with Flexible Working Hours .

• Group Health Insurance.

• Choose your own gear: Mac or Windows – you pick!

• Grab Credits: Allowance for GrabFood and Grab Transportation.

• Free language courses, certificate fee coverage, and specialized technical training.

• 10+ days of annual leave.

Interested candidates, please click "Apply Now" to submit your Resume.

jobs.title: Technology Governance Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us
Do you want to be part of Thailand banking transformation? Data is the core of the new financial services era, and we are open for the opportunity to be part to drive this change at the core.
SCB DATAx is a new venture of the Siam Commercial Bank (SCB) holdings, a leading financial services and digital services holdings in Thailand and ASEAN.
As part of the transformation of SCB into a group of product and technology companies, under the SCBx brand, SCB DATAx is the technology company to centralize data and provide AI and data science services and products to the group.
With a leading-edge cloud native data & AI platform, our vision is to support the group to providing everyone in our region with the opportunity to prosper.
We work on forward-thinking challenges of centralizing, analyzing and sharing information. We collaborate with companies and experts in many different domains, embrace diversity and all that while having a good laugh and joy in work.

About Team & Role
Technology Governance Office acts as the "control tower" for Technology, providing governance oversight, risk visibility, compliance coordination, and executive insights to support the CTO and technology leadership team. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain end-to-end exposure across Data Platforms, AI Products, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Technology Operations, and Banking Technology while working directly with senior leaders and key stakeholders across the organization. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, AI-driven, intellectually curious, and passionate about using technology and data to solve problems, improve processes, and support strategic decision-making.

Your Responsibility
• Support Technology Governance activities across Data Platform, AI Products, Cloud, and Enterprise Technology environments.

• Develop, maintain, and monitor technology policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation.

• Coordinate technology risk assessments, compliance reviews, audit activities, and remediation tracking.

• Support governance oversight for technology projects, AI initiatives, and product implementation to ensure alignment with regulatory and organizational requirements.

• Prepare governance dashboards, executive reports, committee materials, and management presentations for decision-making.

• Analyze technology risks, compliance gaps, audit findings, and operational issues, providing actionable insights and recommendations.

• Collaborate with Technology, Security, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Business teams to drive governance and control effectiveness.

• Leverage AI tools and automation to improve reporting, governance processes, productivity, and operational efficiency.

• Support CTO and Technology Governance Lead in strategic initiatives, governance programs, KPI tracking, and executive communications.

• Continuously learn emerging technologies, AI trends, cybersecurity, risk management, and regulatory developments.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's Degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or related fields.

• 2–4 years of experience in Technology Governance, IT Risk, IT Audit, Cybersecurity, Compliance, or related areas.

• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong command of English and Thai, with the ability to effectively communicate, translate, and bridge discussions between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong presentation skills with the ability to prepare executive-level reports and management presentations.

• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Passionate about learning new technologies, AI, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and digital transformation.

• Demonstrated curiosity and initiative in leveraging AI tools to improve work quality, productivity, and business outcomes.

• Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and data analysis tools; Cowork is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in banking, financial services, data platforms, cloud, AI products, or regulated industries.

• Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT, ITIL, Technology Risk, or AI Governance frameworks.

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar productivity tools.

• Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, AZ-900, Security+, ISO 27001 Foundation, or AI-related certifications.
