jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Cloud Engineer to lead the design, architecture, and deployment of cloud infrastructure and MLOps environments supporting corporate AI projects and big data analytics. In this role, you will manage high-performance computing clusters (AI Compute Clusters), optimize model lifecycle pipelines from staging to production, and ensure a highly secure, resilient, and cost-efficient cloud platform.

•
Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure : Design and develop cloud-native, secure, and scalable infrastructures (primarily on Microsoft Azure) tailored for AI model processing, deep learning platforms, and AI-driven applications.

•
Network & Cloud Security : Design and implement enterprise-grade network security, including Azure Landing Zone (Hub-Spoke architecture), and manage firewall policies (Azure Firewall, NSG, Route Table) for service access and endpoint restrictions.

•
End-to-End MLOps Workflows: Build and maintain comprehensive MLOps workflows, managing the model lifecycle (Model Lifecycle Management), model tracking, and production deployments using tools like MLflow or Azure Machine Learning.

•
Compute Optimization: Manage and optimize autoscaling mechanisms for AI compute worker nodes, effectively handling scale computing tasks without performance degradation.

•
Pipelines & Automation: Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) via Terraform and automate CI/CD pipelines triggered by APIs to dynamically provision compute infrastructure for advanced mathematical/AI solutions.

•
Secure Environments: Establish secure enterprise network zones (Azure Landing Zone) and seamlessly migrate legacy AI workloads into environments aligned with corporate IT security standards.

•
Identity & Governance: Govern identity, security compliance, and access controls (Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identity) for internal/external API integrations with AI endpoints (e.g., Azure Machine Learning).

•
Financial & Cloud Cost Optimization: Monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud infrastructure costs. Generate financial reports and manage resource budgeting to ensure maximum cost-efficiency for AI workloads.

•
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps, or AI/Data Engineering , with at least 2-3 years dedicated to building AI infrastructure or MLOps platforms.

•
AI & Cloud Expertise: Strong proficiency in AI-related cloud ecosystem components (Azure), such as Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Data Factory, Container Apps, and serverless architectures.

•
MLOps & Containerization Skills: Hands-on experience with MLflow and Docker to effectively containerize and orchestrate Machine Learning models.

•
DevOps & IaC Expertise: Advanced skills in writing declarative Terraform scripts and constructing automation pipelines using Azure DevOps or Jenkins .

•
Data & Frameworks Foundation: Solid understanding of data architecture, database management (SQL/NoSQL), and integration layers including REST APIs and GraphQL frameworks.

•
Network & Security Foundations : Familiar with foundational cloud networking concepts.

•
Programming Languages: Highly proficient in Python (critical for AI/ML environments); familiarity with Groovy, JavaScript, or TypeScript is an asset.

•
Soft Skills: Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, and Application Developers. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and self-directed execution capabilities.

•
English Skill: Good command of spoken & written (Minimum TOEIC Score 500)

We are currently seeking a Cloud Operations Engineer (Azure) to join our team in Bangkok, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon Bangkok (TH-10), Thailand (TH).

Position Summary

The role is responsible for managing software releases, cloud platform operations, monitoring, and incident management across Azure-based IoT ecosystems. This position supports continuous delivery pipelines, ensures platform reliability, leads major incident response, and collaborates with engineering teams to maintain operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Release & Deployment Management

• Manage software releases across QA → Load Test → Stage → Production environments.

• Execute and support OTA firmware releases.

• Work with agile teams to build, test, and maintain CI/CD pipeline components.

• Support product NPI onboarding and participate in early sprint planning.

Cloud Operations & Platform Support

• Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure environments.

• Perform L1.5–L2 support activities including monitoring, deployments, rollbacks, and platform health checks.

• Manage migrations across platforms or service providers.

• Ensure proactive performance monitoring and SLA compliance.

• Maintain system documentation, runbooks, and operational best practices.

Monitoring, Alerting & Incident Management

• Create and manage monitoring/alerting systems for cloud and connected device platforms.

• Lead and support 24x7 major incident management, including on-call support.

• Own end-to-end incident resolution from ticket creation to closure.

• Implement corrective actions to mitigate operational and security risks.

• Conduct periodic user access/security audits.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Required

3–5 years of experience in Microsoft Azure cloud systems support.

• Knowledge of container orchestration (Kubernetes).

• Ability to script with PowerShell and Python.

• Understanding of SQL vs NoSQL databases and operational maintenance.

• Knowledge of monitoring/logging systems (Log Analytics, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Nagios, Zabbix).

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Why Coda

Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.

We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you.

Data Science & Analytics at Coda

At Coda, the Data Science & Analytics team turns data into business decisions.

We work closely with Commercial, Account Management, Marketing, Pay/Risk, Finance, and Product teams. Our work directly influences revenue growth, margin performance, risk management, campaign effectiveness, and operational efficiency.

Our stack runs on AWS, with dbt for transformation, Athena and Spark over an Iceberg and Parquet data lake, Python for analysis, and BI tools including QuickSight, Tableau, and Looker. We are also building a stronger analytics foundation: moving from fragmented legacy reporting to trusted Gold datasets, clearer metric ownership, and stronger semantic-layer practices.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer to own high-impact commercial analytics across Coda.

This role sits at the intersection of business analytics, dashboarding, metric governance, and analytical data modeling. You will support Commercial, Account Management, Marketing, Pay/Risk, and Finance by turning raw data into trusted metrics, decision-ready dashboards, and clear business recommendations.

This is not a reporting-only role. We are looking for someone who can sit with business leaders, understand the decision that needs to be made, go deep into the data, and come back with a clear point of view.

The ideal candidate is commercially sharp, technically strong, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to move quickly without compromising analytical quality.

•
Own analytics for Commercial and Account Management use cases, including publisher performance, portfolio health, margin trends, pricing impact, product performance, and opportunity sizing.

•
Support Commercial, Pay/Risk, Marketing, and Finance teams with fast, high-quality analysis that helps diagnose trends, quantify impact, and drive business action.

•
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analysis, clear recommendations, and decision-ready outputs.

•
Build and maintain trusted analytical datasets in dbt, helping define shared business logic and improve the quality of Coda’s Gold layer.

•
Help codify key metrics through semantic-layer tools such as LookML, the dbt semantic layer, or similar governed BI patterns.

•
Build dashboards in Tableau, Looker, and QuickSight that business teams actually use to monitor performance, identify issues, and make decisions.

•
Improve data quality and trust through dbt tests, freshness checks, anomaly detection, documentation, and root-cause analysis.

•
5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer, BI Analyst, or similar role.

•
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.

•
Strong business analytics experience, ideally in payments, fintech, eCommerce, gaming, digital commerce, marketplaces, or high-growth internet businesses.

•
Experience translating ambiguous business questions into structured analysis and clear recommendations.

•
Experience building dashboards in Tableau, Looker, QuickSight, Power BI, or similar tools.

•
Production experience with dbt, including models, tests, documentation, and reusable transformation patterns.

•
Familiarity with semantic-layer concepts such as LookML, dbt semantic layer, Cube, metrics layers, or governed BI models.

•
Working knowledge of AWS data tools such as Athena, S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, or similar cloud data platforms.

•
Python skills for analytical work, especially pandas, numpy, and basic statistical analysis.

•
Strong understanding of business metrics such as TPV, revenue, gross profit, margin, conversion, retention, campaign performance, fraud/risk metrics, and account performance.

•
Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially with business and leadership stakeholders.

•
Ability to work independently, prioritize well, and move quickly in a fast-changing business environment.

•
Experience with Iceberg, Parquet, or modern lakehouse architectures.

•
Experience migrating from legacy BI/reporting environments to governed semantic layers.

•
Experience with marketing measurement, attribution, incrementality, A/B testing, geo tests, or matched-market tests.

•
Experience working with payment, fraud, risk, or transaction data.

•
Experience supporting Commercial, Account Management, Finance, or executive stakeholders.

•
Exposure to ML workflows, SageMaker, or AI-assisted analytics workflows.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued.

Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

jobs.title: UX Designer and Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
CMKL University is rebuilding its public website using a modern static-site architecture powered by Astro and Keystatic. This project encompasses the complete redesign of the university's public web presence, including information architecture, user experience, visual design, and frontend implementation. This is a hands-on role focused on designing and building the user-facing experience. Backend infrastructure, content migration, and deployment are managed by an in-house engineer and AI coding agents, allowing you to concentrate on UX, UI, and frontend development. Throughout the project, you will collaborate closely with AI coding tools, directing implementation while owning the overall design, interaction, and frontend architecture.
Responsibilities
• Partner with the project director to conduct rapid user research, map user journeys, and define the site's information architecture and navigation.

• Design wireframes and interactive prototypes for key page types, including the homepage, program pages, faculty directory, news articles, and admissions.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive design system, including typography, color palettes, spacing, responsive layouts, and reusable UI components aligned with the university's brand identity.

• Translate UX designs into semantic, maintainable, production-ready frontend templates using Astro.

• Build responsive, mobile-first interfaces supporting academic programs, admissions, research, faculty profiles, news, and university events.

• Design an accessible bilingual content model supporting English content with optional Thai translations while maintaining high usability across localized layouts.

• Ensure all templates meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility standards.

• Refine layouts and interactions through iterative feedback from stakeholders across the university.

• Conduct comprehensive visual, accessibility, and cross-browser quality assurance before launch.

• Produce clear technical documentation covering frontend conventions, design tokens, and component usage, and coordinate with the engineering team during deployment.

Qualifications
• At least 2 years of professional experience combining frontend development with UX/UI design.

• A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of digital products, from UX design through frontend implementation.

• Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma, along with strong expertise in responsive, mobile-first CSS architecture.

• Experience developing frontend applications with modern frameworks such as React, Vue, Svelte, or similar technologies.

• Familiarity with Git-based development workflows and command-line tooling.

• Experience using AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude to accelerate frontend development.

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills for day-to-day collaboration and technical documentation.

• Familiarity with static-site technologies such as Astro, Next.js, or Hugo, and Git-based headless CMS platforms such as Keystatic.

• Experience designing or developing websites for universities, educational institutions, or other content-rich organizations is highly desirable.

• Professional proficiency in Thai for validating localized interfaces, typography, and translated content.

Please submit your comprehensive CV and professional design & development portfolio to ••••@cmkl.ac.th .

jobs.description:
Job Purpose/Role
Our company is currently in the process of revolutionizing an internal IT industry to optimize and improve our customer journey throughout our system of which it supports from the Point of Sales to the gigantic ERP system.
As Tooling and Innovation Engineer, your role is providing innovation/technologies/tools evaluation, design, implement and support for just in time solutions align with rapid business changes. Tools & Innovation are integrated applications with business operation to optimize and efficient. It can be both create a new system or add-on world class SAAS (such as JIRA, Salesforce, Kissflow, Kong API Gateway and etc.). They are using for making business operation and technology are optimized and make greater return.
Tooling and Innovative Engineer also develop solutions for improve all organization’s operations for replacing manpower with RPA (Robotic Process Automation) to making Hyper Automation Organization. For example, Integration between systems, Reconciliation, Issue Analytical Chatbot for improve quality checking list, Automation process / job for reducing manpower and etc.
Your job is working with many departments in organization for transform manually operations to be automation including provide guidance for their able develop automation with our automation platforms. We are using Agile methodology for managing planning and delivery cycle.
Key Responsibilities
• Design / Implement & Unit Testing / Testing / Support applications or services for improving organization’s process.

• Provide Technology / Tools evaluation for selecting the best fit or Innovation / Tool / RPA.

• Co-ordinate / Participate in UAT for user testing our solutions

• Create design documents and/or manual (if needed)

• Coaching and Mentoring team members.

• More than full stack developer; able to do basic DevOps, Testing and Requirement gathering

• Able to identify gaps for defining initiative for team level improvement.

• Delivery cycle with agile methodologies.

• Back up team leader for managing team.

• Development by AI Agent Assistance (SDD or Vibe Code)

Key Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in IT related and experience more than 6 years in Software development.

• Flexible, Adaptative and Open mind for any new challenges and changes.

• Innovative and think outside to box for mix & matched on solutions.

• Business driven over individual interest

• Teamwork and transparent.

• At least 2 years in senior position or equivalent.

• At least 3 years on node.js and TypeScript either server or client-side development.

• At least 3 years on Git for source control.

• At least 2 years on TDD (Test Driven Development) and unit testing framework such as jasmine, etc.

• At least 2 years on either SQL or noSQL.

• At least 1 years on AI Agent Assistance development (SDD or Vibe Code)

• Experienced on Agile development any Scrum / Kanban / ScrumBan.

• Experienced on Code reviewer and Code healthiness analysis for eliminate code smell.

• Experienced on CI/CD Concept such as Jenkins

• Experienced on IDE such as Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ and etc.

• Experienced on Web Client JS framework such as Angular, React, Vue and etc. As a plus

• Experienced on Groovy language as a plus.

• Experienced on JIRA Plugin as a plus.

• Experienced on Salesforce APEX coding as a plus.

• Experienced on Jenkins pipeline as a plus.

• Experienced on RPA (Such as UI Path, Selenium, WebDriver and etc.) as a plus
